rows.title: Construction Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Construction Operations Analyst plays a pivotal role in Suffolk’s Mission Control model—our transformational, analytics-driven strategy to drive project excellence across cost, schedule and safety. This role combines construction operations, data analytics, and technology to identify emerging project risks, translate data into actionable insights, and support timely intervention across the portfolio. The Analyst will work closely with senior leadership, project teams, functional groups, and the Data team to turn complex project data into clear, practical actions.

This is a high-growth opportunity for someone who understands construction, is curious about data and technology, and wants to directly influence project outcomes.

Responsibilities

 Monitor and analyze portfolio performance to identify early indicators of project risk across the project lifecycle, from preconstruction through closeout.  Analyze cost, schedule, and safety trends to develop performance and predictive insights using project data, benchmarks, and technology tools.  Support Mission Control through leading-indicator dashboards, analytics, and executive reporting.  Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for Project Managers, Superintendents, and senior leadership.  Collaborate with the Data and Operations teams to develop and deploy predictive analytics and construction technology solutions, including Tripwire 2.0, Schedule and Financial Analytics, and other emerging tools.  Participate in onsite project reviews and deep dives to connect data-driven insights with field conditions and project execution.  Continuously identify opportunities to improve how Suffolk uses data, analytics, and technology to manage project risk and performance. 

 FY27-FY28 Key Initiatives You’ll Support 

 Mission Critical Risk & Metrics Development: Partner with Mission Critical leadership and the Data team to develop, validate, and implement metrics that identify early indicators of risk and enable proactive intervention across the data center portfolio.  Predictive Analytics & Technology: Collaborate with the Data team to build foundational capabilities for Suffolk’s predictive and prescriptive analytics framework, including dynamic dashboards and enterprise-level reporting.  Executive Reporting Modernization: Assess and reimagine Suffolk’s executive reporting portfolio to streamline reporting, improve data flow and insights, and establish a scalable future-state model. Partner with Regional Operations and Data teams to implement the future state, including opportunities to leverage AI for executive insights and action tracking. 


Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Civil Engineering, Data Analytics, Finance/Accounting, or related discipline.  2–4 years of professional experience, preferably in construction operations, project controls, or data center construction.  Construction experience in roles such as Project Engineer, Project Manager, Superintendent, or Project Controls is preferred.  Experience with Procore, Primavera P6, and Oracle; strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.  Working Knowledge on SQL, Power BI or Tableau is a plus.  Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive-level insights.  Strong interest in predictive analytics, AI, construction technology, and data-driven decision-making  Willingness to learn and adopt emerging construction technology, including SmartPM, Schedule Validator, ALICE, and Vena.  Strong interpersonal skills and cross-functional collaboration experience; able to work with national and regional teams.  Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with flexibility to work long hours as needed. 

 Working Conditions 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; talk or hear; perform fine motor, hand and finger skills in the use of a keyboard, telephone, or writing. The employee is frequently required to stands; walk; and reach with arms and/or hands. Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. The employee will spend their time in an office environment with a quiet to moderate noise level. Job site walking.

 EEO Statement 

Suffolk provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, national origin, citizenship, genetic information, disability, protected veteran, gender identity, age or any other status protected by law. This policy applies to recruiting, hiring, transfers, promotions, terminations, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment. Suffolk will not tolerate any unlawful discrimination toward, or harassment of, applicants or employees by anyone at Suffolk, or anyone working on behalf of Suffolk.

Compensation Information

Where required by law, pay ranges can be found in Suffolk's job postings. Base Salary for this position is just one component of Suffolk’s total rewards package for employees. Actual salaries may be based on several factors including, but not limited to, a candidate's skill set, experience, education and other qualifications. Suffolk offers a comprehensive benefits package as part of its overall total rewards strategy. Salary ranges are reviewed regularly to reflect market trends.

About Suffolk

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment (Suffolk Technologies). By integrating data, artificial intelligence, and advanced technology through our Seamless Platform, we connect design, construction, and operations to deliver smarter, more predictable results and redefine how America builds.

Suffolk – America’s Contractor – is a national company with more than $9 billion in annual revenue, 3,000 employees, and 17 offices, including Boston (headquarters), New York City, Miami, West Palm Beach, Tampa, Estero, Dallas, Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Las Vegas, Herndon, U.S. Virgin Islands, and other key markets. Suffolk manages some of the most complex and transformative projects in the country, serving clients across healthcare, life sciences, education, gaming, aviation, transportation, government, mission critical, and commercial sectors. Suffolk is privately held and is led by founder, chairman and CEO John Fish. Suffolk is ranked #8 on ENR’s list of “Top CM-at-Risk Contractors.” For more information, visit www.suffolk.com and follow Suffolk on Facebook , Twitter , LinkedIn , YouTube , and Instagram .

At Suffolk, we believe that our total rewards program should offer you and your family the support you need when it matters most. That’s why we have created a program that provides employees with access to a wide variety of options that can be personalized to support you and your loved ones physically, emotionally, and financially.

Benefits include, competitive salaries, auto allowances and gas cards for certain roles, access to market leading medical and emotional and mental health benefits, dental, and vision insurance plans, virtual care options for physical therapy and primary care, generous paid time off, 401k plan with employer match and access to expert financial resources, company paid and voluntary life insurance, tax deferred savings accounts, 10 backup daycare days each year, short- and long-term disability, commuter benefits and more.? rows.descriptionText:
Commercial Analyst - Summer 2027

Start Dates Available: June & July 2027

Boston, MA

Salary Range: The base salary for this position is $80,000 plus a joining bonus of $5,000.

This is a Boston based opportunity with a 4 day in office expectation (Monday - Thursday) with 1 day remote (Friday).

At this time, Wayfair will not sponsor applicants for employment authorization for this position for the following work visas: STEM OPT EAD, H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, O-1, J-1, or TN.

Who We Are:

Join us as we build the #1 destination for all things home!

At Wayfair, we support upcoming graduates in launching their careers in e-commerce and technology. With endless opportunities across technology, commercial, operations, marketing, and finance - there is a path for everyone. As a full-time employee, you'll be challenged to solve complex problems and build solutions to company-wide initiatives.

Drive the strategic growth of Wayfair's dynamic Commercial team as a Commercial Analyst, where your insights will directly shape how millions of customers design their homes. In this high-impact role, you will tackle complex operational challenges, optimize product discovery, and execute high-stakes initiatives that sharpen Wayfair's competitive edge. By bridging data-driven strategy with real-world execution, your work will directly enhance supplier partnerships and elevate the end-to-end experience for customers across the globe.

What You’ll Do:

Analyze and model large, complex datasets using SQL, Python, R, or advanced Excel techniques to surface actionable business trends and uncover growth opportunities.Drive end-to-end strategy execution by leading high-impact initiatives across pricing, marketing, and product selection to directly enhance profitability and competitive position.Build and own intuitive performance dashboards and real-time tracking systems to optimize daily operations and establish measurable KPIs across teams.Leverage analytical insights to partner directly with suppliers, guiding selection strategy and negotiating key improvements to elevate the end-to-end customer experience.Design, deploy, and evaluate rigorous A/B tests and quantitative models to solve ambiguous business challenges and validate long-term roadmap decisions.Communicate technical findings through clear visualizations and persuasive presentations to align cross-functional stakeholders and steer leadership decision-making.Use approved AI and automation tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analysis and workflows; validate and refine technology-assisted outputs, apply sound judgment, and remain accountable for the quality of the final deliverable.

What You’ll Need:

Basic Qualifications:

Currently pursuing a Bachelors in a relevant discipline (e.g. Marketing, Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics), with the expectation that degree will be obtained by Spring 2027Minimum GPA of 3.0Authorization to work in the United States without visa sponsorship by Wayfair now or in the future. Visa sponsorship includes the following work visas: STEM OPT EAD, H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, O-1, J-1, or TN.Proficient in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets and SQL or Google Big Query

Preferred Qualifications:

Strong consultative skills: ability to work effectively and persuasively with a highly cross- functional group of business partners Strong business acumen: ability to understand how various parts of the business interact; can identify and approach problems from a customer or supplier perspective Exceptional analytical and quantitative skills: excited about working with and synthesizing big data into actionable insights; comfortable using data software to conduct analyses and synthesize findings Exceptional problem-solving and execution skills: ability to make decisions, reprioritize tasks, and draw conclusions in the face of ambiguity Excellent written and verbal communication skills Familiarity with any programming language is a plus, including motivation to learn and develop the skill-setStrong comfort level and appetite to use AI in daily workflow

Possible Team Placements:

Global Marketing: Lead high-yield acquisition and brand strategies across Wayfair’s largest digital and offline advertising channels to drive profitable customer growth. On a daily basis, you’ll analyze channel performance metrics, optimize multi-million dollar campaign spends using predictive data models, and present cross-functional growth strategies to senior leaders. It’s an immersive, high-stakes role where your data-driven adjustments directly scale Wayfair's reach across global markets.

Profit Management: Directly influence Wayfair’s top and bottom lines by owning dynamic pricing strategies and margin performance across all global brands. Your average day involves auditing dynamic pricing models, analyzing price elasticity across millions of SKUs, and stress-testing profitability scenarios to balance market competitiveness with gross margin targets. You’ll tackle complex financial trade-offs in real time, making a direct and immediate impact on organizational revenue.

Business Trends: Serve as a strategic advisor to senior executives by tracking, diagnosing, and acting on key performance metrics that govern long-term Customer Lifetime Value (CLV). Day-to-day, you’ll query cross-channel datasets, isolate macro and micro trend anomalies, and deliver clear, rapid-response root-cause analyses directly to business leads. This role puts you at the absolute center of corporate decision-making, where your diagnostic work guides high-level operational pivots.

B2B & Global Sales: Engine for growth within Wayfair Professional, driving strategies to capture market share across commercial and B2B customer segments. On any given day, you will evaluate sales pipeline health, model custom pricing incentives for high-value accounts, and build tools that empower account managers to optimize client engagement. You’ll tackle unique B2B buyer journeys, building data foundations that turn high-volume business prospects into lifelong clients.

Each day, you’ll dive into customer search and browsing behaviors, build intuitive performance dashboards, and run item-level placement analyses across digital platforms and physical store footprints. Your insights ensure every brand collection tells a cohesive story that maximizes customer conversion.

Your daily routine includes evaluating store-level inventory velocity, analyzing foot-traffic behavior patterns, and synthesizing in-store shopping data with digital metrics to optimize the physical retail journey. You will tackle the unique, highly strategic challenge of bridging brick-and-mortar experiences with our digital ecosystem.

On a daily basis, you will run diagnostic queries on supplier data pipelines, design A/B testing frameworks for product page layouts, and refine discovery algorithms that help customers find precisely what they need. rows.descriptionText:
Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

Working under the supervision of the Administrative Manager for Psychiatry Interventional Services, and in collaboration with the Director of the Clinical Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) Service and Medical Director of Image-Guided Targeting and following established policies and procedures, supports image-guided targeting for clinical patients receiving accelerated TMS (aTMS). The analyst will work in the clinical TMS service of BWH and will require professionalism, self-motivation, and an ability to work independently.

The analyst should have experience in data analyses and/or statistical programming and be highly motivated and able to learn new analytical skills. The analyst may be responsible for the following activities: collecting, entering and organizing patient data; cleaning and analyzing large databases of patient data; developing and running statistical code to the clinical TMS service, generating data visualizations using statistical software including Python; contributing to the preparation and presentation of results in the form of oral presentation at meetings and documentation in the electronic medical record. Projects range from simple programming and basic data manipulation/analysis to more advanced and predictive analytics. The analyst will work closely with their team to execute analytic plans and ensure accurate, valid, reliable, and timely results. The analyst must have a strong attention to detail and an in-depth knowledge of data structure, programming, and administration of computational systems.

Qualifications

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Work with a variety of tools (ex: Python, Excel, etc.) to access data, write queries, develop programming logic, create dashboards, manipulate, and analyze large datasets to meet the needs of the BWH clinical TMS service.Assisting in all statistical and data management tasks for clinical service. Performs these tasks with a high level of accuracy under supervision of faculty.Developing analytical and statistical tools to aid with analysis of patient data.Developing and maintaining the service’s computational environment.Assists in writing the processing programs necessary to implement new phases of clinical care including the checking scripts needed to ensure the validity and consistency of new data.Contributes data and programming expertise at meetings.Assists in the design and implementation of interim and final data cleaning and documentation for closed sections of the clinical database.Modifies and runs routine quality control and reporting programs for use by clinical personnel as well as for circulation to leadership. This includes writing new macros for data management and analysis, as well as production of any graphical output necessary for visualization of the results.Interacts directly with clinical personnel to resolve data problems.Responsible for the development and maintenance of department databases and capabilities.Assisting with MRI image acquisition and MRI data processing, including construction and de-bugging of data analysis pipelines.Managing the clinical TMS targeting pipeline.Responsible for collecting data and maintaining patient information database for clinical care. May be required to input data, do minimum analysis and run various reports. Maintains patients records as part of record keeping function.Monitors and sets up any needed equipment.Maintains inventory and orders supplies when necessary.Opportunity to perform transcranial magnetic stimulation if candidate interested.Works as a team member with all other staff to ensure smooth collaboration.All other duties, as assigned.Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

BS or BANew graduate with relevant course or project work

Skills/Abilities/Competencies Required

Excellent interpersonal skills are required for working with the team.Good oral and written communication skills.Knowledge of clinical research protocols.Knowledge of computer programs, databases, etc.Working knowledge of programming systems such as Python, etc.Knowledge of the Windows environment including Microsoft Office software and related database applications.Previous experience with MS Access and Excel highly encouraged.Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize a variety of tasks.Careful attention to detail.Ability to demonstrate professionalism and respect for patient rights and individual needs.

Working Conditions

Office and clinic environmentHybrid work arrangement can be discussed

Additional Job Details (if Applicable)

Remote Type

Hybrid

Work Location

60 Fenwood Road

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Employee Type

Regular

Work Shift

Day (United States of America)

Pay Range

$53,040.00 - $75,888.80/Annual

Grade

5

At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package.

EEO Statement

2200 The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. We will ensure that all individuals with a disability are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857)-282-7642.

Mass General Brigham Competency Framework

At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People-Focused, half Performance-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

NOTE: Fidelity will not provide sponsorship for this position. 

The Role

Do you want to make a difference in our customers’ lives and be part of a highly collaborative, cross-functional team committed to improving the value of our products within Fidelity Capital Markets? We are looking for a quantitative expert to lead our research in our systematic trading and analytics platforms, coach our quant team to deliver relevant solutions, and help our clients to navigate the market! With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe{{:}} Summer (May-Aug 2027)

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

What We Need

Symbotic is looking for an applied scientist intern with a passion for multi-agent planning to improve the performance and reliability of our systems as we rapidly scale our product and organization. The Robot Routing team plans highly efficient, collision-free paths between the storage structure and the inbound/outbound cells of our system for dozens of robots traversing the transfer deck. The right candidate is excited about concepts like deadlock resolution and time-space reservations. This is a hybrid position based at our headquarters in Wilmington, MA.

What You’ll Do

Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics software. Adapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems. Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms. Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues. 

What You’ll Need

Pursuing PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages{{:}} C++, Python, Java, or C#. Strong research background in combinatorial optimization, Robotics planning, multi-robot systems, or machine learning. Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) on some of the aforementioned topics. 

About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information.

We are looking for someone to champion the creation and adoption of standardized data. The Senior Associate of Ontology and Data Modeling will be responsible for partnering with Technology, Product, and other Capital One teams to support the development and integration of semantic technology into Capital One products and services.

The Senior Associate of Ontology and Data Modeling should be capable of supporting an emerging and evolving semantic program at Capital One, capable of clearly communicating and advocating the value of using semantic technology and knowledge organization concepts.

rows.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow- Biostatistics/Machine Learning - Hovestadt Lab
rows.descriptionText:
Dr. Vokler Hovestadt is hiring a Postdoctoral Research Fellow- Biostatistics/Machine Learning for his lab!

The Hovestadt Lab in the Department of Pediatric Oncology at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (https://hovestadtlab.github.io, affiliations with Boston Children’s Hospital and the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard) is seeking a highly motivated computational postdoctoral research fellow. Our lab studies childhood brain tumors and leukemias, two of the most common cancers in children. We aim to better understand tumor biology using cutting-edge experimental and computational approaches. Translational goals of our research include the development of more accurate patient classification systems and novel treatment strategies.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Requirements

The postdoctoral fellow will apply modern AI techniques to accurately predict clinical outcomes and provide treatment recommendations for children with cancer. Towards this goal, the postdoc will work with large genomic datasets derived from thousands of patients. The project provides ample opportunity to advance scientific skills and to collaborate with world renowned experts in the fields of childhood brain tumor research and epigenomics. Candidates need to be passionate about cancer research and intrinsically motivated. Creativity and innovative/independent thinking are a must.

Qualifications

 A PhD in Computational Biology, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or related discipline Strong interest in working with large biomedical/genomic datasets Experience in developing/applying modern AI approaches Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with scientists from other disciplines Good oral and written communication skills An outstanding academic track record

Interested applicants must apply to the position and send a cover letter with their CV to James McLean (JamesA_McLean@dfci.harvard.edu). Letters of support will be asked for later.

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. As relentless as we are in our mission to reduce the burden of cancer for all, we are committed to having faculty and staff who offer multifaceted experiences. Cancer knows no boundaries and when it comes to hiring the most dedicated and compassionate professionals, neither do we. If working in this kind of organization inspires you, we encourage you to apply.

Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is an equal opportunity employer and affirms the right of every qualified applicant to receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, genetic information, disability, age, ancestry, military service, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

rows.title: Coach-Mentor
rows.descriptionText:
Soccer Without Borders is looking for a dynamic Coach-Mentor to serve at Soccer Without Borders’ sports-based youth development programs across the United States through the Coach Across America Coach-Mentor to bring our mission to life every day through their work on and off the field, delivering quality programming and engaging in authentic community-building. The Coach-Mentor will be part of an innovative and inclusive organization that is made up of a passionate group of people who are united by the shared belief that sport can positively shape the lives of youth.
ResponsibilitiesThis position has two primary areas of responsibility: 
1. Direct Service: Soccer Coaching and Activity-planning (75%): Coach-Mentors work directly with newcomer refugee and immigrant youth and families. Together with other local Soccer Without Borders team members, Coach-Mentors design and lead soccer practices, games, league play, team-building activities, and community events throughout the year. The Coach-Mentor will learn the Soccer Without Borders “FAMILY” model for coaching, creating an environment where everyone has an opportunity to learn, grow and belong. The Coach-Mentor is responsible for fostering a positive team culture through their facilitation and leadership skills. Facilitating group circles is a key part of building a strong culture, where the Coach-Mentor creates a space for youth to develop Social-Emotional and Leadership skills through reflection, voice, and connection. 
2. Program Support (25%): The Coach-Mentor plays an important role in the behind-the-scenes work that goes into making our programs possible. The Coach-Mentor supports youth and families to overcome barriers to participation through youth and family engagement, including phone calls and house visits. The Coach-Mentor is responsible for helping SWB communicate the impact of the program to our funders in grants and to our fans on social media through timely monitoring and reporting of activities and their attendance, as well as collecting surveys, stories, photos, and videos from our youth and families. The Coach-Mentor may take on other responsibilities to meet the unique needs of local program sites
ExpectationsThe ideal candidate for this role... 1. Is an energetic, dynamic, and engaging leader who is passionate about bringing SWB’s mission to life. You believe in the power of sport and are eager to have as many people live the mission as possible. You get energy from interacting with people, and look forward to leading teams of youth alongside a group of volunteer assistant coaches. You have experience working with youth, public speaking, coaching soccer and are able to tailor practice sessions to age and ability. 
2. Is a dedicated team-oriented person who enjoys building relationships and desires to create an inclusive environment for all participants. You are interested in getting to know all SWB youth and their families, and look forward to building relationships with all members of the SWB community. You are eager to build a positive culture that aligns with SWB values and brings together diverse communities. You may already be embedded in the communities we serve, have an understanding of the experiences of immigrants and refugees, or have cross-cultural experience from your personal life, work, or travel. 
3. Is a flexible self-starter who can take initiative and be a creative problem solver. You are able to work independently and figure out problems on their own without guidance. When confronted with a problem, you are resourceful when coming up with a solution. You are open-minded and flexible when plans change. You may have experience working or living independently and managing your own schedule in less structured environments. 
Ideally, the Coach-Mentor is proficient in English and a second language spoken by the local SWB community. Having a driver’s license and personal transportation is helpful, but not required.

rows.title: Research Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As a Research Operations Analyst, you will help safeguard the quality, integrity, and efficiency of research and model development across CRS (Catastrophe and Risk Solutions). Reporting to the Head of Research Operations within the Research Department, you will partner with researchers and engineers as a compliance liaison throughout the development lifecycle, conduct model audits ahead of release, and support a broad portfolio of Research Operations initiatives, from training and GenAI enablement to data acquisition and resource planning, all in service of helping Research operate at scale and amplify its impact across the organization. We operate in an environment in perpetual evolution, with access to new compute solutions, new software, and new AI capabilities. Research Operations helps Research maintain its level of excellence by organizing and optimizing the people, processes, tools, and technologies behind our work, ensuring it stays reproducible, well documented, compliant, and efficiently supported. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong attention to detail, solid technical foundations, and a genuine curiosity about how world-class scientific modeling gets done. You will apply and enforce our established procedures while gaining broad exposure to audit, data, AI, and infrastructure topics within a leading modeling organization. You will join a department of more than 100 scientists, engineers, mathematicians, and analysts who develop and maintain a global suite of probabilistic risk models used to quantify and transfer risk worldwide.

Responsibilities

Supporting Model Audits & Research Compliance 

Following our established audit procedure, you will conduct methodical audits of models ahead of each release milestone. Working from our model release questionnaire, you will verify process and release readiness (including reproducibility of results and validation against benchmarks), data management practices, documentation and team redundancy, compliance requirements, and adherence to code and coding standards. Beyond checking responses, you will probe inconsistencies, ask follow-up questions, and exercise judgment about what constitutes sufficient evidence, tracking findings through to resolution. As a review liaison during development, you will advise teams on research compliance, helping protect our intellectual property and minimize our data footprint. You will also help implement new processes and requirements for models developed on Nexus, our new platform, and keep audit procedures and checklists documented and up to date.

Advising on Data Acquisition

You will guide teams through Data Usage Requests and advise on terms of use for external data, flagging licensing or usage risks early in development.

Enabling Training & Knowledge Sharing

You will develop training content on research best practices and compliance standards, and coordinate, and at times lead, training efforts drawing on our in-house experts, helping knowledge circulate across the department.

Advancing GenAI Adoption

You will maintain a curated repository of GenAI prompts and workflows, helping researchers discover, reuse, and extend what works, and tracking emerging use cases to broaden the responsible use of generative AI in Research.

Supporting IT Resource Management & Planning

You will maintain an overview of data management practices, facilitate the planning of compute, storage, and software needs, and prepare usage overviews that help leadership make informed decisions about resources.

Contributing to Community & Communication

You will help coordinate community rituals such as research seminars and team-building events, and participate in newsletter efforts that showcase the department's work and keep teams connected.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree required (Math, Engineering, Science, or related field). Master’s degree preferred. 0–3 years of experience; exposure to research, model development, audit, or quality assurance environments is a plus.

Skills & Mindset 

Exceptional attention to detail and a methodical, rigorous approach to reviewing workGenuine interest in auditing scientific work and understanding how models are built Highly organized, able to juggle several initiatives and follow established procedures consistently Clear communicator who can raise findings constructively and interact with different roles and levels Integrity and independence: able to hold teams to standards respectfully but firmly Curious, self-directed learner, energized by an evolving environment of new tools and technologies Comfortable operating in an environment of continuous change, flexible and adaptable to shifting priorities Technical Skills Working knowledge of Python or a similar scripting language, sufficient to read and assess code Experience in project management and software such as Jira Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git/GitHub) Strong working skills in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and prompt design, with an interest in building reusable AI workflows Understanding of reproducibility principles in scientific or data-driven work Familiarity with data management concepts (data catalogs, data lineage) is a plus Experience building dashboards or usage reports (e.g., Excel, Power BI) is a plus

Our Values in Action In this role, you will embody Verisk's values by: 

Learning, seeking to understand how models are developed, how compliance protects our work, and how emerging technologies such as generative AI can responsibly enhance research Caring, engaging with teams respectfully, raising findings constructively, and acting as a trusted partner rather than a gatekeeper Delivering Value, ensuring our research is compliant, reproducible, and efficiently supported, translating into reliable, high-quality outcomes for our downstream teams and our businesses

About Us

For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster.

At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations.

Verisk Businesses

Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision

Claims Solutions — supports end-to-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences

Property and Restoration Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day-to-day workflows the most efficient

Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end-to-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance

Catastrophe and Risk Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to catastrophic events.

Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing,relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement

Life Insurance Solutions – offers end-to-end, data insight-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group.

Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger

Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.

Verisk invests in a benefits package for all employees that includes the following: Health Insurance, a Retirement Plan, Disability benefits, and a Paid Time Off program. We offer a competitive total rewards package that includes base salary determined based on role, experience, skill set, and location.

These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

Job Title: 2027 Spring Co-op mRNA Drug Substance Process Characterization Data Analytics and Visualization

About The Job

Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. We are seeking a highly motivated Spring Co-op to join our mRNA Drug Substance Process Characterization Data Analytics and Visualization team.

This role focuses on developing tools and workflows to analyze, visualize, and streamline analytical data generated in support of mRNA drug substance process development. You will work closely with a team of scientists responsible for routine and development-stage analytical assays, including HPLC, LC–MS, ELISA, qPCR, and electrophoretic methods. The primary goal of this internship is to improve how analytical data is processed, interpreted, and communicated—enabling faster decision-making and increased throughput. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of analytical chemistry/biochemistry and data science, with opportunities to directly impact development decisions, lab operations, assay performance tracking, and data integrity.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

Design and implement data analysis and visualization tools for analytical datasets (e.g., HPLC, LC–MS, ELISA, qPCR).Build automated workflows for data ingestion, cleaning, and transformation from instrument outputs or shared databases.Develop intuitive data visualization dashboards (e.g. Power BI) for assay output, performance, trends, and control.Support statistical analysis of assay performance (e.g., accuracy, precision, linearity).Collaborate with scientists to understand pain points and translate them into practical data-based solutions.Document tools and workflows for internal use and scalability.

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future focused team. rows.title: Research Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As a Research Operations Analyst, you will help safeguard the quality, integrity, and efficiency of research and model development across CRS (Catastrophe and Risk Solutions). Reporting to the Head of Research Operations within the Research Department, you will partner with researchers and engineers as a compliance liaison throughout the development lifecycle, conduct model audits ahead of release, and support a broad portfolio of Research Operations initiatives, from training and GenAI enablement to data acquisition and resource planning, all in service of helping Research operate at scale and amplify its impact across the organization. We operate in an environment in perpetual evolution, with access to new compute solutions, new software, and new AI capabilities. Research Operations helps Research maintain its level of excellence by organizing and optimizing the people, processes, tools, and technologies behind our work, ensuring it stays reproducible, well documented, compliant, and efficiently supported. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong attention to detail, solid technical foundations, and a genuine curiosity about how world-class scientific modeling gets done. You will apply and enforce our established procedures while gaining broad exposure to audit, data, AI, and infrastructure topics within a leading modeling organization. You will join a department of more than 100 scientists, engineers, mathematicians, and analysts who develop and maintain a global suite of probabilistic risk models used to quantify and transfer risk worldwide.

Responsibilities

Supporting Model Audits & Research Compliance 

Following our established audit procedure, you will conduct methodical audits of models ahead of each release milestone. Working from our model release questionnaire, you will verify process and release readiness (including reproducibility of results and validation against benchmarks), data management practices, documentation and team redundancy, compliance requirements, and adherence to code and coding standards. Beyond checking responses, you will probe inconsistencies, ask follow-up questions, and exercise judgment about what constitutes sufficient evidence, tracking findings through to resolution. As a review liaison during development, you will advise teams on research compliance, helping protect our intellectual property and minimize our data footprint. You will also help implement new processes and requirements for models developed on Nexus, our new platform, and keep audit procedures and checklists documented and up to date.

Advising on Data Acquisition

You will guide teams through Data Usage Requests and advise on terms of use for external data, flagging licensing or usage risks early in development.

Enabling Training & Knowledge Sharing

You will develop training content on research best practices and compliance standards, and coordinate, and at times lead, training efforts drawing on our in-house experts, helping knowledge circulate across the department.

Advancing GenAI Adoption

You will maintain a curated repository of GenAI prompts and workflows, helping researchers discover, reuse, and extend what works, and tracking emerging use cases to broaden the responsible use of generative AI in Research.

Supporting IT Resource Management & Planning

You will maintain an overview of data management practices, facilitate the planning of compute, storage, and software needs, and prepare usage overviews that help leadership make informed decisions about resources.

Contributing to Community & Communication

You will help coordinate community rituals such as research seminars and team-building events, and participate in newsletter efforts that showcase the department's work and keep teams connected.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree required (Math, Engineering, Science, or related field). Master’s degree preferred. 0–3 years of experience; exposure to research, model development, audit, or quality assurance environments is a plus.

Skills & Mindset 

Exceptional attention to detail and a methodical, rigorous approach to reviewing workGenuine interest in auditing scientific work and understanding how models are built Highly organized, able to juggle several initiatives and follow established procedures consistently Clear communicator who can raise findings constructively and interact with different roles and levels Integrity and independence: able to hold teams to standards respectfully but firmly Curious, self-directed learner, energized by an evolving environment of new tools and technologies Comfortable operating in an environment of continuous change, flexible and adaptable to shifting priorities Technical Skills Working knowledge of Python or a similar scripting language, sufficient to read and assess code Experience in project management and software such as Jira Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git/GitHub) Strong working skills in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and prompt design, with an interest in building reusable AI workflows Understanding of reproducibility principles in scientific or data-driven work Familiarity with data management concepts (data catalogs, data lineage) is a plus Experience building dashboards or usage reports (e.g., Excel, Power BI) is a plus

Our Values in Action In this role, you will embody Verisk's values by: 

Learning, seeking to understand how models are developed, how compliance protects our work, and how emerging technologies such as generative AI can responsibly enhance research Caring, engaging with teams respectfully, raising findings constructively, and acting as a trusted partner rather than a gatekeeper Delivering Value, ensuring our research is compliant, reproducible, and efficiently supported, translating into reliable, high-quality outcomes for our downstream teams and our businesses

About Us

For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster.

At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations.

Verisk Businesses

Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision

Claims Solutions — supports end-to-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences

Property and Restoration Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day-to-day workflows the most efficient

Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end-to-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance

Catastrophe and Risk Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to catastrophic events.

Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing,relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement

Life Insurance Solutions – offers end-to-end, data insight-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group.

Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger

Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.

Verisk invests in a benefits package for all employees that includes the following: Health Insurance, a Retirement Plan, Disability benefits, and a Paid Time Off program. We offer a competitive total rewards package that includes base salary determined based on role, experience, skill set, and location.

All members of the Verisk Analytics family of companies are equal opportunity employers. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, veteran's status, age or disability. rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Construction Operations Analyst plays a pivotal role in Suffolk’s Mission Control model—our transformational, analytics-driven strategy to drive project excellence across cost, schedule and safety. This role combines construction operations, data analytics, and technology to identify emerging project risks, translate data into actionable insights, and support timely intervention across the portfolio. The Analyst will work closely with senior leadership, project teams, functional groups, and the Data team to turn complex project data into clear, practical actions.

This is a high-growth opportunity for someone who understands construction, is curious about data and technology, and wants to directly influence project outcomes.

Responsibilities

 Monitor and analyze portfolio performance to identify early indicators of project risk across the project lifecycle, from preconstruction through closeout.  Analyze cost, schedule, and safety trends to develop performance and predictive insights using project data, benchmarks, and technology tools.  Support Mission Control through leading-indicator dashboards, analytics, and executive reporting.  Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for Project Managers, Superintendents, and senior leadership.  Collaborate with the Data and Operations teams to develop and deploy predictive analytics and construction technology solutions, including Tripwire 2.0, Schedule and Financial Analytics, and other emerging tools.  Participate in onsite project reviews and deep dives to connect data-driven insights with field conditions and project execution.  Continuously identify opportunities to improve how Suffolk uses data, analytics, and technology to manage project risk and performance. 

 FY27-FY28 Key Initiatives You’ll Support 

 Mission Critical Risk & Metrics Development: Partner with Mission Critical leadership and the Data team to develop, validate, and implement metrics that identify early indicators of risk and enable proactive intervention across the data center portfolio.  Predictive Analytics & Technology: Collaborate with the Data team to build foundational capabilities for Suffolk’s predictive and prescriptive analytics framework, including dynamic dashboards and enterprise-level reporting.  Executive Reporting Modernization: Assess and reimagine Suffolk’s executive reporting portfolio to streamline reporting, improve data flow and insights, and establish a scalable future-state model. Partner with Regional Operations and Data teams to implement the future state, including opportunities to leverage AI for executive insights and action tracking. 


Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Civil Engineering, Data Analytics, Finance/Accounting, or related discipline.  2–4 years of professional experience, preferably in construction operations, project controls, or data center construction.  Construction experience in roles such as Project Engineer, Project Manager, Superintendent, or Project Controls is preferred.  Experience with Procore, Primavera P6, and Oracle; strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.  Working Knowledge on SQL, Power BI or Tableau is a plus.  Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive-level insights.  Strong interest in predictive analytics, AI, construction technology, and data-driven decision-making  Willingness to learn and adopt emerging construction technology, including SmartPM, Schedule Validator, ALICE, and Vena.  Strong interpersonal skills and cross-functional collaboration experience; able to work with national and regional teams.  Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with flexibility to work long hours as needed. 

 Working Conditions

The employee is frequently required to stands; walk; and reach with arms and/or hands. Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. The employee will spend their time in an office environment with a quiet to moderate noise level. Job site walking.

Suffolk offers a comprehensive benefits package as part of its overall total rewards strategy. Salary ranges are reviewed regularly to reflect market trends.

About Suffolk

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment (Suffolk Technologies). By integrating data, artificial intelligence, and advanced technology through our Seamless Platform, we connect design, construction, and operations to deliver smarter, more predictable results and redefine how America builds.

Professional experience with building advanced AI workflows, MCPs, agent swarms etc…

You'll be working with extensive proprietary datasets and building systems that directly impact investment decisions in breakthrough medical and climate technologies. Success in this role means creating AI systems that help fund innovations that can extend and improve human lives.

Dr. Vokler Hovestadt is hiring a Postdoctoral Research Fellow- Biostatistics/Machine Learning for his lab!

The Hovestadt Lab in the Department of Pediatric Oncology at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (https://hovestadtlab.github.io, affiliations with Boston Children’s Hospital and the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard) is seeking a highly motivated computational postdoctoral research fellow. Our lab studies childhood brain tumors and leukemias, two of the most common cancers in children. We aim to better understand tumor biology using cutting-edge experimental and computational approaches. Translational goals of our research include the development of more accurate patient classification systems and novel treatment strategies.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Requirements

The postdoctoral fellow will apply modern AI techniques to accurately predict clinical outcomes and provide treatment recommendations for children with cancer. Towards this goal, the postdoc will work with large genomic datasets derived from thousands of patients. The project provides ample opportunity to advance scientific skills and to collaborate with world renowned experts in the fields of childhood brain tumor research and epigenomics. Candidates need to be passionate about cancer research and intrinsically motivated. Creativity and innovative/independent thinking are a must.

Qualifications

 A PhD in Computational Biology, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or related discipline Strong interest in working with large biomedical/genomic datasets Experience in developing/applying modern AI approaches Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with scientists from other disciplines Good oral and written communication skills An outstanding academic track record

rows.title: PhD Applied Scientist, Routing
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe{{:}} Summer (May-Aug 2027)

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

What We Need

Symbotic is looking for an applied scientist intern with a passion for multi-agent planning to improve the performance and reliability of our systems as we rapidly scale our product and organization. The Robot Routing team plans highly efficient, collision-free paths between the storage structure and the inbound/outbound cells of our system for dozens of robots traversing the transfer deck. The right candidate is excited about concepts like deadlock resolution and time-space reservations. This is a hybrid position based at our headquarters in Wilmington, MA.

What You’ll Do

Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics software. Adapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems. Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms. Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues. 

What You’ll Need

Pursuing PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages{{:}} C++, Python, Java, or C#. Strong research background in combinatorial optimization, Robotics planning, multi-robot systems, or machine learning. Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) on some of the aforementioned topics. 

About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information.

rows.descriptionText:
Dr. Vokler Hovestadt is hiring a Postdoctoral Research Fellow- Biostatistics/Machine Learning for his lab!

The Hovestadt Lab in the Department of Pediatric Oncology at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (https://hovestadtlab.github.io, affiliations with Boston Children’s Hospital and the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard) is seeking a highly motivated computational postdoctoral research fellow. Our lab studies childhood brain tumors and leukemias, two of the most common cancers in children. We aim to better understand tumor biology using cutting-edge experimental and computational approaches. Translational goals of our research include the development of more accurate patient classification systems and novel treatment strategies.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Requirements

The postdoctoral fellow will apply modern AI techniques to accurately predict clinical outcomes and provide treatment recommendations for children with cancer. Towards this goal, the postdoc will work with large genomic datasets derived from thousands of patients. The project provides ample opportunity to advance scientific skills and to collaborate with world renowned experts in the fields of childhood brain tumor research and epigenomics. Candidates need to be passionate about cancer research and intrinsically motivated. Creativity and innovative/independent thinking are a must.

Qualifications

 A PhD in Computational Biology, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or related discipline Strong interest in working with large biomedical/genomic datasets Experience in developing/applying modern AI approaches Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with scientists from other disciplines Good oral and written communication skills An outstanding academic track record

Interested applicants must apply to the position and send a cover letter with their CV to James McLean (JamesA_McLean@dfci.harvard.edu). Letters of support will be asked for later.

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. As relentless as we are in our mission to reduce the burden of cancer for all, we are committed to having faculty and staff who offer multifaceted experiences. Cancer knows no boundaries and when it comes to hiring the most dedicated and compassionate professionals, neither do we. The candidate will ideally have masters level training in bioinformatics and be familiar with computation of the most common types of genomics data (bulk RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, single nucleus RNAseq etc…) and will be expected to apply this knowledge for calculations on the lab's experimental data.

Required Skills

This position requires a master's and experience in bioinformatics, biostatistics, or a related field. Requires 1 to 3 years' experience.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, natural or protective hairstyle, religion, sex, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military service, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, or because of marital, parental, or veteran status. We are a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.

How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us.

Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.

Overview of Role: 

We are actively looking for a Data Scientist to join L.E.K.’s rapidly growing DDA (Data, Digital, and AI) practice. This role sits within our Data Science & Engineering team and operates at the intersection of advanced analytics, machine learning and applied AI, building the models, applications and analytical products that power client engagements and L.E.K.'s proprietary IP.

rows.title: PhD Applied Scientist, Routing
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe{{:}} Summer (May-Aug 2027)

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

What We Need

Symbotic is looking for an applied scientist intern with a passion for multi-agent planning to improve the performance and reliability of our systems as we rapidly scale our product and organization. The Robot Routing team plans highly efficient, collision-free paths between the storage structure and the inbound/outbound cells of our system for dozens of robots traversing the transfer deck. The right candidate is excited about concepts like deadlock resolution and time-space reservations. This is a hybrid position based at our headquarters in Wilmington, MA.

What You’ll Do

Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics software. Adapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems. Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms. Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues. 

What You’ll Need

Pursuing PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages{{:}} C++, Python, Java, or C#. Strong research background in combinatorial optimization, Robotics planning, multi-robot systems, or machine learning. Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) on some of the aforementioned topics. 

About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information.

The base range for this position in the posted location is $52.00 - $54.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

HHMI is focused on supporting and moving science forward in a variety of different ways ranging from conducting basic biomedical research, empowering educators, inspiring students, developing the next generation of scientists – even stretching into film and media production. Education

Ph.D. degree in a scientific field or MD degree

Skills And Abilities

Ability to review goals, analyze processes vital to achieve those goals, and develop techniques and systems required to meet those goals. Often explores new areas and seeks opportunities to apply new knowledge to work.

The position requires mobility, including the ability to move materials weighing up to several pounds (such as a laptop computer or tablet).

Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this position with reasonable accommodation. Requests for reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis.

This job description sets forth the job’s principal duties, responsibilities, and requirements; it should not be construed as an exhaustive statement, however. Unless they begin with the word “may,” the Essential Duties and Responsibilities described above are “essential functions” of the job, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.
