rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Do you have demonstrated machine learning experience and want to apply that experience to solving a wide variety of complex problems in this rapidly evolving field?

Do you thrive in a collaborative research environment, working alongside an energetic, multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers?

Are you ready to help the US secure and maintain leadership in the development and deployment of AI/ML algorithms for non-kinetic defense systems?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer who will contribute to all phases of the machine learning algorithm development and implementation. You will be joining a team of engineers and scientists who are at the forefront of APL's mission to provide innovative solutions to critical challenges.

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will...

Design, implement, and evaluate advanced machine learning algorithms to solve challenging real-world planning, perception, coordination, and control problems in support of national defense. Develop software pipelines to integrate data streams, simulation environments, and intelligent decision-making algorithms.Work with technologies and concepts at the cutting edge of AI, including but not limited to: deep reinforcement learning, foundation models, large language models, convolutional/recurrent/graph neural networks, computer vision, and physics-based modeling and simulation tools. Collaborate closely with the talented team of scientists and engineers in our group and with others across APL.Engage directly with sponsors to communicate proposed concepts, solutions, and analysis.

Qualifications

You meet the minimum requirements for the job if you...

Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.Have at least 2+ years of experience in machine learning and data science fields.Have at least one year of hands-on experience applying/developing machine learning algorithms using common libraries such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.Have strong foundational knowledge in at least two of the following: classification, clustering, deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision (object detection and visual tracking), multi-agent systems, or optimization/control theory.Have demonstrated experience in working with version control software like Git.Have strong, effective communication skills both verbal and written.Are able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You 'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

Have an MS in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.Have 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing AI/ML algorithms for a variety of datasets.Have proven experience applying state-of-the-art deep learning techniques to solve distributed resource allocation problems.Have hands-on experience building computer vision pipelines for detection, tracking, segmentation, or multi-modal sensor fusion.Have experience with modeling and simulation platforms such as AFSIM, Blender, Unity, or Unreal.Are comfortable working in high performance computing environments (GPU/CPU clusters).Have proficiency in one or more of the following technology areas: multi-agent reinforcement learning, geometric deep learning, multi-modal sensor fusion, agentic AI.Have a track record of writing deployable, production-level code (Python, C/C++) for real-world applications.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

AI Foundations Specialist Models Data Science team builds and ships state of the art scalable architecture, AI/ML solutions for Capital One’s award-winning mobile app. We partner with product, tech and design teams to deliver app features that delight customers with dynamic and personalized experiences, enable them to chat with Capital One’s digital assistant Eno, or search for useful contents. You will be the driving force to experiment, innovate and create next generation experiences powered by the latest emerging generative AI technologies.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI powered products that change how customers interact with their money. Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Hugging Face, LangChain, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. Be the expert in Natural Language Processing (NLP) to harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs), adapt and finetune them for customer facing applications and features. Build machine learning and NLP models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, and validation; partnering with engineering teams to operationalize them in scalable and resilient production systems that serve 80+ million customers. Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. 

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with advanced ML and DL technologies including language models and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience working with LLMs and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Influential. You are passionate about AI/ML and can bring along a cross functional team in breakthrough innovations. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences. You are experienced in training language models or large computer vision models as well as have expertise in one or more key subdomains such as: training optimization, self-supervised learning, explainability, RLHF. You have an engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in training data and inference volumes. You have experience in delivering libraries, platforms, or solution level code to existing products. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)Experience working with AWSAt least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or RAt least 4 years’ experience with machine learningAt least 4 years’ experience with SQL

rows.title: Generative AI Applications Engineer (Agents & RAG)
rows.descriptionText:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Build AI that matters. We ship production GenAI apps for confidential federal programs across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health where reliability, privacy, and safety aren’t optional. AFS is a technology company within global Accenture and a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work. You’ll join a collaborative, inclusive community with handson growth, certifications, and industry training. We ship in weeks, not quarters, and measure success with latency, reliability, safety, and cost.

Confidentiality matters: We don’t disclose program details publicly. If you advance, we’ll share specifics during the process.

Role Overview

You’ll turn mission needs into secure, reliable, and scalable GenAI applications no model training required. This is a hands-on role across agentic workflows, RAG, prompt/policy design, LLM evaluation, and platform integration. You’ll own the end-to-end path from use case evaluation → production deployment → operational excellence, partnering with product, security, data, and SRE to ship features safely and at scale.

What You’ll Do (Day To Day)

Design & ship mission grade GenAI: Build agentic workflows and RAG systems tailored to mission data and environments; target low hallucination, tight p95 latency, and predictable cost. Agent frameworks & orchestration: Apply patterns from LangChain/LlamaIndex/Semantic Kernel; design task decomposition, tool use, guardrails, and recovery/fallback strategies. Platform integration (no model training): Implement with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Kendra, and managed services (e.g., Document AI, Gemini, Gemma). LLM selection & evaluation: Compare models for quality, safety, latency, cost; author/test prompts & policies; deploy with observability and safe rollback/fallback. RAG done right: Build retrieval pipelines & vector search (Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, pgvector, FAISS/Chroma); handle data prep, chunking, metadata, and IRstyle evals (e.g., NDCG) to maximize signal to noise. Production rigor: Instrument metrics/logs/traces; run A/B experiments; maintain incident playbooks; and implement safety & compliance guardrails. SRE & FinOps for AI: Define SLIs/SLOs (quality/latency/safety/cost), run on call and postmortems, reduce MTTR; meter usage and optimize token/spend. Reusable platform components: Ship SDKs, CI/CD templates, Terraform/IaC modules, evaluation harnesses that accelerate multiple mission team not one-off projects. Operate in real world constraints: Deliver into hybrid, restricted, or air gapped environments with Zero Trust principles and audit ready controls. 

You'll Thrive Here If you have

Built and deployed a production GenAI application (chatbot, copilot, assistant, or enterprise AI). Hands-on with LLMs GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Mistral, via APIs or self-hosted. Designed and implemented RAG solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search for enterprise or mission data. Shipped AI applications with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, DSPy, or similar. Strong Python development for building and integrating AI/ML applications. Owned AI solutions through full production life cycle, deployment and operational support. Active U.S. citizenship. 

Nice to Have

Integration with leading cloud AI services or on prem inference stacks Background in LLM evaluation, prompt authoring/testing, A/B experimentation, and LLM Ops. Responsible AI expertise (privacy, security, bias, transparency, human in the loop) and data governance. Experience implementing tool using agents for API integration and external data access. Containerization & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, VMware) and scripting/automation (Linux Bash, PowerShell). Prior work in regulated/secure environments (e.g., ATO, STIGs, Zero Trust) with fast shipping. Familiarity with NVIDIA AI Foundations, OpenAI ChatGPT, and AI assisted dev tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude). Contributions to internal frameworks or opensource; mentorship of engineers. Clear communication with engineers, PMs, and security/compliance stakeholders.

rows.title: Marketing and Campaign Manager - Star Pubs
rows.descriptionText:
Marketing and Campaigns ManagerFunction: Star PubsLocation: Field Based (UK-wide travel for meetings)Salary: Circa £35,000 base depending on experience, plus full benefits listed below.Contract: 12 Month Fixed Term Contract
Closing Date: Monday 5th October 2026. Please note, we may close vacancies early where we receive significant numbers of applications.
Did you know HEINEKEN owns more than 2,400 pubs across the UK? We believe great pubs play an important role in British culture and in the communities they serve. Through Star Pubs, we work with our lessees to help them build successful businesses, giving them the support, tools and investment they need to make the most of their pubs.
That takes great people behind the scenes too.
We're looking for a Marketer to join our Star Pubs Licensee Attraction Marketing Team on a fixed-term contract. You'll help us attract the right people to our pubs and bring the Star Pubs opportunity to life for potential lessees.
If you're looking for your next marketing opportunity and fancy doing something a little different, we'd love to hear from you.
The RoleA key focus for the Licensee Attraction Team is to attract, proactively recruit, and appoint the best licensees and pub operators. We need to stand out. We need to reach a broader demographic with our communications in a very competitive marketplace. As one of our Marketing and Campaigns Managers, you’ll work with the Star Pubs Attraction Marketing Manager to be the lead technical expert on all things digital, social and content regarding pub operator attraction.
You’ll deliver the regional marketing strategy to attract licensees to our vacant pubs. You’ll be the first point of contact for the team of Licensee Attraction Managers to build and execute a recruitment plan for their regions. You’ll also be a product owner of the pub website listings, email marketing system and take the lead on collating and analysing our customer experience measurement and insights.
The CandidateWe’re looking for someone who has experience with creating compelling creative assets using Canva, Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop, and PremierPro, or briefing our creative agencies and bringing to life on our external channels (to let boards and banners, POS flyers for pub vacancies and open day advertising material, social and digital ads and marketing e-shots) why pub operators should take a pub agreement with Star Pubs.
Experience in managing website listings, email marketing systems, digital platforms and social media channels will be preferred as you’ll be responsible for ensuring a consistent look, feel and tone of voice across our external communication platforms. You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Licensee Attraction Team to develop stand-out adverts for vacancies and events as well as create digital content to support campaigns.
It’d be a real asset if you have a strong appreciation (or love) for data, knowing that the success of what you do needs to be measured and you’ll be able to pull on experience of utilising data analytic tools to assess the performance of campaigns and engagement. You’ll have money to spend on campaigns and you’ll need to utilise your analytical skills to demonstrate the ROI.
Our BenefitsAs part of the team, along with your salary, you'll also receive:Company funded Private Medical HealthcareAnnual BonusDouble matched pension (up to 10%)35 days holiday (pro rata)Flexible benefits, including a retail discounts platformA quarterly allowance towards purchasing our delicious ciders and beers (low and no alcohol options available)
You'll also have the opportunity to get involved with one of our colleague networks, where colleagues from across the business work together to help ensure we're building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
The applicationIf you like what you've read and you're ready to brew a better career with us, we'd love to hear from you.
We may close vacancies early if we receive a high volume of applications, so don't delay.
If you need any adjustments to support your application, for example if you require information in a different format or have any accessibility requirements, we're happy to help. Please get in touch with us at recruitment@heineken.co.uk.
Who We AreStar Pubs is part of HEINEKEN UK. Headquartered in Edinburgh, Star Pubs has 230 pubs in Scotland, the vast majority of which are leased out to small businesses and entrepreneurs.
Across the whole of the UK, Star has 2,400 pubs and around 200 of these operate on our Just Add Talent model (a managed operator agreement). Our ambition is to bring out the best in local pubs by attracting and retaining the best licensees and by providing them with market-leading insight and support.
There's no better place to untap your future. Join us and brew a better career.

rows.descriptionText:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Supply

Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen. If you're looking for a career in supply chain, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. You could join our Global Supply Planning team to develop and implement our global supply strategy, or work with our Procurement Centre of Excellence team to negotiate and manage our supplier relationships. Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Product Analyst/Global Business Process Owner - Manufacturing Data Platform to strengthen our Digital Manufacturing team and ensure that our digital solutions are built on a coherent, scalable and connected data foundation. This role sits at the intersection of manufacturing, data, and digital platforms, with a strong focus on connecting systems, defining data structures, and enabling data‑driven decision-making across our global factory network. The role is critical in ensuring that Digital Manufacturing initiatives translate into consistent, reliable, and scalable solutions — enabling better operational decisions at site level.

Your responsibilities

 Data Integration & System UnderstandingMap and understand end‑to‑end data flows across: shopfloor systems (PLCs, SCADA), MES and operational systems, ERP (e.g. SAP), data platforms (e.g. Siemens on AWS)Define and document: master systems vs. slave systems, data ownership and responsibilities, points of inconsistency or redundancy  Data Architecture & Platform EnablementSupport the design of practical, scalable data architectureEnsure alignment between: operational systems, cloud platforms, analytics environmentsWork closely with IT to ensure that solutions are: technically robust, aligned with business needs  Connectivity & Data StandardsDefine and enforce: data connectivity standards, data ingestion logic, naming conventions and structuring principlesEnsure consistency across sites and use casesSupport integration into the Siemens data platform (AWS) environment  Support Digital Use Case DeliveryTranslate business use cases (e.g. performance management, predictive maintenance) into: data requirements, data models, system dependenciesWork closely with: Digital Product Owners, site teams, IT&D  Transparency & Governance SupportProvide visibility on: data dependencies, readiness and gaps, risks related to data availabilitySupport the PMO with: structured inputs, data-related decision supportHelp ensure a single, consistent data logic across the programme

The experience we're looking for 

2–5 years experience in:manufacturing / CPG environmentdata analytics / data engineering / industrial dataExposure to:supply chain processes (basic understanding)digital or IT-enabled manufacturing environmentsExperience with data platforms (e.g. Siemens, Azure, AWS) is a plus

The skills for success 

Degree in: Engineering, Data Science, Industrial IT or a related fieldBasic to solid proficiency in:SQL, Python (or similar)data modellingdata pipelines / APIsUnderstanding of:cloud environments (AWS desirable)industrial systems (MES / SCADA / PLC concepts)System thinking: ability to connect data across systems and processesStructured approach: translates complexity into clear, usable modelsPragmatism: focuses on practical solutions, not theoryCommunication: able to interact with:factory teamsIT architectsbusiness stakeholdersCuriosity & ownership mindset: strong drive to understand “how things really work”

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

Who We Are

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. rows.title: Analyst Digital Marketing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. Experience with social listening, social intelligence, and/or social analytics tools, such as Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similarFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening / GEO / AEO space and the associated insights toolsBasic knowledge of coding languages or developer toolsExperience or familiarity with advanced analytics, including media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, statistical analysis, lifetime value analysis, and sales impact studiesFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shifts 
Salary: $80,029.77 to $100,585.35 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1-800-321-6467.

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Title: Director of Global Statistics

Location: Piscataway 

Travel: As needed ~10%

 The Role:

The primary function of CP R&D is to develop new and innovative products. To this end, our scientists must make important decisions based on limited data and considerable uncertainty. As a leader of CP Statistics, you will ensure that our organization and scientists are equipped and skilled to make better data-based decisions in the face of this uncertainty. You will achieve this through direct one-on-one collaboration, strategic capability development and training. Your vision, leadership, and analytical expertise will help sustain our pipeline of innovative products and ensure that CP continues to retain its well-earned reputation as an innovation leader in the CPG industry.

Responsibilities:

Promote application of Statistical Thinking and Design of Experiments (DOE) to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of product development processProvide one-on-one project-specific consulting on DOE design, analysis, and interpretationSupport automation of core routine statistical tasks (eg DOE, stability analysis, process capability) into enterprise applications Provide pre-clinical guidance on clinical study design, power, and statistical analysis plan (SAP) for study protocolsConduct post-clinical data analysis and help investigators with interpretation, claim support, and publication Provide analysis of accelerated stability data to substantiate product shelf life declarations for new product registrationWork with plant-based Quality teams to increase the effectiveness of our process capability and Six Sigma continuous improvement programsProvide statistical support/POV to address issues raised by Regulatory bodies (eg, FDA audits, FTC/NAD claim challenges, etc)Work with R&D leaders to identify and rectify capability gaps (eg, Sensory methods, stability analysis, Six Sigma) Use appropriate statistical design and validation tools to assess and improve measurement system accuracy and precisionManage, administer, and foster development of direct reportsManage and administrator commercial statistical software applications (eg, SAS, JMP, Minitab, DesignExpert)

Required Qualifications:

A minimum of a Master's Degree or higher in Industrial Statistics, Biostatistics, or related field is required10+ years of expereince in a consumer products industry, pharmaceutical, biotech, or related industryDemonstrated expertise in application of DOE in consumer product R&DDemonstrated expertise in clinical design and biostatistical analysisStatistical software skills (SAS, JMP, Minitab, DesignExpert, R, Python) Enterprise software skills (SQL, AWS, LIMs, etc)

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters DegreeBackground in stability testing methods, accelerated data analysis and Arrhenius modelingBackground in sensory science, consumer/expert panel testing, and analysis methodsPrior experience working with regulatory bodies (eg FDA, FTC/NAD) Prior experience in method development design and validationFamiliarity with manufacturing quality control metrics and tools (eg process capability, sampling plans, Six Sigma DMAIC)Excellent communication skills (written and oral)Enthusiasm and passion for teaching/raising awareness of utility of statisticsExcellent consulting/collaboration skillsFamiliarity with tools and methods used in omics data analysis (i.e. genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics)

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $200,000.00 - $230,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

rows.title: Post Doctoral Research Scientist-Research & Innovation ( Biological Sciences)
rows.descriptionText:
No Relocation Assistance Offered

Job Number #176034 - Piscataway, New Jersey, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary:

This Post Doctoral Research Scientist role focuses exclusively on understanding oxidative stress pathways and sensory responses in human oral mucosa triggered by oral care products. Your research will focus on developing in vitro and ex vivo models to study reactive oxygen species (ROS) associated pathways on oral mucosal and neuron-like cells. You will establish key biomarkers on oxidative stress related cytotoxicity. You will lead early-stage research programs that guide cross-functional teams in formulating safer, next-generation oral care products.

Responsibilities:

Discovery & Mechanistic Research

Scientific Discovery: Execute in vitro and ex vivo studies to evaluate oxidative stress induction and neuronal activation in oral tissue models exposed to novel formulations. Mechanistic Cellular Pathology: Investigate cellular signaling cascades linked to oxidative stress and neurogenic sensory responses . Biomarker Identification: Utilize -omics platforms to identify salivary and biological markers specific to oxidative markers and cytotoxicity. Protocol Design: Standardize testing protocols for screening active ingredients based on redox balance and neuronal reactivity. Technical Reporting: Translate oxidative and neuro-response dataset findings into guidelines for product development teams. 

Cross-Functional Innovation Strategy

Interdepartmental Partnership: Communicate mechanistic findings on oxidative stress and neuro-activation to Safety, Regulatory, and R&D leadership. Legal & IP Strategy: Work with Legal/IP to secure patent protection for novel models or formulations mitigating oxidative and neurological stress. 

Laboratory Excellence & Data Science

Lab Models: Establish high-throughput oxidative assay screening systems. Protocol Development: Standardize testing methods for quantifying ROS generation and neuronal responses. Advanced Analytics: Leverage bioinformatics tools to analyze gene expression changes in oxidative and neuro response pathways. 

Required Qualifications:

PhD in Oral Biology, Toxicology Oral Immunology, or a related fieldResearch experience in one or more of the following areas:Oral Mucosal Irritation Expertise: Deep understanding of irritation on oral soft tissues and mechanism of action of compounds inducing oral ulceration . Oral Immunology Expertise: Understanding of oral immunology, specifically the mechanisms of allergic sensitization and the inflammatory cascades leading to mucosal ulceration. Biomarker Validation: Experience in identifying, quantifying, and validating biological markers from biosamples such as saliva and blood. Bio-informatics: Data analysis and developing computable prediction models. 
Preferred Qualifications:

Toxicology and Immunology: Hands-on experience. Risk Assessment & Safety Evaluation: Database knowledge and computational predictionRegulatory Knowledge: Safety databases, status of common oral care ingredients.

Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES

Job Description

About Us

At P&G, we are innovators, leaders, and brand builders. Our iconic Skin Care brands are trusted in millions of homes worldwide. We are committed to delighting consumers through superior product experiences and compelling storytelling, building brands that improve everyday life. We believe in the power of authentic conversation, deep connection, and vibrant community to foster enduring brand love. When you join P&G, you make an impact from day one, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

The Opportunity

Are you a visionary marketing leader with a proven track record in sparking conversations, cultivating communities, and driving organic relevance for beloved brands? Do you thrive on translating brand objectives into powerful social experiences and measurable business impact within the dynamic Skin Care category?

We are seeking a highly strategic and execution-focused Director, Social Strategy & Organic Growth - Skin Care to orchestrate brand talkability and sustainable organic relevance growth for our leading Skin Care portfolio. In this pivotal role, you will define the strategy, lead the planning, and oversee the execution, learning, and optimization of social-first ideas, innovative content, and high-impact partnerships. You will be at the forefront of translating deep consumer insights, culture, and trends into compelling social moments, both online and through unique experiential activations that resonate with our consumers and amplify our presence at key retailer moments. This role demands a sophisticated blend of creative vision, analytical rigor, and exceptional cross-functional leadership, working hand-in-hand with Brand Marketing, Media, and Communications teams to ensure cohesive, impactful, and globally relevant brand narratives.

Your Responsibilities

 Orchestrate Brand Talkability & Organic Relevance Growth for Skin Care: Develop and lead the overarching strategy for driving organic brand conversation, share of voice, and community engagement across relevant social platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, emerging platforms). This includes creating a calendar of Brand Idea-led social tentpoles, orchestrating across branded assets, celebrity, influencer and other external partnerships, experiential executions, and user-generated content. The ultimate goal is to grow brand relevance and earned media value, translating into increased glance views, improved conversion rates, and sales growth. Design and implement repeatable "social flywheel" systems and frameworks that transform content, community, employees, and consumers into powerful brand advocates, fostering authentic connections within the Skin Care community. Lead Social-First Content Strategy & Innovation: Own the editorial vision and content framework for Skin Care, guiding the creation of compelling brand-led and creator-generated content optimized for social platforms to encourage comments, shares, and user-generated content, reflecting unique Skin Care consumer needs and trends. Leverage cutting-edge AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate content ideation, creation, repurposing, and testing, identifying viral content patterns and building scalable playbooks that resonate with beauty and skin care enthusiasts. Build & Nurture Influencer & Partnership Ecosystems: Identify, onboard, and manage strategic influencer, creator, and ambassador programs that authentically amplify Skin Care brand messaging and extend reach, targeting relevant beauty and lifestyle communities. Foster meaningful engagement and community participation, developing systems that convert followers into active brand advocates and co-creators within the Skin Care space. Drive Experiential & Retailer Activation Integration: Conceptualize and execute social strategies that seamlessly integrate with experiential activations, maximizing their talkability and digital footprint within the beauty landscape. Partner closely with Brand Marketing and Sales teams to amplify Skin Care brand presence around key retailer tentpoles and promotional events through bespoke social campaigns and compelling content strategies. Measure Impact & Optimize Performance: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as organic reach, engagement rate, audience growth, brand sentiment, referral traffic, and contribution to marketing-qualified leads/sales pipeline specifically for Skin Care. Establish an experimentation roadmap for content formats, posting strategies, AI workflows, and engagement tactics, driving continuous optimization based on data-driven insights and market trends. Lead & Influence Cross-Functionally: Collaborate extensively with Brand Marketing, Media, Communications, Product Development, and Sales teams to ensure integrated campaigns and amplified messaging for Skin Care brands. Present insights, strategies, and recommendations to senior leadership, acting as a thought leader in social media, organic growth, and the evolving beauty landscape.

What We Offer You

Meaningful Work from Day 1: Lead organic growth for iconic, global Skin Care brands that truly impact consumers' lives.Continuous Growth & Development: Access to world-class learning and development opportunities, a robust career path, and the chance to expand your skills and expertise within the beauty industry.Dynamic & Collaborative Culture: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment where innovation, leadership, and integrity are highly valued, collaborating with top talent globally.Competitive Compensation & Benefits: A comprehensive package designed to support your overall well-being.

Job Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree or higher.7-10+ years of progressive experience in social media marketing, content strategy, growth marketing, or community leadership, with significant experience in the Beauty, Personal Care, or Consumer Goods sector, ideally Skin Care.Proven track record of significantly growing organic audiences, engagement, and brand talkability across diverse social platforms for major brands.Hands-on experience in the orchestration between different aspects of the social flywheel (branded assets, influencer, social media, experiential).Demonstrated experience in building and scaling creator, influencer, and/or employee advocacy programs within the beauty industry.Deep understanding of social platform algorithms, content distribution best practices, and emerging social trends relevant to Skin Care consumers.Exceptional strategic thinking, complex project management, and execution capabilities.Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse stakeholders, including executive leadership.Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate organizational structures and foster partnerships.

Preferred:

Experience with integrated marketing campaigns involving large-scale experiential activations and complex retailer partnerships.Experience leveraging AI tools and advanced analytics platforms to inform strategy and optimize performance.In-depth familiarity with the creator economy and modern creator business models within the beauty space.Passion for consumer insights and the ability to translate them into highly effective, culturally relevant social strategies for Skin Care.Strong personal brand or demonstrable track record of thought leadership in social media/beauty marketing.

Just so you know:

At P&G, we believe that diverse experiences help build strong leaders. Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. Candidates should be prepared to consider relocation opportunities throughout their career as business needs and development opportunities arise.

Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

The Senior Accountant of Internal Reporting will have hands-on involvement in the monthly close process, including responsibilities over the consolidation of all financial data of the Company. The Senior Accountant will assist in producing management reports that reflect the Company’s internal financial statements on a monthly basis, as well as consolidated financial statements for quarterly SEC reporting.

The Senior Accountant will liaise with various departments worldwide, including FP&A, Investor Relations, Shared Services (aka Record-to-Report or “R2R”), Global Management Reporting, Master Data, Treasury, Tax, and Internal Audit, as well as the Company’s external auditors.

,

 Assist in preparing the consolidated financial statements including the Company’s Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, and Equity Statement Assist in preparing customized management reporting, financial analyses, and business insights that support executive decision-making and strategic initiatives Responsible for fiscal month-end exchange rates for the divisions and data consolidation Review intercompany balances and ensure proper elimination Prepare schedules for the quarterly Management Information Book and distribute to executive management and Investor Relations Assist in the preparation and aggregation of the Company’s key external disclosures within SEC filings on Forms 10-K and 10-Q Maintain and distribute divisional financial reporting packages Assist in maintaining and overseeing the global consolidated chart of accounts within RL’s consolidation system, Financial Consolidation & Close (“FCC”) Prepare various ad hoc reports, analyses, and projects as requested by senior management Participate in process improvement, automation, and systems-related initiatives, including the use of AI-enabled technologies and data analytics tools, to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of financial reporting and close processes

,

 Bachelor's Degree in Accounting Strong organizational/multi-tasking and communications skills, both oral and written Strong attention to detail Private accounting experience or a combination of public/private accounting experience Proficiency in MS office (Word & Excel) Experience working in a complex, multi-national organization a plus Consolidations experience a plus Experience with financial consolidation, close management, and ERP platforms, including FCC/FCCS, SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting, or similar systems Demonstrated ability to leverage automation, analytics, AI, and reporting tools to streamline close activities, improve data quality, and enhance reporting processes

rows.title: Senior Specialist, US Retirement
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Position Summary

In this role, you will manage a range of operational activities that support the accuracy, compliance, and overall effectiveness of our defined benefit pension plans. You will serve as the initial escalation for HR partners and Vendors, responding to inquiries, resolving routine to moderately complex issues, and ensuring timely, compliant execution of plan processes. Working both independently and collaboratively, you will support operations, identify and troubleshoot issues, and actively contribute to process improvements and operational enhancements.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

Owns data quality for assigned pension processes, leading ongoing data reviews, preventative HRIS audits, and investigation of daily import errors to resolve issues and prevent recurrence.Serves as Tier 2 escalation point for pension mailbox and retiree payroll matters to ensure accurate outcomes and guide appropriate resolution paths for complex issues.Accountable for execution of assigned pension controls and compliance activities (examples: TERP termination, QPSA communications) to identify issues or risks and partnering with stakeholders.Owns resolution of escalated cases from Vendor, including resolving calculation or plan questions, death escalations (with Savings) and overpayment/over-limit cases.Performs and validates Hours and Pay calculations and process system updates as required by Plan requirements.Acts as the point of contact for key processes which include legal requests (subpoenas), year-end activities (W2s, annualized local values, international transfers).Participate in UAT testing, process reviews/documentation, and project support leveraging operational expertise to influence changes and reduce risk.Collaborate with colleagues on calls and cross-functional initiatives.Identifies, documents, and implements improvements within assigned pension processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.Collaborate on special projects and other pension activities as required.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Experience

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

5+ years of professional experience in retirement plan administration, benefits, HR, or related field.

Competencies

Experience with defined benefit pension administration, calculations & plan document interpretation and exposure to HRIS/Payroll or other data-intensive systems.Proficiency with Excel for trend analysis, reconciliations, and exception reporting, including vlookups, formulas, and pivot tables.Demonstrated experience improving a business process using data (e.g., reducing error rates, cycle time, or manual touchpoints).Hands-on experience performing root-cause analysis and implementing corrective/preventive actions.Ability to interpret technical specifications or data interface documentation and validate business rules against real data.Ability to work independently and as part of a team; commitment to confidentiality.

Skills & Capabilities

Process improvement mindset.Data analytics orientation & ability to review and manipulate large datasets.Control design & risk awareness to proactively identify control gaps.Ability to collaborate and knowledge sharing.Customer service orientation and adaptability to change.Operational Influence as it relates to building alignment across cross-functional partners & Vendors.Technical fluency as it relates to data mapping, integration rules, calculation and file specs etc.Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications

SAP/SuccessFactors experience preferred.Experience designing or operating business controls (SOX/internal control environment, audit readiness, or data quality controls).Familiarity with ERISA, IRS, and DOL regulations.Experience with complex pension or payroll issues.Experience with user acceptance testing or implementing new HRIS/pension systems.Experience with ServiceNow or other applicable case management system.

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1-800-321-6467.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Review our applicant privacy notice before applying at https://www.nestlejobs.com/privacy.

Through impactful communications, distinctive brand identity, meaningful consumer engagement, and strong value propositions, you help shape how the brand shows up across the consumer journey. Consumer, Category & Customer (3C) Understanding:

Support the development of consumer, category, and competitive understanding to inform brand strategy, communications, and consumer experience plans. Execute campaign pre-testing, optimization, and learning plans to improve communications effectiveness and strengthen consumer engagement. Contribute to audience strategy, consumer portraits, and journey mapping to improve consumer engagement across touchpoints. Support in market campaign testing, optimization, and learning initiatives to enhance communications effectiveness and consumer impact. Track and synthesize creative and campaign performance metrics to inform future brand-building decisions. 

Brand Building Fundamentals:

Support the development of consumer, category, and competitive understanding to inform brand strategy, communications, and consumer experience plans. Execute campaign pre-testing, optimization, and learning plans to improve communications effectiveness and strengthen consumer engagement. Contribute to audience strategy, consumer portraits, and journey mapping to improve consumer engagement across touchpoints. Support in market campaign testing, optimization, and learning initiatives to enhance communications effectiveness and consumer impact. Track and synthesize creative and campaign performance metrics to inform future brand-building decisions. 

Unforgettable Communications & Agency Management

Execute campaign builds, brief development, creative activation plans, and promotions in alignment with defined brand strategy, ensuring connectivity and consistency across all consumer-facing touchpoints.Lead execution of marketing communications across channels, including PR, influencer, social, CRM, community management, and owned digital experiences, while supporting audience activation and organic content development through media performance across planning, measurement, analytics, and optimization.Partner with agencies of record to execute creative development and production, managing day-to-day workflows, timelines, deliverables, and cross-agency coordination to ensure alignment to briefs and business objectives.Execute content creation, asset production, deployment, and maintenance of brand platforms and websites, ensuring content is current, accurate, and aligned with brand standards.Partner with Product Experience (PX) for execution of new item support communications plans across channels.Develop, coordinate, and distribute key brand documents and communications materials (e.g., brand growth plans, campaign details, touchpoint inputs), ensuring alignment, completeness, and timely delivery across stakeholders.Support communications leadership through day-to-day coordination of activation plans, agency scope of work execution, exception requests, approvals, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment.

Job Title: Customer Development Manager – Walmart (L'Oréal Dermatological Beauty)

Division: L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB)

Reports To: VP Commercial Sales - Walmart

Location: Field – Bentonville, AR

Who We Are

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. Our goal is to offer each and every person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity.

At L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty, our mission is to help everyone in their quest for healthy and beautiful skin. Our division is the world leader in dermo-cosmetics by adding health to beauty. Our brands portfolio includes CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, Vichy, SkinCeuticals and Skinbetter Science offering a range of skincare and haircare products to respond to all expectations linked to beauty and health of the skin.

What You Will Learn

As a strategic thinker with a passion for the beauty industry and a desire to drive category growth, you will master the development and execution of our skincare category strategy across Walmart’s rapidly evolving omni-channel ecosystem. This role will empower you to leverage advanced shopper understanding, Walmart Data Ventures/Scintilla analysis, and omni-channel expertise to accelerate the growth of our powerhouse derm portfolio. You will operate as a collaborative team member with a deep understanding of the retail landscape, gaining invaluable experience in identifying and capitalizing on emerging digital, AI, and rapid-delivery trends.

Position Overview

As the Customer Development Manager for Walmart within L'Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB), you will serve as both the commercial account strategist and the advanced data catalyst driving our business within Walmart’s rapidly evolving digital and physical ecosystem. You will leverage Walmart Scintilla, Data Ventures platform, and Retail Link to unlock omnichannel, insights, translating first-party data into future-forward growth strategies for our powerhouse derm brands (CeraVe, La Roche-Posay).

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management

Analyze and define growth levers relevant to Walmart with a specific focus on the shopper, ensuring selling is driven by robust shopper insights.Own direct account management responsibilities for smaller and emerging growth categories (e.g., First Aid, Baby), driving their specific commercial strategy and retail performance.Provide managerial support on customer management functions inclusive of Joint Business Planning (JBP), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Line Reviews and various other strategic workstreams (Health & Wellness, Beauty Elevation, Anti-Theft etc.).

Business Intelligence & Omnichannel Leadership

Act as the internal power user for Walmart Data Ventures Scintilla platform, extracting granular first-party omnichannel data (basket affinity, loyalty, lifetime value) to shape commercial strategy.Create the online vision for LDB brands, aligning with Walmart's rapidly evolving ecosystem (Omnichannel/Digital, AI Optimization, and Rapid Delivery).Collaborate with e-retail and consumer experience teams to execute plans and create a seamless Online-Plus-Offline (O+O) experience.

Reporting & Operational Execution

Deliver comprehensive commentary to supplement weekly performance reporting, tracking key business drivers, shipments, retail sales, and events.Lead end-to-end Line Review Preparation, partnering with cross-functional teams to build data-backed sales presentations and strategic proposals.Drive Category Insights & Analysis: Serve as the resident expert on category analysis for your brands, competitive brands, and the overall skincare/emerging categories. Develop opportunities from top-door analysis, new item/hero item evaluation, and weekly inventory reviews.Manage Item Set Up & Maintenance, ensuring flawless execution of data integrity across retail systems.Coordinate Mod Room execution and Sample management, ensuring physical and digital presentations meet retailer standards.Oversee planning and execution for retail Displays.

Main Interfaces

Commercial VP / Account Directors / Business AnalystInternal Sales Support Teams (Trade, Analytics, Customer Marketing, Category Development, Finance, Supply Chain, etc.)Assigned retailer touchpoints across various business units within Walmart.

Measures of Success

Commercial & Category Growth: Successful delivery of sales targets, distribution points, ROI, and profitable growth across core skincare and emerging categories (e.g., First Aid, Baby).Data Ventures & Omnichannel Mastery: Effective utilization and translation of Walmart Data Ventures and Scintilla platforms into winning Joint Business Planning (JBP) strategies, driving e-share expansion, digital shelf optimization, and rapid-delivery metrics.Strategic Partnership & Alignment: Positive retailer scorecards and strong collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and Walmart buying teams.Operational & Execution Rigor: Effective weekly reporting commentary, timely item set-up & maintenance, display planning, and mod room/line review preparation.Team & Collaborative Impact: Active cross-functional leadership, ongoing support and development of junior team members, and positive Team 360° feedback.

What We Are Looking For

A results-oriented individual who can translate market and shopper insights into actionable strategies, contributing to profitable growth for the LDB Walmart business. You will possess a solid understanding of commercial principles, strong analytical skills, and the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

Experience: 4–5+ years of relevant commercial, sales, or advanced analytical experience in CPG, with direct experience managing the Walmart account.Technical Expertise: Proven mastery of Walmart Data Ventures, Scintilla, and Retail Link (DSS/IDW). Experience with syndicated data (Circana/IRI) is a strong plus.Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel & PowerPoint. Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, and interpret large sets of retail data into compelling business narratives.Ecosystem Acumen: Deep knowledge of retailer strategies, digital shelf dynamics, omnichannel retail levers, and competitor landscapes.Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field.

What’s In It For You

Salary Range: $90,200-$128,500 (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job-related factors which may include geographic location, work experience, education, and skill level)Competitive Benefit Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan) Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!) Access to Company Perks (VIP Access to L’Oréal’s Internal Shop for Discounted Products, Monthly Mobile Allowance) Learning & Development Opportunities for Career Progression (Unlimited Access to E-learnings, Lunch & Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, & More!)   Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads)   Access to Mental Health & Wellness Programs    

Authorization to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent, ongoing basis is required. No immigration support/sponsorship offered for this role

Being present in the office three days a week is considered an essential function of all office-based roles for eligible full-time employees.

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!
