Job Description

About Us

At P&G, we are innovators, leaders, and brand builders. Our iconic Skin Care brands are trusted in millions of homes worldwide. We are committed to delighting consumers through superior product experiences and compelling storytelling, building brands that improve everyday life. We believe in the power of authentic conversation, deep connection, and vibrant community to foster enduring brand love. When you join P&G, you make an impact from day one, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

The Opportunity

Are you a visionary marketing leader with a proven track record in sparking conversations, cultivating communities, and driving organic relevance for beloved brands? Do you thrive on translating brand objectives into powerful social experiences and measurable business impact within the dynamic Skin Care category?

We are seeking a highly strategic and execution-focused Director, Social Strategy & Organic Growth - Skin Care to orchestrate brand talkability and sustainable organic relevance growth for our leading Skin Care portfolio. In this pivotal role, you will define the strategy, lead the planning, and oversee the execution, learning, and optimization of social-first ideas, innovative content, and high-impact partnerships. You will be at the forefront of translating deep consumer insights, culture, and trends into compelling social moments, both online and through unique experiential activations that resonate with our consumers and amplify our presence at key retailer moments. This role demands a sophisticated blend of creative vision, analytical rigor, and exceptional cross-functional leadership, working hand-in-hand with Brand Marketing, Media, and Communications teams to ensure cohesive, impactful, and globally relevant brand narratives.

Your Responsibilities

 Orchestrate Brand Talkability & Organic Relevance Growth for Skin Care: Develop and lead the overarching strategy for driving organic brand conversation, share of voice, and community engagement across relevant social platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, emerging platforms). This includes creating a calendar of Brand Idea-led social tentpoles, orchestrating across branded assets, celebrity, influencer and other external partnerships, experiential executions, and user-generated content. The ultimate goal is to grow brand relevance and earned media value, translating into increased glance views, improved conversion rates, and sales growth. Design and implement repeatable "social flywheel" systems and frameworks that transform content, community, employees, and consumers into powerful brand advocates, fostering authentic connections within the Skin Care community. Lead Social-First Content Strategy & Innovation: Own the editorial vision and content framework for Skin Care, guiding the creation of compelling brand-led and creator-generated content optimized for social platforms to encourage comments, shares, and user-generated content, reflecting unique Skin Care consumer needs and trends. Leverage cutting-edge AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate content ideation, creation, repurposing, and testing, identifying viral content patterns and building scalable playbooks that resonate with beauty and skin care enthusiasts. Build & Nurture Influencer & Partnership Ecosystems: Identify, onboard, and manage strategic influencer, creator, and ambassador programs that authentically amplify Skin Care brand messaging and extend reach, targeting relevant beauty and lifestyle communities. Foster meaningful engagement and community participation, developing systems that convert followers into active brand advocates and co-creators within the Skin Care space. Drive Experiential & Retailer Activation Integration: Conceptualize and execute social strategies that seamlessly integrate with experiential activations, maximizing their talkability and digital footprint within the beauty landscape. Partner closely with Brand Marketing and Sales teams to amplify Skin Care brand presence around key retailer tentpoles and promotional events through bespoke social campaigns and compelling content strategies. Measure Impact & Optimize Performance: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as organic reach, engagement rate, audience growth, brand sentiment, referral traffic, and contribution to marketing-qualified leads/sales pipeline specifically for Skin Care. Establish an experimentation roadmap for content formats, posting strategies, AI workflows, and engagement tactics, driving continuous optimization based on data-driven insights and market trends. Lead & Influence Cross-Functionally: Collaborate extensively with Brand Marketing, Media, Communications, Product Development, and Sales teams to ensure integrated campaigns and amplified messaging for Skin Care brands. Present insights, strategies, and recommendations to senior leadership, acting as a thought leader in social media, organic growth, and the evolving beauty landscape.

What We Offer You

Meaningful Work from Day 1: Lead organic growth for iconic, global Skin Care brands that truly impact consumers' lives.Continuous Growth & Development: Access to world-class learning and development opportunities, a robust career path, and the chance to expand your skills and expertise within the beauty industry.Dynamic & Collaborative Culture: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment where innovation, leadership, and integrity are highly valued, collaborating with top talent globally.Competitive Compensation & Benefits: A comprehensive package designed to support your overall well-being.

Job Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree or higher.7-10+ years of progressive experience in social media marketing, content strategy, growth marketing, or community leadership, with significant experience in the Beauty, Personal Care, or Consumer Goods sector, ideally Skin Care.Proven track record of significantly growing organic audiences, engagement, and brand talkability across diverse social platforms for major brands.Hands-on experience in the orchestration between different aspects of the social flywheel (branded assets, influencer, social media, experiential).Demonstrated experience in building and scaling creator, influencer, and/or employee advocacy programs within the beauty industry.Deep understanding of social platform algorithms, content distribution best practices, and emerging social trends relevant to Skin Care consumers.Exceptional strategic thinking, complex project management, and execution capabilities.Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse stakeholders, including executive leadership.Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate organizational structures and foster partnerships.

Preferred:

Experience with integrated marketing campaigns involving large-scale experiential activations and complex retailer partnerships.Experience leveraging AI tools and advanced analytics platforms to inform strategy and optimize performance.In-depth familiarity with the creator economy and modern creator business models within the beauty space.Passion for consumer insights and the ability to translate them into highly effective, culturally relevant social strategies for Skin Care.Strong personal brand or demonstrable track record of thought leadership in social media/beauty marketing.

Job Description:

Senior Manager, Global Scientific & Regulatory Affairs (SRA) Center of Excellence (CoE)

The Senior Manager, Global Scientific & Regulatory Affairs (SRA) Center of Excellence (CoE), is a high-impact individual contributor responsible for end-to-end stewardship of the SRA Issues Management Program.

Operating within a 3–5-year time horizon, this leader acts as a trusted strategic partner who translates emerging, pre-regulatory scientific trends, shifting risk-assessment methodologies, and global policy developments into actionable business foresight. By collaborating with an expansive, matrixed network of senior business leaders, technical subject matter experts and regional SRA teams, the Senior Manager designs robust frameworks that integrate seamlessly within enterprise level risk management systems to assess financial and operational impacts.

This role will leverage advanced data analytics and predictive modeling to create highly visual, synthesis-driven landscape assessments that drive visibility, identify opportunities and unlock long-term freedom-to-operate initiatives.

What are we looking for?

Minimum bachelor's degree in a technical area, such as food chemistry, nutrition, food science, biology, chemistry, or toxicology. Advance degree preferredMinimum 7 years of experience in scientific and/or regulatory compliance/affairs and/or a related technical area with food products or related product categories (such as food supplements, cosmetics, and natural health products) with proficiency in food law, nutrition policy, and regulatory affairs (preferably in multiple major markets). Experience working on global-scale regulatory programs involving risk assessment & mitigation, issues management and opportunity identificationDemonstrated track record of working successfully across functions to achieve shared goals with proven ability to interact at all levels within the organization; proven drive for results with an ability to work independently.

What will be your key responsibilities?

Program Stewardship & Governance: Lead the governance of the Global SRA Issues Management Program, establishing a standardized framework that aligns with the broader enterprise risk management systems. Long-Term Horizon Scanning: Partner with subject matter experts to monitor and analyse the 3–5 year predictive time horizon to anticipate long-term scientific and regulatory shifts. "Pre-Regulatory" Intelligence Frameworks: Design and govern the organizational frameworks, processes and channels required to systematically capture "pre-regulatory" insights (such as emerging scientific trends, shifts in government risk assessment endpoints, and novel methodologies) from internal technical subject matter experts and regional teams. Strategic Translation & Business Context: Act as the primary translator of complex, expert-level technical assessments, translating raw scientific data and regulatory trends into clear business strategy and commercial context, driving strategic options for leadership. Risk & Opportunity Assessment Methodology: Design structured methodologies and risk assessment models that allow the business to evaluate the potential financial, reputational and operational impacts of emerging issues. Data Analytics & Prioritization Systems: Build and manage data-driven prioritization models and analytical tools to evaluate complex global issues, enabling leadership to make objective decisions regarding resource allocation and business priority.Strategic Visualization & Executive Reporting: Synthesize high-level, cross-functional expert inputs into highly visual global landscape maps, charts and dashboards to drive executive visibility and facilitate strategic decision-making. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Mobilization: Act as the SRA global lead and trusted partner, convening and driving alignment across an expansive, matrixed network of global business units, technical experts and regional SRA leads to build consensus on mitigation plans.Regional Empowerment & Ways of Working: Cultivate collaborative, bidirectional workflows and feedback loops with regional SRA teams to optimize how regional insights are ingested, analysed and integrated into the global framework.

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

rows.title: Principal AI/ML Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Requirements

 Description & Requirements 

Who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable , inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The Enterprise Data & AI organization is a strategic and operational driver of growth for lululemon, owning and building the data and AI platforms and services that enable the enterprise to operate with intelligence at scale. The team leads the design and delivery of a trusted unified data foundation, AI-driven data analytics and insights, and AI solutions across lululemon’s vertically integrated retail ecosystem, while embedding strong data governance and responsible AI practices from the very beginning. By applying AI to critical business challenges and creating new, transformative AI solutions, the team helps reshape how lululemon operates. Through deep partnership with product, technology, and business teams, Enterprise Data & AI accelerates product innovation, unlocks measurable value, elevates guest and educator experiences, and drives enterprise efficiency. 

Core responsibilities

As a Principal AI/ML Engineer, you will define and drive implementation approaches for enterprise-scale AI initiatives that transform how lululemon operates and delivers value. You will leverage deep expertise in machine learning systems, generative AI, MLOps , and platform architecture to shape company-wide technical strategy and design of the enterprise AI platform and services, and AI solutions.

You will collaborate closely with enterprise architects, applied science leaders, product leaders, and engineering organizations to translate the AI strategy and priorities into scalable technical solutions. Acting as a trusted advisor across the enterprise, you will guide critical decisions related to the architecture for enterprise AI platform and services, the evolution of the AI platform, and responsible AI implementation.

You will operate as a hands-on technical leader, advisor, and thought leader, influencing organizational direction through your technical expertise, and as an individual contributor, guide the build of AI/ML engineering capabilities across the company.This role may require availability outside of standard business hours, including on-call support, based on business needs.

Select Responsibilities Include

 Define the enterprise AI/ML engineering vision and implementation strategy spanning the enterprise AI platform and services, and common frameworks and tools for model development, training infrastructure, inference platforms, evaluation frameworks, and governance capabilities.  Drive implementation of major AI initiatives, ensuring scalable, reliable, secure, and cost-effective AI solutions across the enterprise.  Demonstrate expert-level coding proficiency by developing critical components of AI platforms, ML infrastructure, and production AI systems when hands-on technical leadership is required.  Partner with enterprise architects, product team, and the Data and AI team to shape company-wide AI architecture, providing deep technical expertise on implementation feasibility, operational considerations, scalability, and long-term maintainability.  Lead technical design of foundation model services, generative AI solutions, and agentic frameworks,  Challenge and improve existing AI architectures by identifying platform limitations, technical risks, and opportunities for innovation, proposing solutions that advance enterprise AI capabilities.  Provide executive-level technical advisory on complex AI investments, build-versus-buy decisions, model strategy, technology selection, responsible AI considerations, and implementation risk assessment.  Drive enterprise-wide AI/ML engineering practices including model lifecycle management, experimentation standards, evaluation methodologies, observability, reliability, and responsible AI controls.  Influence product strategy and business investment decisions through technical insights on AI feasibility, value realization, scalability, and organizational impact.  Drive engineering productivity and AI adoption across multiple teams through platform enhancements, reusable AI capabilities, automation, and reduction of systemic technical barriers.  Mentor Senior and Staff engineers while developing the next generation of AI technical leaders across the organization.  Represent lululemon externally through industry conferences, technical publications, open-source contributions, and participation in the broader AI community. 

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience; Master's preferred.  11-15+ years of progressive software engineering and AI/ML engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating enterprise-scale AI systems and platforms, or equivalent.  Expert-level coding ability with a track record of developing production-grade AI/ML systems, platforms, and infrastructure that solve highly complex technical and business challenges. Retail experience preferred.  Deep expertise across system design for complex ML solutions, model deployments, batch and real-time services, and evaluation frameworks.  Proven experience defining implementation strategies and execution approaches for complex, cross-organizational AI initiatives with measurable business impact.  Demonstrated ability to evaluate and guide adoption of emerging AI technologies  Deep experience analyzing complex technical trade-offs involving model quality, latency, reliability, scalability, cost optimization, privacy, and governance requirements.  Recognized expertise in implementing AI solutions combined with the ability to assess enterprise-wide implications and influence long-term technology direction.  Experience collaborating with applied science, product, architecture, security, and engineering leadership teams to deliver enterprise AI capabilities.  Advanced experience with implementing AI/ML engineering solutions using python , Spark, Airflow, MLFlow , feature stores, vector databases, model serving platforms, cloud AI services, Kubernetes, and modern MLOps tooling. 

Must haves

 Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.  Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.   Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.   Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.   Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.   Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.  

Additional Notes

Please note: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from $266,720 - $350,070   annually  ; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and equity offerings, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

At Lululemon, Investing In Our People Is a Top Priority. We Believe That When Life Works, Work Works. We Strive To Be The Place Where Inclusive Leaders Come To Develop And Enable All To Be Well. Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth

 Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans  Paid time off  Savings and retirement plan matching  Generous employee discount  Fitness & yoga classes  Parenthood top-up  Extensive catalog of development course offerings  People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few) 

Note: The incentive programs, benefits, and perks have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these incentive programs, benefits, and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

workplace arrangement 

In-person collaboration and connection is important to our culture. Work is performed onsite, minimum 4 days per week.

rows.descriptionText:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Data Analyst (Ads & Sponsorships)

Locations: Kirkland, Los Angeles (Hybrid)

Reports to: Director, Advertising & Sponsorships Insights & Innovations

As the Advertising Intelligence Analyst, you will manage monthly reporting deliverables for in-game advertising inventory as well as develop scalable data models and construct essential dashboards for the Ads & Sponsorships (A&S) team. You will partner with AdOps, AdTech, Product Management, and game analytics groups across game studios to ensure reporting data remains precise, documented, and streamlined through automation.

Operating on assignments of moderate complexity, you will independently handle the standard reporting rhythm while collaborating on new projects. You will report directly to the Director of Advertising Intelligence, and collaborate daily with the Data Solutions Analyst. Your contributions will provide foundational insights relied upon by the entire A&S Team.

Responsibilities

Align with the AdOps team each month on which campaigns are included in reporting, then create and consistently publish reports for all custom A&S inventory across EA titles.Act as the A&S business lead with AdTech on report automation — define requirements, validate output, and cut manual steps out of the monthly cycle.Collaborate with the Product Management team to ensure new inventory is included in standardized reporting.Maintain documentation of reporting queries and KPI calculations so results are reproducible and auditable.Bridge the reporting gap for A&S inventory in mobile titles and work towards automation.Build and maintain the A&S team dashboards, to support the Sales, AdOps, Product Management, and Revenue Strategy functions.Manage access and permissions for A&S dashboards.Apply working knowledge of data engineering concepts to design and maintain internal A&S data models and databases as well as provide inputs and guidance to AdTech partners on data pipeline migration.Build partnerships with studio analytics teams to understand each team's data taxonomy.Fulfill ad hoc telemetry and data requests across the A&S team.

Qualifications

1+ years of experience in analytics, reporting, or business intelligence; internship experience counts.Bachelor, MBA or Master's degree in Statistics or related field with knowledge in the application of statistics using analytics software.Database knowledge including table structures, views, queries, and SQL statements including window/analytic functions.Competent with at least one analytics software package (Python, R, SAS, or SPSS) and comfortable working in Excel (can write advanced macros).Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker), and generating graphs and visuals that make an insight easy to understand.Summarize data using the right statistical terms and explain those concepts to non-statistical audiences in plain language.Familiar with core data engineering concepts — pipelines, schemas, ETL, and telemetry — enough to be a useful partner to engineering teams.Clear documentation habits, and prioritization recommendations, give effort estimates, and flag scheduling conflicts early.An interest in games: you play EA titles across platforms and follow industry and tech news.Exposure to digital advertising metrics (impressions, reach and frequency, viewability) or game telemetry data.Familiar with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

Requirements

 Description & Requirements 

Note: there is only one position, however, the team is open to hiring in New York (Remote) or LA (Hybrid).

Who We Are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The Global PR manager will be responsible for identifying real-time trends taking place in culture, responding in real-time with ideas that drive earned media, and delivering regular insights, measurement, and analytics across all Global PR efforts.

This person will sit on the Global PR team and work closely with regional and cross-functional teams and agency partners to lead always-on PR. They will use media monitoring and social listening tools to identify bubbling themes emerging across fashion, sports, lifestyle, and entertainment that are relevant for our brand, and identify authentic ways to insert lululemon into the conversation that ultimately drive earned. They will also deliver actionable insights and recaps to better inform Global PR strategies and show the impact of the collective Consumer PR team’s work.

The ideal candidate is at the forefront of culture and knows how to move at the speed of it to drive cultural relevance, has experience using media monitoring and social listening tools, has a pulse on the latest media intelligence platforms and tools, and confidence in knowing how to use data to inform public relation strategies.

Core Responsibilities

Leads always-on PR by conducting proactive and reactive media monitoring and social listening to identify timely insights, themes, and trends emerging in culture to act on in real-time (ex: news jacking) and drive cultural relevance.Has an earned-first mindset and can deliver and execute ideas, in partnership with the Consumer PR team and the Social Media team, that drive earned media based on the insights and themes they identify.Establishes our Global PR insights, measurement, and analytics program globally, building templates, processes, and reports.In collaboration with internal partners (ex: Regional PR teams, Global Brand Insights, Social Insights) and external PR agency to deliver quarterly Global PR reports and all global campaign and initiative-specific reporting with a focus on meaningful insights and analysis that can shape future strategies.Sets the strategy for what key indicators we measure across all global initiatives and the recommended KPIs, while regularly tracking progress towards goals.Provide regional PR teams with guidance and support on earned media insights, measurement and analytics.Manage and oversee our media monitoring management tool, as well as identify additional tools to help further improve our insights and analytics capabilities.Tracking competitor earned media activity and sharing learnings and insights back with cross functional partners and leadershipProvide operational support to the global PR team as needed.

Qualifications

7-10 years of professional experience in public relations, media monitoring, social listening, and analytics.Proficient knowledge and hands-on experience with media monitoring, social listening and reporting tools, specifically Meltwater and Muckrack, along with Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Netbase and TalkWater from a social listening perspective.Experience writing Boolean logic and query-based searches.Experience creating reports and visualizations in PowerPoint, Keynote and Excel.A news and culture expert who knows what’s taking place across fashion, sports, lifestyle, and entertainment.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong presentation skills, and ability to isolate takeaways for leadership.Able to quickly and easily develop relationships with people across cultures and geographies.Bachelor’s degree in public relations or related discipline. Fluent in English.

must haves

 Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life. Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results. Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same. Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.

Additional Notes

Authorization to work in the United States is required for this role.

Please note: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

The typical hiring range for this position is from $112,000- $147,000 USD annually; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and subject to program eligibility requirements.  

At Lululemon, Investing In Our People Is a Top Priority. We Believe That When Life Works, Work Works. We Strive To Be The Place Where Inclusive Leaders Come To Develop And Enable All To Be Well. Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth

 Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans Paid time off Savings and retirement plan matching Generous employee discount Fitness & yoga classes Parenthood top-up Extensive catalog of development course offerings People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few)

rows.descriptionText:
Join us as Senior Business Navigator III - Business Area 2, London Market
 
We’re looking for a Senior Business Navigator to join our team in Business Area 2, London Market reporting to the Country Business Navigation Manager. You will help to enhance customer value, good growth and optimise long term business performance for IKEA Retail, by enabling better business decisions, securing efficiency and leading in accordance with financial and business strategies. This includes securing (financial) business performance, a safe and secure environment in compliance with laws, policies and standards and process.

You will be a pro-active, trustworthy business partner who takes a multi-dimensional view of the business, connecting the needs of customers and the organisation with a complete overview of the profit & loss, and understanding of the balance sheet and cash flow management. Supporting and challenging the organisation through business-case thinking. Take the lead in


WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE
 
• Senior Ingka Business experience from an IKEA retail market Service office and unit commercial business knowledge and cross-functional understanding of how IKEA operates.
• Store business navigation manager experience in a high volume store for several years, with leadership experience in BN & at least one other SSG role, and a working understanding of project management.
• Effectively builds relationships within and across organisations, including influencing at senior levels, to help achieve business outcomes. 
• Good understanding of data science, new technologies, analytics and their wide ranging application in business context.
• Good knowledge of the IKEA Concept, the IKEA Brand Identity and the IKEA culture & Values.
• In-depth knowledge of IKEA business tools, processes and cycles to formulate and develop strategies to drive the IKEA business and enable better business outcomes, today and tomorrow. 

Capabilities & Skills: 

• Skilled communicator and influencer with capacity to influence decisions and create energy and commitment within the organisation. 
• Strategic, tactical and operational business partner, with strong analytical skills, translate business needs into financial consequences and solutions.
• Comfortable working in agile structures and cross-functional teams to lead change through fully integrated communication with the business goal and the key target audiences in focus., with the ability to handle a constantly changing environment with many different stake holders and demands. 
• Ability to understand the complexity of the IKEA business and the role of business navigation as an integrated part of Omni Area 3. 


WHAT YOU WILL DO DAY TO DAY 

• Provide country management with information, analysis and expert insight to support, challenge and steer the country towards growth, optimal performance and sustained long-term profitability.
• Provide accurate, timely and relevant business information and expertise to the necessary target groups in a way which inspires and engages them to take meaningful decisions and actions to achieve the goals
• Partner with the units in their financial performance and be responsible for the subsequent country financial submission to global retail business navigation.
• Have a full overview of the P&L and take responsibility for specific lines of the country P&L supporting challenging and steering the units and central functions to achieve their goals in these areas.
• Contribute functional expertise to the country pricing process to maximise commercial opportunities and achieve country gross margin goals.
• Identify and actively pursue business opportunities as they arise.
• Work, and follow up with, appropriate partners in units and SO functions to secure the effective implementation of tools, processes and best practice to secure the customer experience and the strong retail foundation.
• Carry out Financial Health Topic Reviews and support the units in improving their functional review outcomes in order to achieve growth, optimal performance and sustained long-term profitability and to improve competence and the customer experience.
• Secure the performance measurement and support to improve performance of the major KPI’s by being close to operations such as organizing workshop for business improvement, benchmark activities etc.


WE CARE FOR THE PEOPLE 

It takes the diversity of thought, background, and culture to make great ideas a reality. We welcome candidates from all walks of life, including those with disabilities and diverse social backgrounds, to join us, and feel valued in the workplace. 


WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW 

• This role has a starting salary of £70,000 per annum. The amount decided is dependent on the successful candidate’s current base salary and their displayed competencies for the role. 
• Full-time: 39 hours per week, Monday to Friday. 
• Location: UK Service Office, Wembley, Flexible working principles, 12 days’ workplace presence, of which 8 must be in Wembley, with the remaining 4 in an individual's nearest unit. 


RECRUITMENT PROCESS INFORMATION 

Let us know if you require any adjustments to be made during the interview process as soon as possible. 

• Please attach an updated CV and cover letter outlining your motivation for applying for the role, so we can get to know you better. 
• Application Closing Date: Monday 27th September 2026
• To ensure a smooth process, we encourage all applicants to apply as soon as possible. 
• Interviews will begin to take place during the application phase. 

We understand not everyone will be successful, but we promise to keep you informed either way. 

If you have any questions regarding the role please contact Allen Gates, for any recruitment experience questions, please contact Beth Crombie, beth.crombie@ingka.ikea.com 
 
 
 
 
 
 We see ourselves as influencers – we steer the IKEA business by finding the truth behind the figures. Together we secure compliance with local and international laws and reporting standards; we assure that accounting processes are efficient and that tax compliance meets business needs. We’re a diverse group of people driven by providing reliable financial data to a wide variety of stakeholders. At the end of the day, that’s one of the foundations to make IKEA even better!

We’re Kingfisher, A team made up of over 74,000 passionate people who bring Kingfisher - and all our other brands: B&Q, Screwfix, Brico Depot, Castorama and Koctas to life. Guided by our purpose Better Homes. Better Lives. For Everyone. We believe a better world starts with better homes, and we work every day to make that a reality. Join us and help shape the future of home improvement.

The role

As a Senior Implementation Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering our measurement strategy, ensuring robust tracking, reporting and insights are embedded across our digital products and platforms. Working closely with Product, Data and Analytics teams, you will design and implement measurement frameworks that enable data-driven decision-making, while partnering with the Group Digital Analytics team and key stakeholders across the business to drive continuous optimisation and maximise the value of our digital experiences.

Please note that this role will be based out of our Kingfisher Head Office in Paddington with an expectation of 12 days a month in the office.   

 What's the job? 

 Partner with Measurement, Product, Analytics and brand teams to define and deliver tagging and measurement requirements across digital platforms.  Lead the implementation of tagging solutions for websites and mobile apps, working with engineering teams to develop and enhance data layers.  Monitor, analyse and improve data quality, proactively identifying issues, investigating root causes and delivering sustainable solutions.  Manage tagging changes through release pipelines, ensuring robust governance, performance and high-quality change management.  Maintain and optimise third-party vendor integrations, ensuring accurate, consistent and reliable data collection.  Build strong stakeholder relationships through clear communication, documentation and alignment of tag management and analytics platforms to deliver consistent tracking.  Drive continuous improvement by researching emerging technologies, sharing best practices, peer reviewing changes and supporting the development of team capability. 

What You'll Bring

 Experience in a technical implementation role such as Implementation Analyst, Data Analyst or Implementation Engineer.  Strong experience delivering website and app analytics tracking, including data layer specification, implementation, debugging, testing and validation.  Extensive knowledge of digital analytics platforms (GA360, GA4), tag management systems (Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ), JavaScript, and tagging governance best practices.  Experience implementing and managing server-side tracking solutions, ideally using Tealium EventStream.  Good working knowledge of Google Marketing Platform and experience using Google Cloud.  Experience debugging and troubleshooting tracking issues within native mobile applications.  Confident presenting technical concepts, data insights and solutions to stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise.  Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and organisational skills, with the ability to peer review work and maintain high standards of quality and accuracy. 

How We Work

We believe in flexibility and balance. Our hybrid model blends home working for focus with time spent connecting and collaborating - whether in our offices or at offsite locations. On average, around 60% of your time will involve in-person collaboration.

We value the perspectives new team members bring and encourage you to apply - even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements.

What We Offer

An inclusive environment where your potential is limited only by your imagination. We encourage new ideas, support experimentation, and strive to create a workplace where everyone can be their best self. Find out more about Diversity & Inclusion at Kingfisher here.

We also offer a competitive benefits package and plenty of opportunities to stretch and grow your career.

Diversity & Inclusion

Our customers come from all walks of life - and so do we. We’re committed to ensuring all colleagues, future colleagues, and applicants are treated equally, regardless of age, gender, marital or civil partnership status, ethnicity, culture, religion, belief, political opinion, disability, gender identity, gender expression, or sexual orientation.

Interested? Great, apply now and help us to Power the Possible.

rows.title: Insight Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behaviour, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

Utilizing extensive industry knowledge to provide valuable insights to solve client business challenges, the ideal candidate would have a high degree of autonomy and problem-solving capabilities. The candidate should have a track record of using innovative and inspiring insight to grow our client’s business, paired with superb organizational and interpersonal engagement skills to deliver an all-round excellent service to the client.

Job Responsibilities

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in [retail, CPG, or general merchandise] to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

Educational background at degree level preferredExperience in a similar role preferred (i.e. Category, Insight, Data)Experience required in the application of market measurement data including shopper

Circana Behaviours

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviours sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviours throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Chiswick Park - London & Bracknell

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing?

You will be one of two dedicated consultants embedded with a leading consumer health client based in Summit, New Jersey, working across some of the most recognized brands in skin care, oral care, and self care. The client has selected Circana as its analytics partner for price and promotion and assortment, and you will be the person who turns model output into decisions. This is a decision advisor role, not a platform operator role. You will frame the business question with the client's RGM, brand, category and customer teams, work with Circana's modeling team to get the right answer, lead the working session, and land a recommendation the client actually takes to market.

You will work across the full program, spanning both price and promotion and assortment, and you will be measured on the commercial decisions you influence, not the number of scenarios you run. You will spend a minimum of two days a week onsite with the client. The role sits in Circana's Analytics organization, with day-to-day account accountability to the Client Insights team that leads the relationship.

Job Responsibilities

Be the trusted advisor to RGM and category teams: Be the day-to-day analytics partner to the client's pricing, RGM, category and brand teams. Understand their planning calendar, their line review cycle, and the retailer conversations they are preparing for, and bring a point of view to those moments rather than waiting to be asked. Earn the seat at the table where pricing and assortment decisions get made. Shape pricing and promotion decisions: Interpret base and promoted price elasticities, cross-price effects, price gaps and thresholds across the client's categories and key retailers. Use Circana's platform to pressure test pricing and promotion scenarios with the client, then translate them into pricing corridors, promotional guidelines and retailer-specific recommendations the client can defend in a buyer meeting. Shape assortment and retailer decisions: Apply demand transferability and incrementality outputs at the retailer and market level to line reviews, new item decisions, delisting and planogram trade-offs. Use assortment simulations, including planogram upload and new item scenarios, to build the retailer story with the client and help them win the line review. Connect analytics to commercial outcomes: Frame the question, coordinate the modeling work, lead the working session, and package the recommendation. Follow the decision through to what happened in market and bring that back to the client so the program is judged on results. Manage the cadence of quarterly refreshes, remodels, new item updates and category reviews so the client always knows what is coming and when. Partner with Circana's delivery teams: Work closely with the Global Solutions modeling team, the Client Insights team on the account, and the dedicated analyst. Own the specs the models depend on (product groupings, attributes, geographies) and make sure what gets built matches what the client will use. Build capability on the client side: Train and support client users on the platforms, run office hours, and raise the client's fluency in elasticities, transferability and optimization so they can self-serve on the routine questions and lean on you for the hard ones. Find the next opportunity: Spot the next question before the client asks it. Actively look for adjacent problems the client is working on, whether in Growth Consulting, demand forecasting, causal analytics or other Circana solutions, and bring them to the commercial lead with a point of view on how to scope them. You will be closer to the client's agenda than anyone else at Circana, and we expect you to use that. Communicate with presence: Present clearly and confidently to senior client stakeholders. Tell the story from what the model says to what the business should do, and be willing to challenge the client's thinking when the data supports it.

Circana Behaviors

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Northern New Jersey / New York metro, with a minimum of two days per week onsite in Summit, NJ. Limited additional travel (under 5%).

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

You’ll partner with clients to align Circana’s solutions, data and analytics to their business goals, delivering actionable insights that drive measurable outcomes.

In addition to managing and contributing to end-to-end insight delivery, this individual will support the team on complex analyses and help drive best practices across measurement, storytelling, and client engagement. Build Strategic Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations, including decision-makers and influencers. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Achieve Revenue Targets: Meet or exceed individual and team sales goals through disciplined pipeline management and strategic account planning. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Support Innovation and Feedback: Provide market feedback to internal teams to help refine offerings and contribute to product development. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

8–12+ years’ relevant experience in marketing, sales, insights, or related functions with a Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG), Retailer, or Research Services company. Analytical mindset deriving insights from various sources of data. Demonstrated expertise in translating data and analysis into relevant implications within the CPG industryExperience with Circana or other syndicated CPG POS solutions is required. CPG Panel experience is preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint requiredBachelor’s degree preferred

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator’s Data Science team provides statistical and methodological leadership across the organization, developing the methodologies, tools, and data products that support our products.

This is a wide-ranging applied data science role focused primarily on the consumer purchase panel underlying our largest products, with opportunities to contribute to other complex data science initiatives across Numerator’s broader product portfolio. The work combines applied statistics, data investigation, methodology development, and practical implementation. Many of the questions we tackle do not have a single observable right answer, requiring us to combine statistical evidence, product context, and subject-matter judgment to understand tradeoffs and determine whether a solution improves the product as a whole. As your expertise grows, you will take on increasingly complex work and have opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, lead projects, improve team practices, and shape how we work.

How You’ll Spend Your Time

Design and implement statistical methodologies that improve the representativeness, stability, and quality of Numerator’s products. Develop data science solutions to problems involving consumer behavior, panel composition, and data quality using techniques such as sampling, weighting, statistical modeling, classification, predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and optimization. Build scalable Python and SQL solutions, internal tools, and data products that turn statistical methodologies into reliable production workflows. Develop metrics, monitoring, and validation frameworks to evaluate system performance and identify unexpected or unintended behavior. Contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from problem definition and exploration through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing evaluation. Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and business partners to shape requirements and develop solutions that are both statistically sound and practical to use. Communicate methodologies, findings, assumptions, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

A bachelor’s or advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Physics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. Two to five years of industry experience developing and delivering data science solutions. A strong foundation in applied statistics, with experience applying statistical modeling, optimization, or other quantitative methods to real-world data problems. Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience developing reusable, well-structured code and working with large, complex datasets. Comfort working through open-ended problems, investigating unexpected results, and developing solutions with guidance and collaboration, along with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical partners. Familiarity with survey research or consumer panels—including sampling, weighting, bias correction, imputation, or other methods used to improve representativeness—is helpful but not required. Experience working with user-level or behavioral data is helpful, as is exposure to production data science workflows and tools such as Snowflake, AWS, Airflow, or GitHub. Familiarity with AI-powered tools and workflows, with an interest in applying emerging technologies to improve productivity, learning, and outcomes. 

What We Offer

An inclusive and collaborative company culture—we work in an open environment while working together to get things done and adapt to changing needs as they arise. A market-competitive total compensation package. Volunteer time off and charitable donation matching. Strong support for career growth, including mentorship programs, leadership training, access to conferences, and employee resource groups. A great benefits package including health, vision, and dental coverage; a Personal Spending Account; unlimited PTO; flexible scheduling; 401(k) matching; travel reimbursement; and more.

rows.title: Sr. Data Scientist II
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator is seeking a Sr. Data Scientist II (Bayesian Modeling) to help build, enhance, and scale data science services across our rapidly evolving data platform. You’ll work end-to-end on initiatives that turn massive proprietary datasets into impactful, production-grade solutions.

This is a highly autonomous, product-focused role. You’ll partner with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to translate customer needs into data-driven products, analytics methodologies, and new offerings that drive measurable business impact.

How You'll Spend Your Time:

Lead the design and delivery of complex Bayesian and probabilistic modeling pipelines, from methodology through production Set technical direction on hard modeling problems and make the key methodological calls, with a high degree of autonomy Work closely with Product, GTM, Data, and Engineering to turn models into reliable, production-grade solutions the business can depend on Help the whole team get better — mentor other data scientists, share your approach openly, and raise the bar for how the group reasons about uncertainty and Bayesian methods Communicate methods, results, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Strong foundation in Bayesian inference and probabilistic modeling — e.g. hierarchical / multilevel models, state-space and time-series models, graphical models, MCMC/HMC, variational and other approximate inference Experience applying these methods to real, messy, production data — not only research or coursework Comfort reasoning about uncertainty, calibration, and model validation Facility with large or structured datasets and the computational side of inference at scale Strong Python, and fluency in a modern probabilistic-programming and numerical-computing stack — NumPyro, PyMC, Stan, JAX, dynamax, or similar. We hire on the ideas, not on exact tooling Track record of shipping statistical models into production BS or PhD in Statistics, Math, Economics, Physics, CS, or a related quantitative field 8+ years of industry experience as a data scientist (or equivalent role/work) with a BS in the above-mentioned areas, or 5+ years of industry experience with a PhD in a quantitative field Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences 

Nice to Haves:

Diagnosing and debugging large Bayesian models — convergence and divergence issues, pinning down which part of a big model is misbehaving, and knowing which inference method to reach for Weighting a non-representative survey or panel sample up to a known population, and a feel for where those adjustments break down Hierarchical models spanning multiple crossed or overlapping groupings — relationships that bridge hierarchies, not just a single nested tree Experience with graph or network models, or modeling relational / graph-structured data Measurement-error modeling, or reconciling multiple imperfect data sources CPG / FMCG / retail experience, or work with user-level purchase or panel data

rows.title: Client Development Manager
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator is looking for a top performing sales professional to join our growing organization. As a Client Development Manager, you will have the opportunity to work with some of the world’s most iconic brands to help bring to life their advertising and marketing strategies through Numerator’s rich portfolio of solutions and insights. This role will be in charge of building out new relationships in a variety of markets and spaces. We're looking for a sales individual who brings both knowledge and experience within the Entertainment on Demand (video streaming) industry and who also understands the marketing and advertising world.

This role is remote but we are prioritizing applicants located in Austin, Texas or Chicago, Illinois.

How You’ll Spend Your Time:

Drive new business and win-back growth: Own outbound prospecting, pipeline creation, and win-back activity across the global Entertainment on Demand (video streaming) market. Identify target accounts, develop senior relationships, and create compelling reasons for prospects to engage with Worldpanel by Numerator. Build senior enterprise partnerships: Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and influencers across strategy, consumer insights, marketing, commercial, finance, product, and subscription teams. Lead consultative sales conversations that connect consumer intelligence to business-critical growth challenges. Create powerful pitch and collateral materials: Partner with the Strategy Manager, Consumer Intelligence leadership, marketing, and subject matter experts to create sharp, persuasive pitch decks, proposals, credentials, and tailored sales materials that bring the opportunity to life for prospects. Lead commercial negotiation: Build and own ARR and NRR commercial negotiations, including scope, terms, renewals, expansions, and deal structure to create strong long-term repeatable value for both clients and the business. Represent the business in the industry: Build visibility and credibility for Worldpanel by Numerator across the Entertainment on Demand ecosystem. Identify and attend lucrative conferences, networking events, client meetings, and industry forums to create opportunity, deepen relationships, and keep the business close to market trends. Collaborate across the growth engine: Work closely with the Head of Consumer Intelligence, Strategy Manager, broader Global Vertical functions. Ensure prospects receive a joined-up, expert, and commercially compelling experience from first conversation through handover. Manage pipeline and CRM discipline: Maintain accurate, timely, and high-quality Salesforce / CRM records, including pipeline activity, opportunity stage, next steps, commercial forecasts, contact mapping, and account intelligence. Bring rigor and transparency to revenue planning and performance tracking. Ensure smooth account transition: During and after close, partner with the Strategy Manager and internal teams to ensure a seamless handover, clear client expectations, and strong foundations for long-term relationship growth, retention, and expansion. 

What We Offer:

An inclusive and collaborative company culture- we work in an open environment while working together to get things done, and adapt to the changing needs as they come. Market competitive total compensation package. Volunteer time off and charitable donation matching. Strong support for career growth, including mentorship programs, leadership training, access to conferences and employee resource groups. Great benefits package including health/vision/dental, Personal Spending Account, unlimited PTO, flexible schedule, 401K matching, travel reimbursement and more. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experienceA minimum of 2 years of sales experience, selling to or working within video streaming, entertainment, media, subscriptions, consumer insights, data, analytics, research, advertising, or adjacent consumer sectors. Proven experience as a sales hunter and an ability to drive strategic sales cycles and close business. Strong commercial negotiation skills across subscriptions, projects, and multi-stakeholder agreements. Experience managing win-back, renewal, expansion, or reactivation opportunities solo. Exceptional communication and presentation skills - Ability to speak fluently to senior executives, salespeople and product managers. Functional knowledge of Salesforce.com and its use for updating accounts, opportunities, and deal stages. Understanding of ARR, NRR, pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with strategy, insights, marketing, and delivery teams. Willingness to travel for prospect meetings, client conversations, industry events, and internal collaboration. 

If this sounds like something you would like to be part of, we'd love for you to apply! Don't worry if you think that you don't meet all the qualifications here. The tools, technology, and methodologies we use are constantly changing, and we value talent and interest over specific experience.

rows.title: Client Analytics Consultant, Pricing and Assortment
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing?

You will be one of two dedicated consultants embedded with a leading consumer health client based in Summit, New Jersey, working across some of the most recognized brands in skin care, oral care, and self care. The client has selected Circana as its analytics partner for price and promotion and assortment, and you will be the person who turns model output into decisions. This is a decision advisor role, not a platform operator role. You will frame the business question with the client's RGM, brand, category and customer teams, work with Circana's modeling team to get the right answer, lead the working session, and land a recommendation the client actually takes to market.

You will work across the full program, spanning both price and promotion and assortment, and you will be measured on the commercial decisions you influence, not the number of scenarios you run. You will spend a minimum of two days a week onsite with the client. The role sits in Circana's Analytics organization, with day-to-day account accountability to the Client Insights team that leads the relationship.

Job Responsibilities

Be the trusted advisor to RGM and category teams: Be the day-to-day analytics partner to the client's pricing, RGM, category and brand teams. Understand their planning calendar, their line review cycle, and the retailer conversations they are preparing for, and bring a point of view to those moments rather than waiting to be asked. Earn the seat at the table where pricing and assortment decisions get made. Shape pricing and promotion decisions: Interpret base and promoted price elasticities, cross-price effects, price gaps and thresholds across the client's categories and key retailers. Use Circana's platform to pressure test pricing and promotion scenarios with the client, then translate them into pricing corridors, promotional guidelines and retailer-specific recommendations the client can defend in a buyer meeting. Shape assortment and retailer decisions: Apply demand transferability and incrementality outputs at the retailer and market level to line reviews, new item decisions, delisting and planogram trade-offs. Use assortment simulations, including planogram upload and new item scenarios, to build the retailer story with the client and help them win the line review. Connect analytics to commercial outcomes: Frame the question, coordinate the modeling work, lead the working session, and package the recommendation. Follow the decision through to what happened in market and bring that back to the client so the program is judged on results. Manage the cadence of quarterly refreshes, remodels, new item updates and category reviews so the client always knows what is coming and when. Partner with Circana's delivery teams: Work closely with the Global Solutions modeling team, the Client Insights team on the account, and the dedicated analyst. Own the specs the models depend on (product groupings, attributes, geographies) and make sure what gets built matches what the client will use. Build capability on the client side: Train and support client users on the platforms, run office hours, and raise the client's fluency in elasticities, transferability and optimization so they can self-serve on the routine questions and lean on you for the hard ones. Find the next opportunity: Spot the next question before the client asks it. Actively look for adjacent problems the client is working on, whether in Growth Consulting, demand forecasting, causal analytics or other Circana solutions, and bring them to the commercial lead with a point of view on how to scope them. You will be closer to the client's agenda than anyone else at Circana, and we expect you to use that. Communicate with presence: Present clearly and confidently to senior client stakeholders. Tell the story from what the model says to what the business should do, and be willing to challenge the client's thinking when the data supports it. 

Requirements

10 to 14 years of experience in CPG revenue growth management, pricing and promotion analytics, category management, or a consulting or analytics role serving CPG clientsA track record of using price elasticity, promotional effectiveness, demand transferability or assortment optimization outputs to influence real pricing, promotion or assortment decisions, and the ability to explain how those models work to a business audienceExperience with Point of Sale, syndicated and panel data; Circana or comparable syndicated data experience strongly preferredDemonstrated ability to lead working sessions, present recommendations to director and VP-level client stakeholders, and hold a position when challengedExperience in consumer health, OTC, beauty or personal care categories preferredFamiliarity with pricing, promotion and assortment simulation platforms preferredBachelor's degree required in business, economics, marketing, statistics or a related field; advanced degree in a quantitative discipline preferred but not requiredLocated in or able to commute to Summit, New Jersey a minimum of two days per week

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Northern New Jersey / New York metro, with a minimum of two days per week onsite in Summit, NJ. Limited additional travel (under 5%).

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

Required for job postings in the United States - Recruiter will insert pay transparency language (see below) to JD after kickoff call with manager*

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is XXX to XXX.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening.
