This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Client Analytics Analyst, Pricing and Assortment
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing?

You will be the dedicated analyst on a two-consultant team embedded with a leading consumer health client in Summit, New Jersey. Circana has been selected as this client's analytics partner for price and promotion and assortment, and you will be the person closest to the model output: running the scenarios, finding what matters in the results, building the deliverables, and making sure every number that reaches the client is right.

This is one of the best development seats in Circana Analytics for the right person. You will get hands-on exposure to price elasticity, promotional effectiveness, demand transferability and assortment optimization models in a live commercial environment, working directly with the consultants, Circana's modeling team and the client's analytics group. Analysts who do this well are on a direct path to a consultant role. The role sits in Circana's Analytics organization, with day-to-day account accountability to the Client Insights team that leads the relationship.

Job Responsibilities

Run the platforms: Become the expert user of Circana's price and promotion and assortment platforms for the client. Execute scenarios and simulations requested by the consultants and client users, QC the results, and turn them around quickly. Find the findings: Go beyond running the scenario. Identify the notable results, the anomalies that need a second look, and the business implications in the model output, and bring them to the consultants with a first take on what they mean for the client. You are the first line of interpretation on the team. Build the deliverables: Translate model output into clear, accurate slides and summaries for line reviews, pricing reviews and category readouts. Maintain a consistent standard across all client-facing materials. Keep the program on schedule: Track quarterly coefficient refreshes, assortment remodels, monthly new item updates and category review timing. Flag risks early and keep the team's internal timeline and open items list current. Manage the data inputs: Maintain the product groupings, attribute files and geography lists the models depend on. Coordinate with Circana's delivery and modeling teams to resolve data questions and confirm what has been built matches the spec. Support client users: Handle routine client questions, support training sessions and office hours, and escalate anything that needs a consultant's judgment. Build the craft: Develop real working knowledge of elasticity modeling, promotional effectiveness measurement, demand transferability and optimization. Learn how the models are built, what drives the results, and where they break, so you can explain outputs to a client, catch errors before they ship, and grow into a consultant role. 

Requirements

2 to 5 years of experience in CPG analytics, category management, revenue growth management support, or a related analytical roleHands-on experience with Point of Sale, syndicated or panel data; Circana data experience preferredStrong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Python, R or SQL preferredAnalytical curiosity: the instinct to ask why a number looks the way it does and the discipline to check before passing it onStrong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines at onceClear written and verbal communication; comfortable working directly with client usersFamiliarity with consumer health, OTC, beauty or personal care categories preferredBachelor's degree required in business, economics, marketing, statistics or a related field

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote within the continental US, working East Coast hours, with the ability to be onsite in Summit, NJ as needed (~5%).

rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Reward ManagerDepartment: People DepartmentReporting to: Head of People Operations & ExperienceDirect reports: Senior Reward AnalystLocation: ManchesterJob Grade: M
DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION
The People Team are role models for the behaviour and values of Channel 4. Our people processes/activities remove complexity and support fast decision making across the organisation.
We understand our people like we understand our viewers – our data and insight allow us to engage with them in the right way, at the right time. We coach and guide the business using best practise to enable them to lead in an engaging and inspiring way.
We work collaboratively across Inclusion, People Operations, People Partnering, Reward, Systems and Talent & Development to support the business in creating a high-performance, inclusive environment that enables Channel 4 to deliver on its remit and produce award-winning content.
JOB PURPOSE
As Reward Manager you will support the delivery of Channel 4’s reward strategy, ensuring reward processes are delivered accurately, consistently and on time. Working closely with the wider People team and Finance, you will help to translate reward priorities into practical plans, processes and guidance that support fair, competitive and well-governed pay and recognition practices.
You will manage the planning, coordination and delivery of cyclical reward activities, including annual pay review, bonus processes, remuneration survey submissions, benchmarking analysis, role evaluation support and mandatory pay gap reporting. You will provide hands-on reward expertise to the People team and business stakeholders, using sound judgement and accurate data to support clear recommendations and robust governance.
You will also contribute to continuous improvement across reward operations, helping to simplify processes, improve employee and manager experience, and ensure reward activity is aligned with Channel 4’s values and commitment to equity and inclusion.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Support the delivery of Channel 4’s reward strategy by translating agreed reward priorities into clear operational plans, processes and guidance.Manage the annual reward cycle, including pay review and bonus processes, ensuring timelines, governance, communications, data inputs and approvals are well coordinated.Partner with People Partners, Finance, Payroll and People Systems to ensure reward activity is delivered accurately, efficiently and in line with agreed controls.Coordinate reward data, modelling and analysis to support pay, bonus, benchmarking and pay equity activity, ensuring outputs are accurate, clearly presented and insight led.Lead market benchmarking activity, including survey participation, data submission, analysis of market outputs and preparation of recommendations for review.Provide practical reward advice and guidance to People Partners and managers on pay decisions, role evaluation, incentives and reward policies, escalating the most complex queries and sensitive matters to the Head of People Operations & Experience as appropriate.Maintain and improve reward processes, templates, guidance and documentation to support consistency, transparency and ease of use.Prepare accurate reward reports, papers and briefing materials for People leadership and governance forums, contributing analysis and recommendations where required.Support the operation and governance of pay frameworks, incentive schemes and reward policies, identifying opportunities to improve clarity, fairness and effectiveness.Work with external suppliers and survey providers, including Willis Towers Watson and Spktral, coordinating activity, data requests, outputs and invoicing within agreed budgets.Monitor relevant reward, pay and employment developments, supporting updates to processes, policies and communications as required.Manage monthly payroll sign-off activity in collaboration with Payroll and Finance, ensuring reward-related changes are accurate and appropriately approved.Line manage and develop the Senior Reward Analyst.
ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE & SKILLS
Strong experience in reward or compensation, with practical experience of delivering annual reward cycles and related processes.Solid understanding of reward principles, pay frameworks, incentive schemes, benchmarking, role evaluation and reward governance.Excellent analytical skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work confidently with complex data, spreadsheets and reporting outputs.Familiarity with WTW Global Grading methodology (or similar) and job evaluation processes.Experience using reward survey data, benchmarking platforms or pay analytics tools.Experience coordinating cross-functional activity or projects with People, Payroll, Finance and Systems teams to deliver accurate and well-controlled outcomes.Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage deadlines, dependencies and competing priorities during cyclical activity.Confident stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain reward processes clearly and build credibility with People colleagues and business stakeholders.Experience preparing clear reports, guidance, briefing notes or presentations using accurate data and concise recommendations.A continuous improvement mindset, with experience improving processes, controls, templates or user guidance.Commitment to fair, inclusive and transparent reward practices that support Channel 4’s remit and values.
DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE & SKILLS
Experience managing or coaching a colleague, including setting priorities, reviewing work and supporting development.Experience in media, broadcasting, creative industries or a similarly complex organisation.Exposure to pay equity analysis, DEI-focused reward activity or gender/ethnicity pay gap reporting.

rows.title: Head of CRM
rows.descriptionText:
Why Join DAZN?
At DAZN, we don't just broadcast sport — we amplify it. We're one of the world's leading sports streaming platforms, and we sit at the heart of two of the most passionate fan communities in global sport — football and boxing.
The Role
As Head of CRM for Global Football & Boxing, you'll be the architect of how we communicate with fans at every stage of their journey at a global scale. From discovery to becoming a passionate subscriber; catching all world title fights, you'll influence the infrastructure, lead strategy and optimise touch points for key DAZN sports.
Football on DAZN combines UEFA Champions League La Lega and Serie A, delivering fans live matches, documentaries, classic games, and original programming from across the football world.
DAZN Boxing is the world's leading boxing streaming destination, home to the biggest fights, the biggest names, and the most passionate fan base in combat sports. From world title fights to emerging talent, DAZN Boxing delivers premium boxing content to fans globally through both subscription and pay-per-view.
CRM sits at the heart of making both propositions sticky, personal and commercially successful.
What You'll Be Doing:
Define and own the global CRM strategy across football and boxing, covering the full customer lifecycle - acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and win-back.Build world-class lifecycle marketing automations for both sports that maximise fan engagement, reduce churn, and grow subscriber and pay-per-view lifetime value.Create integrated CRM calendars, identifying and activating cross-sport CRM opportunities — using data and behavioural insight to introduce football subscribers to boxing content and vice versa, growing overall engagement and reducing churn across the combined baseChampion a fan-first philosophy, driving a personalisation roadmap across platform pop-ups, email, push notification, in-app messaging, and SMS.Driving the team’s full utilisation of CRM tools to improve capability and efficiency in deliveryDevelop specific PPV-focused CRM journeys for boxing - including pre-event hype and awareness, purchase conversion, event-day experience, and post-event follow-up sequencesEnsure CRM communications are localised appropriately for key markets across both sports, working with regional teams and translation partners to maintain relevance and cultural sensitivityWork with regional marketing leads across DAZN's global offices to ensure CRM programmes are adapted and executed effectively at a local level across both sports and cross-sold where possible.
What You'll Bring:
A passion for Sport – we're all fans and so are our customers.Significant CRM leadership experience — ideally at Head of CRM or equivalent senior level — within a fast paced global consumer businessProven track record of building and scaling lifecycle marketing programmes that demonstrably improve retention, engagement, and customer lifetime valueExperience managing CRM across both subscription and transactional/pay-per-view or event-based commercial models — understanding the distinct dynamics of each and how to optimise CRM for bothDeep expertise across CRM channels — email, push, in-app, and SMS — including hands-on experience with enterprise-level CRM and marketing automation platformsStrong data and analytics capability — comfortable working with large datasets, building segmentation models, and interpreting complex performance dataExperience developing and executing personalisation strategies at scale, including working with data science and engineering teams on predictive modellingProven ability to manage complex, cross-functional stakeholder relationships in a global, matrixed organisationExperience working in or alongside a subscription-based, streaming, or content-led businessExcellent communication skills — able to translate complex CRM strategy and data into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholdersHappy to go “all in” – with football and boxing events at evenings and weekends you’ll need to be flexible with working hours.
Benefits
Benefits include access to DAZN, 25 days’ annual leave (increasing by 3 days after 3 years), private medical insurance, life assurance, pension contributions up to 5%, family friendly community including enhanced parental leave, electric vehicle benefit option, learning and development resources, opportunity for flexible working, and access to our internal speaker series and events.
About DAZN
At DAZN, we bring ambition to life. We are innovators, game-changers and pioneers. So, if you want to push boundaries and make an impact, DAZN is the place to be.
As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and the power to make change happen. We're doing things no-one has done before, giving fans and customers access to sport anytime, anywhere. We're using world-class technology to transform sports and revolutionise the industry and we're not going to stop.
DAZN VALUES – THE ‘HOW’ IN WHAT WE DO: 
Agility and creativity fuel growth and innovation, to Make It Happen. 
Prioritising what matters drives progress and positive outcomes, Focusing On Impact. 
Collective ambition builds optimism and success, in order to Win As One. 
At DAZN, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values equality and diversity, where everyone can contribute and have their voices heard. This means hiring and developing talent across all races, ethnicities, religions, age groups, sexual orientations, gender identities and abilities.
If you’d like to include a cover letter with your application, please feel free to. Please do not feel you need to apply with a photo or disclose any other information that is not related to your professional experience.
Our aim is to make our hiring processes as accessible for everyone as possible, including providing adjustments for interviews where we can.
We look forward to hearing from you.

rows.title: Senior Payments Strategy Manager
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on?The Payments platform is the commerce engine behind Roku's transformation from a device company into a streaming platform with more than 100 million households across 15+ countries and $4B+ in annual Platform revenue. Every subscription started with a click of the remote, every movie rented, every Roku-branded device sold, and every shoppable ad tapped mid-show runs through systems this team builds and owns — powering the in-streaming, on-TV purchase experience that's been a primary driver of Roku's exponential subscription growth. The Payments platform supports teams across the company spanning every consumer surface — TV, web, mobile, and advertising — each with its own commerce playbook: Subscription Video on Demand/Transactional Video on Demand (SVOD/TVOD), direct sales of Roku-branded devices, and on-device shoppable ads.What is the role?The Senior Payments Strategy Manager owns the product strategy and roadmap for Roku's Payments Platform end to end — across both the money coming in and the money going out. This is the person who decides which processors, payment methods, wallets, and markets Roku invests in next, builds the business case for each, and then drives the roadmap that delivers them. The role owns the optimization agenda behind Roku's hardest payment numbers — authorization rates, first-payment success, renewal recovery, and payment reliability — working across authorization strategy, intelligent routing, retries and dunning, tokenization, account updater programs, and partner orchestration. It also owns Roku's payment provider and partner relationships day to day, from integrations and migrations through performance management, ensuring each partner's capabilities are productized in a repeatable way rather than rebuilt bespoke every time. Expanding the platform into new payment methods, markets, and regulatory environments runs through this role, in partnership with Consumer Payments PM on consumer demand and prioritization. Success requires deep partnership across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Finance, Legal, and Compliance — and the judgment to tell senior leadership which tradeoffs are worth making and which aren't. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who wants to set the direction of a payments platform at this scale, not just operate one.For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $144,900 - $180,400 annually.Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.What are the responsibilities of the role?Own the full product lifecycle for the Payments Platform, including strategy, roadmap definition, prioritization, execution, launch, and iterative optimization.  Drive platform capabilities that improve authorization rates, first-payment success, renewal recovery, and payment reliability Lead payment optimization initiatives across authorization strategy, intelligent routing, retries/dunning, tokenization, account updater programs, and partner orchestration.  Own payment provider/PSP strategy and commercial relationships end to end, including commercial alignment, integrations, migrations, roadmap coordination, performance management, and ongoing optimization.  Manage payment partnerships end to end, including partner strategy, relationship management, commercial and capability alignment, integrations, migrations, performance reviews, and ongoing enhancements, ensuring partner capabilities are productized in a scalable and repeatable way. Expand platform support for new payment methods, markets, and regulatory requirements in partnership with Consumer Payments PM on consumer demand and prioritization Partner closely with Product, Analytics and Data Science teams to drive experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, and data-driven optimization.  Serve as the primary lead for payments platform initiatives across the subscription commerce ecosystem Communicate roadmap priorities, platform performance, operational risks, and strategic tradeoffs to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?10+ years of Product Management experience, with significant ownership of payments, subscription commerce, billing, checkout, or financial platform products at scaleDeep expertise across the payments ecosystem, including payment gateways, processors, tokenization, network tokens, digital wallets, recurring billing, subscription recovery, retries and dunning, fraud and risk controls, and payment optimization strategiesProven experience leading large-scale payment platform initiatives that materially improved authorization rates, conversion, retention, payment recovery, or payments cost efficiencyStrong understanding of payment orchestration concepts, including intelligent routing, retry optimization, processor performance management, and multi-partner payment ecosystemsExperience operating global payment systems across multiple markets, payment methods, currencies, regulatory environments, and regional payment preferencesDemonstrated success managing external payment partners, including commercial alignment, integrations, migrations, escalations, roadmap influence, and performance optimizationStrong analytical and experimentation background, including A/B testing, KPI development, funnel optimization, and data-driven prioritizationExperience balancing growth, customer experience, reliability, operational scalability, financial integrity, and risk management within a high-volume commerce environmentProven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, Finance, Data, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Business teamsStrong executive communication skills, including experience presenting platform strategy, business cases, operational risks, and performance insights to senior leadershipExperience working in high-scale subscription, streaming, marketplace, fintech, ecommerce, or digital commerce environmentsTechnical fluency with modern commerce and payments architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and platform scalability considerationsBachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

rows.title: Head of AI Transformation | S5 | Data & AI Domain | London & Milton Keynes
rows.descriptionText:
Country: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE

Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

The Data & AI Domain at Santander is responsible for setting the strategic direction for data, analytics, and artificial intelligence across the organisation. It ensures that data is managed as a trusted enterprise asset and that advanced technologies are applied responsibly, securely, and effectively to create value for customers and the business.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE 

The Data & AI Domain is looking for a Head of AI Transformation based out of London and Milton Keynes.

The Head of AI Transformation is responsible for leading Santander UK’s enterprise-wide adoption of artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to drive business transformation. This role oversees the data science and AI function, ensuring the effective development, deployment, and scaling of AI capabilities across the organisation.

The role holder partners with senior business, technology, risk, and operations leaders to define and execute a strategic AI transformation roadmap aligned to Santander Group priorities and UK business objectives. They are accountable for embedding AI-driven decision-making into core processes, accelerating value creation, and ensuring robust governance, ethical standards, and regulatory compliance across all AI initiatives.

This individual plays a critical leadership role in translating cutting-edge AI capabilities into tangible business outcomes, fostering a culture of innovation, and positioning Santander UK as a leader in responsible AI adoption within the financial services sector.

They are a member of the Data and AI Domain UK Leadership team, are part of the global AI Leadership team and a key influencers of strategic direction for Santander UK We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

Responsibilities

AI Transformation Strategy & Roadmap Define, own, and deliver the Santander UK AI transformation strategy and roadmap, aligned with Group direction and UK business priorities. Leadership of Data Science & AI Function Lead and develop the UK data science and AI teams, ensuring high performance, strong technical capability, and alignment to strategic outcomes. Enterprise AI Adoption Drive the adoption of AI and advanced analytics across business units, embedding AI into key customer journeys, operations, and decision-making processes. Deployment of Group AI Products Lead the localisation, deployment, and scaling of Santander Group AI products within the UK business, ensuring relevance, performance, and value delivery. Business Value Realisation Ensure AI initiatives deliver measurable business impact, including revenue growth, cost optimisation, risk reduction, and improved customer experience. 

What You’ll Bring

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Professional Experience

AI Product / Operating Model (Required):

Shapes an enterprise operating model that enables rapid and responsible delivery of AI products and capabilities. Champions agile, product-led ways of working across business and technology teams to accelerate value realisation. Balances delivery speed with governance, risk management and regulatory requirements. 

Enterprise transformation enabled by AI (Required):

Defines and delivers enterprise AI transformation aligned to business strategy and Santander Group priorities. Identifies opportunities to redesign customer journeys, operations and decision-making through AI and advanced analytics. Leads organisational change required to embed AI capabilities and realise measurable business outcomes. 

Technical capability (AI/ML) (Required):

Demonstrates deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science and advanced analytics, with the ability to translate emerging technologies into scalable business solutions and strategic outcomes. Provides technical leadership and governance across the AI lifecycle, ensuring solutions are designed, deployed and operated in line with regulatory requirements, model risk standards, security, and Responsible AI principles. Maintains a strong understanding of modern AI platforms, data architectures, cloud technologies and MLOps practices, enabling informed decisions on technology strategy, vendor selection, and enterprise AI capability development 

Banking Products and Services (Required):

Demonstrates strong understanding of UK retail and commercial banking products, customer journeys and value drivers. Identifies opportunities where AI and analytics can improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency and risk management. Partners with business leaders to embed AI into core products, processes and services 

Cross-functional Collaboration (Required):

Knowledge of collaborative techniques and approaches; ability to promote a culture of continuous improvement and working together across functions to solve business problems and meet business goals. Uses specific network of leaderships or experts to help achieve organizational and client goals. Builds trusted partnerships across Business, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Operations to drive enterprise AI adoption. Influences senior executives across Santander UK and Santander Group to align priorities and accelerate delivery. Creates a collaborative environment that enables delivery of cross-functional transformation programmes. 

Decision Making and Critical Thinking (Required):

Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyse situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Makes strategic investment decisions balancing business value, technical feasibility and regulatory obligations. Evaluates competing AI opportunities and prioritises initiatives delivering the greatest enterprise value. Applies sound judgement in managing technology, operational, conduct and model risks. 

Communicating for Impact (Required):

Communicates a compelling vision for AI transformation across all organisational levels. Influences Executive Committee and Board stakeholders through clear, evidence-based recommendations. Builds confidence in AI through transparent communication of opportunities, risks and outcomes. Interprets business plans or solutions to top management to gain both collective intelligence and support. 

Strategic Thinking (Required):

Knowledge of the importance of "big picture" thinking and planning; ability to apply organizational acumen and competitiveness to identify and maintain focus on key success factors for the organization. Directs strategic alliances and partnerships for mutual benefit. Develops long-term AI strategy aligned with business priorities, emerging technologies and market trends. Anticipates regulatory, competitive and technological developments to position Santander UK as a leader in responsible AI. Creates strategic partnerships that accelerate AI capability and innovation. 

Team Management (Required):

Leads and develops high-performing multidisciplinary teams including Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Product Managers and AI Specialists. Builds organisational capability in AI through coaching, succession planning and talent development. Creates an inclusive, innovative culture that attracts and retains leading AI talent. 

Technical & Non-Technical Skills/Knowledge

Significant leadership experience in AI, Data Science or Advanced Analytics within a large, complex organisation. Demonstrable experience defining and delivering enterprise AI or digital transformation strategies. Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, Responsible AI and financial services regulation. Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and building high-performing AI capabilities. Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and deliver complex cross-functional transformation programmes. Strong commercial acumen with experience delivering measurable business value from AI and analytics investments. Knowledge of modern AI platforms, cloud technologies, MLOps and enterprise data architectures. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including engagement with Executive Committees and Board-level governance. 

Education

Undergraduate degree in business or similar related field or substantial and relevant work experience supported by professional certifications/licences (Required)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.

Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.

30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 31 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year. £8,500 car allowance per year. Company funded private medical insurance for you and your familyCompany funded Health screenings every two years. Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover. Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans. As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and servicesCompetitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring. Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support. Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support. Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve. Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network. 

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE

At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.

We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.

We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.

To make this possible, our roles are site-based with a hybrid working pattern, where colleagues are expected to attend the office at least 12 days per month (pro-rata for part-time roles).

When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen office location(s).

Right to work in the UK

Every individual must have the right to work in the UK to commence employment with Santander either by way of nationality, visa or work permit. If you do require a working visa / permit this will not influence our decision on whether to progress your application. However, if you do not have a right to work, or an application for a working visa / permit is unsuccessful, Santander will not proceed with your application and will withdraw any conditional offer previously made. 

We welcome applications on the understanding that, should you be offered this role, there may be no relocation package available. Santander will pay the employer mandatory government fees that are required to pay in connection with visa sponsorship. You may be liable for your own personal employee immigration and relocation costs.

What To Do Next

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

If there’s anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it’s a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we’re available through email. You can contact us at resourcing@santander.co.uk.

rows.title: Data Scientist, Private Banking & Wealth Management (PBWM)
rows.descriptionText:

Uber's Marketplace Matching team builds the real-time decision systems that determine how riders and drivers are matched across a global, two-sided marketplace. These decisions happen under uncertainty, at massive scale, and with competing short- and long-term objectives across marketplace efficiency, reliability, sustainable growth, user value, and quality of experience.

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to help define and build the next generation of matching optimization systems. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, sequential decision-making, optimization, control, and marketplace dynamics. You will own major optimization charters, set technical direction, and lead ambiguous 0→1 problems from formulation through large-scale production deployment. rows.title: Sr Product Manager - Enterprise Risk
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Product Manager, Enterprise & Payment Risk

About The Role

Uber's Risk team is critical to enabling trusted growth across our global marketplace by preventing fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Enterprise (B2B) accounts are a major and fast-growing part of that marketplace, and managing their risk is one of the most structurally complex domains in Payment Risk.

In this senior, high-impact individual contributor role, the Product Manager for Enterprise & Payment Risk will own the full risk lifecycle of B2B entities at scale - from onboarding and information acquisition, through manual review processes, to real-time risk decisioning at checkout and payment. The role also owns the underlying account and billing infrastructure that enterprise risk decisions run on, and the recovery/verification experiences enterprise customers rely on when something goes wrong.

A defining challenge of this role is that the enterprise customer base spans many distinct cohorts, each with a different risk tolerance and a different sensitivity to friction and actioning. Success requires calibrating risk treatment differently across these cohorts rather than applying a single, one-size-fits-all policy - balancing fraud prevention against growth and satisfaction for legitimate business customers. This is the most stakeholder-intensive scope in the Payment Risk organization, requiring close, sustained partnership with business/BD leadership in addition to Engineering, Data Science, and platform teams.

This position is ideal for a senior product leader who thrives in ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces, has strong command of B2B/enterprise payment or billing systems, and can drive outcomes through influence across a large and often-competing set of stakeholders and shared engineering capacity.

What The Candidate Will Do

Own the B2B entity risk lifecycle end-to-end at scale: onboarding and information acquisition, manual review workflows, and real-time risk decisioning at checkout and payment.Segment and calibrate risk policy across distinct enterprise customer cohorts, each with different risk tolerance and sensitivity to friction/actioning.Define the product requirements and roadmap for enterprise risk capabilities, including underlying account and billing infrastructure modernization and its associated cross-functional dependencies.Own recovery and verification experiences for enterprise customers, including fallback challenges, admin verification, and cross-party messaging.Partner with Engineering and Data Science to scope and land payment authorization and decisioning improvements against concrete loss-reduction targets.Triage, prioritize, and negotiate a high volume of cross-functional dependency requests against shared and constrained engineering capacity.Build and maintain trusted relationships with business/BD stakeholders, translating enterprise account needs into a risk product roadmap.Measure impact using well-defined KPIs (e.g., loss-rate reduction, authorization effectiveness, dispute/chargeback rates) and iterate based on learnings.Coordinate with Risk Operations, Risk Governance/Compliance, and payments platform teams to ensure solutions are practical, compliant, and operationally sound.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of product management experience delivering software products as an individual contributor in a technology company.Experience owning a complex, technically deep product domain (e.g., payments, billing, risk, or platform infrastructure) with significant stakeholder breadth.Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and measure impact.Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex problems simply to both technical and business audiences.Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Business/BD, Design, and Operations, including negotiating priority against shared/constrained resources.Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data/Analytics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).

Preferred Qualifications

Risk & Fraud Domain Expertise - Experience in risk, fraud, or trust & safety within a B2B/enterprise or multi-sided marketplace, particularly billing risk, checkout/payment decisioning, or auth-hold systems.B2B/Enterprise Product Ownership - Prior ownership of a product serving business or organizational accounts (rather than purely consumer-facing products), including billing configuration, credit management, or account administration.Business Acumen - Demonstrated ability to drive P&L improvements through loss reduction or account-health initiatives, with strong intuition for how risk interventions affect the broader business.Strategic Judgment - Strong product instincts for navigating ambiguous, structurally complex problem spaces and balancing competing constraints across risk, business, engineering capacity, and compliance.Advanced Business Education - MBA or equivalent business experience.

Extra notes:

Prefer candidates with prior experience in engineering, data scientist, consulting, finance, or a B2B/enterprise SaaS product role before moving into PM, given the domain's billing/payments complexity.

About The Role & Team

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Software Engineer (ML Data & Backend) , you will architect mission-critical systems that power the foundation of trust across our global marketplace-from ensuring millions of earners are paid accurately and on time to scaling the simulation platforms that drive billions in pricing decisions. The problems here are complex, the systems are massive, and the pace is fast. You'll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information and own your work end-to-end: from the first design doc to debugging production issues when the stakes are highest. We are looking for technical powerhouses who think in systems, stay calm under pressure, and care about building things that actually work. If you're energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact-this is where you'll grow.

What You'll Do

 System Design & Architecture: Design and build long-lasting engineering artifacts that reduce complexity and increase developer velocity across the organization. Foresee architectural problems or opportunities and work with leadership to address them before they impact the global marketplace.  Complex Problem Solving: Solve messy, high-impact problems at the intersection of low latency and high correctness, often without a clear starting point or obvious solution.  Technical Leadership: Lead organization-wide development and adoption of key frameworks while role-modeling coding best practices and high-quality design reviews.  Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Science, and Ops to translate ambiguous business requirements into production-ready technical roadmaps.  Mentorship & Culture: Mentor and guide other engineers, acting as a technical brand ambassador and raising the bar for engineering excellence across the organization. 

 Basic Qualifications 

Role

 6+ years of experience building developing ML models to solve business problem.  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.  Familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Tensorflow).  Hands-on experience developing foundational models or Large Language Models (LLMs) for user facing applications, marketplace systems, recommendation engines, ad-tech platforms, or e-commerce/shopping infrastructures at scale.  Solid understanding of core machine learning algorithms, their applications, and the underlying systems/infrastructures required to train and serve them.  Proven track record in MLOps and ML Infrastructure (e.g., container orchestration via Kubernetes, data pipeline design, distributed workflow systems, and large-scale job scheduling).

Strong fluency in system trade-offs between consistency, availability, latency, and operational cost.  Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber's vision of igniting opportunity by setting the world in motion depends on our customers seamlessly paying for goods and services and our ability to reliably pay our partners. Additionally, we must ensure that each commerce interaction is accurately recorded and transparent to all parties involved.

The Uber Payments Platform team is an integral part of realizing that vision. Money is a sensitive topic for every interaction on our marketplaces. Our mission is to ensure the experience of paying and being paid is as frictionless, personal, and ubiquitous as possible. As a PM on the Uber Payments Platform team, you'll be responsible for helping shape this experience and growing the platform, thus enabling the foundation for the growth of Uber's overall business!

Uber's Payments Platform is a ledger that orchestrates the movement of money between all users on our marketplaces (riders, drivers, couriers, restaurants, eaters, shippers, carriers, etc.), processing orders at the scale of tens of millions per day. Being the core platform orchestrating all money movements in our marketplaces, it's essential to ensure the platform is reliable enough to handle the scale of our operations while versatile and flexible enough to handle the ever-growing use cases we offer through our different lines of business.

Basic Qualifications

 3+ years of experience with Platform Product Management experience.  Proven passion for building platforms and products at scale.  Strong technical fluency and comfort in discussing technology concepts and an ability to collaborate effectively with software engineering teams.  Proven product/business sense-you can see how impacting one lever in a sophisticated system affects many others.  Not afraid to dive into metrics and data whether it's to diagnose a problem, evaluate a solution, or propose a new critical metric. You have experience using analytics tools.

rows.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber Freight Marketplace is building the next generation of logistics technology by leveraging Uber's proven marketplace playbook to freight. As part of a small, high-impact team, you'll help bring expertise from Uber's mobility and delivery marketplaces into a rapidly evolving industry, developing pricing, matching, recommendation, and optimization systems that will disrupt the freight industry ($1T TAM). Uber Freight is at a very early stage, with just 0.4% of the pie now, and it's a rare opportunity to solve challenging marketplace problems with AI/ML and marketplace optimization while shaping how the freight industry transforms.

We are looking for a highly motivated Machine Learning Engineer to join Uber's Marketplace team to modernize the Uber Freight marketplace team. It is a fascinating area with challenges in predictive modeling, causal inference, constrained optimization, reinforcement learning, marketplace design, etc. The business is about to elevate and this role has a huge growing opportunity.

rows.title: Senior Compensation Analyst, Mergers & Acquisitions
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Compensation M&A team at Uber is seeking an experienced compensation professional to support compensation due diligence, harmonization modeling, and post-close integration for M&A transactions. This individual will play a critical role in evaluating compensation structures at target companies, assessing financial implications of harmonizing with Uber's compensation philosophy, and overseeing compensation program management for existing subsidiaries. What You'll Do

 Support compensation workstreams during M&A transactions, including due diligence and integrations (including data intake, validation, benchmarking, and risk identification)  Evaluate target companies' compensation philosophy and structure (base pay, variable pay, equity, sales incentives, and benefits) to identify gaps, compliance risks, and areas requiring remediation  Develop compensation diligence summaries and financial impact assessments for Corporate Development, Finance, HR leadership, and business leadership  Partner with People M&A, Legal, and Finance teams to align diligence findings with broader deal strategy 

 Compensation Harmonization Analysis 

 Model the financial impact of aligning target company roles and incumbents to Uber's job architecture, compensation ranges, and pay-for-performance frameworks  Conduct market benchmarking to determine appropriate compensation positioning for acquired employees across geographies and job functions  Build scenarios that quantify cost implications of harmonization decisions, including salary adjustments, bonus targets, equity transitions, and special retention programs  Provide clear, data-driven recommendations that balance competitiveness, consistency, cost management, and employee experience 

 Post-Close Integration & Subsidiary Compensation Management 

 Manage compensation programs for existing subsidiaries, supporting local HR teams with salary structures, job mapping, and governance processes  Ensure subsidiaries' compensation practices remain aligned with Uber's philosophy, ranges, policies, and compliance standards  Monitor compensation trends and identify integration risks or misalignments over time, proposing corrective actions as necessary 

 Analytics, Reporting & Governance 

 Build and maintain analytical models, dashboards, and templates used in M&A diligence and harmonization processes  Maintain documentation and repeatable processes to improve operational efficiency and scale compensation integration practices across transactions  Partner with Legal to ensure compliance with local labor regulations, pay equity requirements, and statutory obligations 

 Basic Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in Finance, HR, Economics, Business, or related field  3+ years of experience in compensation, HR analytics, corporate finance, or consulting; experience supporting M&A transactions strongly preferred  Advanced proficiency in data modeling and analysis tools (Excel/Google Sheets required) 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with compensation market data sources (Radford, Mercer, WTW, etc.)  Experience with job architecture frameworks  Prior experience conducting compensation due diligence or supporting integrations in a corporate or consulting environment.  Strong understanding of compensation design principles, global market practices, and governance.  Ability to interpret complex compensation structures and synthesize them into concise, executive-ready insights.  Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly working cross-functionally with HR, Finance, Legal, and Corporate Development.  Exceptional analytical and modeling skills, with the ability to quantify and communicate the implications of compensation decisions.  A solutions-oriented approach and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-paced deal environments with shifting priorities.  Strong written and verbal communication skills suitable for senior and executive audiences.  A commitment to harmonizing compensation practices in a way that supports Uber's philosophy while managing cost, equity, and compliance.

About The Team And Role

eBay Live is a new way to sell on eBay, enabling real-time interaction between buyers and sellers through live video. Through consistent, engaging live streams, sellers build trust, expand their customer base, and grow repeat business. eBay Live blends commerce and entertainment to create differentiated, high-trust shopping experiences at scale.

We are seeking a Head of Trading Cards – eBay Live to lead and scale one of eBay’s most established, strategically important, and competitive categories in live commerce: Trading Cards. This role is responsible for defining and executing the category strategy for Trading Cards on eBay Live, accelerating growth across supply, demand, content, trust, and product innovation.

This is a highly visible, GM-style leadership role with end-to-end accountability across supply, demand, content, trust, and product innovation.

To learn more, visit: https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive/

What You Will Accomplish

Own Category P&L & Business Outcomes

Deliver ambitious GMV and revenue targets for Trading Cards on eBay Live.Act as General Manager for your categories, with accountability for both topline and bottom-line performanceOwn budget management, including seller incentives, marketing, and programming investments to maximize ROI


Define & Execute Category Strategy

Drive Supply Growth & Seller Success

Define assortment strategy, including target buyer segments and inventory profilesSet clear criteria for seller selection and onboarding using analytics, pattern recognition, and merchant intuitionPartner with Business Development to recruit, onboard, and scale high-potential sellersNegotiate complex commercial agreements and incentive structures with sellers and vendors


Build Compelling Live Commerce Experiences

Lead the creation of entertaining, high-conversion live content tailored to different shopping and entertainment “modes”Develop and continuously refine run-of-show playbooks that push the boundaries of live shoppingEnsure eBay Live stands apart in Trading Cards through trusted sellers, strong inventory, differentiated programming, and a buyer experience rooted in confidence and fun.


Lead at Scale, Cross-Functionally

Lead a diverse cross-functional group including Business Development, onboarding, account management, programming, operations, and product partnersInfluence senior stakeholders across eBay to align resources, remove blockers, and deliver category outcomes.Drive execution with the rigor of an operator and the adaptability of a startup founderBuild, hire, coach, and retain a high-performing direct team (5–10), including entrepreneurial category managers as new verticals are launchedEvolve team structure, operating rhythms, and category processes as Trading Cards scales on eBay Live


What You’ll Bring

$126,800 - $204,000

rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Media Sales Specialist will work directly with recognized brands, agencies, and vendor partners to secure advertising revenue and establish themselves as a trusted resource for clients. The Specialist manages their own accounts and collaborates with Sales Leads to support larger accounts. They are responsible for developing sales-related materials including presentations, RFPs, custom proposals, etc. Seeking input from cross-functional teams (including Media, Analytics, Product, and Finance) as required, the Specialist ensures the team's main objective of maximizing sales revenues while ensuring utmost client satisfaction is met. This presents a unique opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment while benefiting from the resources, organizational support, and existing vendor relationships of an industry leader.

What You Will Do

Contribute to building a pipeline of prospective accounts by identifying and nurturing leads.Cultivate relationships to expand and develop client accounts.Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to create sales collateral, presentations, project plans, and account setup information.Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., media planning, operations, analytics) to devise marketing strategies for both on-site and off-site initiatives.Provide exceptional customer service to clients by promptly responding to requests and ensuring availability for follow-up questions.Analyze campaign results to identify opportunities for enhancing client satisfaction and performance.Listen actively to advertisers' needs and generate innovative ideas to enhance and optimize the offerings of Macy’s Media Network, feeding insights to the product development team.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities

Skills You Will Need

Sales and Negotiation: Proven ability to secure advertising revenue and build strong relationships with recognized brands, agencies, and vendor partners.

Customer Service: Exceptional customer service skills, including prompt responsiveness to client requests and thorough follow-up to ensure client satisfaction.

Analytical Skills: Capability to analyze campaign results and identify opportunities for enhancing client satisfaction and performance, demonstrating a data-driven approach to decision-making.

Online Advertising Expertise: Deep knowledge of the online advertising space, including exchange and audience-based selling, with experience in retail media highly desired.

Communication and Presentation: Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, essential for effectively conveying ideas and proposals to clients and stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management: Experience managing multiple stakeholders, such as vendors, marketing agencies, and media owners, as well as cross-functional teams, to ensure project success and alignment with objectives.

Detail-Oriented: Strong attention to detail in marketing activities, including the development of sales collateral, presentations, reports, and project plans, to ensure accuracy and professionalism.

Who You Are

Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 3-5 years of ad sales experience for on- and off-site media, including selling into agencies. This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discounts Performance-based incentives Annual merit review Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

rows.title: 2027 Merchandising Internship - Brooklyn
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DESCRIPTION 

WILLIAMS-SONOMA, INC. MERCHANDISING INTERNSHIP 2027

We designed our program to be a game-changing first step in kicking off your career journey. We're looking for the next generation of home merchandisers who want to bring fresh ideas and perspectives to our brands. During this 10-week program, you'll develop your skills alongside a team of supportive mentors and inspiring leaders.

Merchandising blends creativity, analytics, and marketing  to drive customer engagement and profitability. As an intern, you'll work closely with a team for a specific category (ex: furniture, tabletop, bath, etc) to get behind the scenes insight on how they create product strategies, manage pricing, and interpret data. You'll use this to develop your own new product recommendations.

ABOUT YOU


 Passionate about product, home decor, and retail  Keep up with home design trends  Currently in your junior year of an undergraduate program  Minimum GPA of 3.5  Able to work onsite at our West Elm Office in Brooklyn  Know how to prioritize and move quickly to react to our ever-changing business  Think strategically and critically to solve problems  Have Excel experience: vlooks-ups, pivot tables, etc… 


OUR PROGRAM

Our program is designed for undergraduate students graduating in 2028. During your internship, you will be a part of an intern cohort working at West Elm in Brooklyn. Throughout the program, you will attend business critical meetings, lead projects, gain experience working with cross-functional teams, attend professional trainings, and have the chance to brainstorm with our leadership team.

At the end of the program, you are given the opportunity to pioneer a new idea and present it to our executive leadership team. Many of our interns' project proposals have been implemented in new business strategies, as we value the fresh perspective our interns bring to the business.

Of course, we also leave time for a little fun by hosting social and networking opportunities with your fellow interns such as cohort lunches, and social hours.

WHEN

Our 10 week program runs June 7th - August 13th (start date is flexible for students on the quarter system).

WHERE

Brooklyn, NY. Onsite 4x a week.

ABOUT US

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a global, multi-channel retailer of home furnishings and housewares (our family of brands includes Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn teen, west elm, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark & Graham), but we operate within smaller teams, giving each person an opportunity for hands-on experience. Together, our brands represent a strong, diverse and growing portfolio that allow us to reach customers in a new way every day - and we'd love your help.

Our Performance Driven Culture Is Best Described As Entrepreneurial, Collaborative, And Purpose Driven. Our Teams Are Filled With Smart And Innovative People Who Have Helped Us Achieve Such Accolades Such As:


 American Innovation Index Top 25 Most Innovative Companies, 2023  Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable U.S. Companies, 2023  Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces, 2023  Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces for Women, 2022  Newsweek’s America’s Best Customer Service, 2024  Time World’s Best Companies, 2024  Fortune 500 List, 2022 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration 

 The expected starting pay range for this position is $22-$26 hourly. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities. 

 ABOUT US 

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.
