rows.title: Data Product Manager (contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

Hybrid role in our Dallas, TX or McLean, VA office working onsite 3 days/week***

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to drive the strategy, development, and delivery of data reporting tools and data products within our Analytics Product organization. This role requires a unique blend of product and project management expertise, with a deep understanding of data product lifecycles that differ from traditional software development. You will lead one or more focus teams, partnering closely with analytics, business, data, and external stakeholders across Marketing, Loyalty, CRM, Digital, and MarTech to define roadmaps, manage timelines, and ensure the successful delivery of impactful data solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for a forward-thinking professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, embraces continuous learning, and is passionate about evolving commercial analytics capabilities to enhance the customer experience.

Responsibilities

 Partner with analytics, business, data, and external partners to articulate the Marketing, Loyalty, and MarTech data transformation vision, and communicate timelines, opportunities, and challenges Lead Marketing, Loyalty, and MarTech project and product management activities for development lifecycles, including product definition, roadmap, scope, and budget management across multiple focus teams Provide inputs to value measurement processes, capturing data product wins and impact, and building content to socialize results across the organization Act as a Data Subject Matter Expert to provide input, clarity, and requirements to cross-functional teams Partner with multiple business areas across CRM, Digital, Loyalty, MarTech, and Marketing to leverage data in understanding business problems and identifying the tools and datasets necessary for delivery Review and prioritize data enhancement requests and ongoing development activities to ensure alignment with organizational goals Track and report progress, define project deliverables, and ensure transparency of delivery timelines while proactively managing scope changes, identifying potential risks, and devising contingency plans Maintain communications for governing bodies and interested parties, and communicate project expectations to team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear manner Apply analytical skills to examine data and ideas, identify assumptions, and obtain detailed information to support the planning of Marketing and Loyalty solutions and technology products Provide critical thinking to incorporate emerging trends and innovative technologies into recommendations that support the enhancement and improvement of the customer experience Demonstrate creative problem-solving to address complex challenges and deliver innovative solutions in a fast-paced environment Partner closely with CRM on the Master Data Management workstream, supporting the development of a Customer Data Platform to serve as the source of truth and foundational identity resolution for MarTech systems Develop a strong understanding of competitor capabilities and strategies specific to the dynamic content space Partner on the implementation of new data capabilities and coordinate integrations into existing Marketing and Loyalty tools for delivery and handoff to operational teams

Skills

 Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive relationships, exhibit tact, and earn trust across all levels of the organization Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex information to diverse audiences Creative and flexible problem-solving abilities with a proven track record of finding innovative solutions to complex challenges Self-starter mentality with the initiative to exceed goals, strong analytical capabilities, and adaptability to change High level of accountability with the ability to take ownership of projects, communicate results effectively, and recommend meaningful improvements Effective risk management and root cause analysis skills Familiarity with business intelligence tools including MicroStrategy and Tableau Familiarity with project management tools including Jira and Smartsheets Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and statistical skills Experience collaborating directly with data developers, cloud technology delivery teams, and business customers

Experience

 4+ years of professional experience driving timeline and delivery performance in engineering, analytics, or technical projects 4+ years of experience creating and analyzing management reports 3+ years of project and/or product management experience, including requirement gathering, roadmapping, and assessing and mitigating quality issues 2+ years of experience working with data representation, storytelling, analyses, and modeling 5+ years of professional experience preferred Experience working in data and analytics as a project manager and/or product owner preferred Experience working in the hospitality or travel industry is a plus

Qualifications

 Bachelor's Degree preferred MBA or Master's degree in an analytically-oriented field preferred

This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy within one of the world's most recognized hospitality brands. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of commercial analytics, influencing how data-driven decisions are made across Marketing, Loyalty, and MarTech functions at a global scale. If you are a motivated, analytically minded professional who is energized by solving complex problems and driving meaningful impact through data, this role offers the challenge, visibility, and growth potential to take your career to the next level.

Pay Rate Range

55 - 65 USD hourly

rows.title: Manager, Website Merchandising - GreenRow
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

We are a small scrappy team that’s passionate about beautiful and sustainable product. We are responsible for delivering a superior site experience for the customer by using data and customer insights to deliver easy friction free, inspiring product discovery and helpful, intuitive, content-rich product pages.

About The Role

The Manager, Website Operations + Merchandising has oversight of the day-to-day operations of the website, ensuring that all site initiatives are successfully executed according to established timelines and best practices. You will also play a pivotal role in driving the merchandising strategies for our channel, utilizing site analytics to enhance the overall customer experience. This role will work with cross-functional teams to continuously drive operational excellence and a superior online experience. The position will serve as a brand leader and customer advocate. This position reports directly to the Head of E-Commerce.

This role is onsite in San Francisco 4x a week.

Responsibilities


Leverage understanding of web design principles, technical capabilities, consumer behavior, and operational processes to develop and drive website strategies to increase conversion, improve customer experience, and improve how the product assortment is represented.Build webpages and launch content for marketing, merchandising, etc. as needed. Collaborate with IT, Creative, Marketing, Merchandising, and Development teams to execute critical site enhancements, product launches, and promotional campaigns.End-to-end project management of seasonal product and feature. Troubleshoot and/or escalate website issues and see them through to resolution.Proactively review the site with a customer-first mindset, identifying operational and customer experience problems, while suggesting and delivering solutions. Fully test/QA/UAT all site initiatives prior to launching to the website -- prioritizing any issues found to be fixed and subsequently validated.Represent brand requirements and priorities while serving as primary or secondary lead on IT governance roadmap projects.Build and maintain strong relationships across all channels within the brand, other WSI brands, and shared services teams.Flexible schedule that can accommodate off hour/cadence site launches and technical issue triaging.Monitor and analyze website traffic, user behavior, and conversion metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement data-driven optimizations.Establish streamlined processes in co-ordination with cross-functional teams to facilitate the execution of seasonal launches, ensuring timely and accurate implementation.Conduct regular audits of product listings and ensure accurate and up-to-date product information, including pricing, descriptions, and images.Maintain clear and consistent communication of deliverables to cross-functional partners, fostering collaboration and alignment across departments.Conduct regular analysis of weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reports to identify growth opportunities and inform strategic decisions for the channel.Support cross-functional projects and initiatives as needed, contributing expertise in website merchandising and customer experience.Stay informed about industry best practices, competitor activities, and emerging trends in eCommerce and website merchandising, incorporating relevant insights into strategy development.Stay abreast of web best practices, competitive landscape, and overall business goals in order to recommend process improvements and/or enhancements for content management systems, site platform and front-end site experience.


Criteria


Bachelor’s degree required5+ years in an e-commerce/website operations/web merchandising roleStrong affinity for the product and brandProject management skills and ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneouslyPrevious experience managing a team with direct reportsAbility to adapt and respond with a sense of urgency in a fast paced and evolving working environmentStrong knowledge of web development, lifecycle and processes is a mustCreative problem solving and analytical skills requiredExcellent communication skills are a must, including the ability to break down complex concepts, interface with executive leadership as well as developersDemonstrated ability to be a team player and drive resultsAbility to lead projects effectively and with minimal supervision and keen attention to detailContent management system experience requiredExperience with project/story management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, etc requiredExperience with Adobe Analytics and/or Test & Target suite is a plusProven analytical and business planning skills.Able to make timely decisions, anticipate problems, and provide creative solutions.Well-organized and detail-orientedExcellent written and verbal communication skillsStrong quantitative skillsExperience creating PowerPoint presentations.Intermediate Excel skills (working knowledge with pivot tables and v-lookups


Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits Tax-free commuter benefits A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-development Advisor (Mentor) program Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series

rows.title: Quality Assurance Specialist, FIU

parsed.text: Salt Lake City, UT, United States

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

At eBay, our Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) plays an important role in protecting the integrity of our global marketplace by advancing a strong and effective Anti-Money Laundering / Counter Terrorist Financing (AML/CTF) compliance program. The team helps prevent, detect, and respond to money laundering, terrorist financing, and related financial crime risks while supporting a culture of compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement across the business.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing FIU team as a Quality Assurance Specialist supporting high-impact investigative and compliance work. Reporting to the FIU Quality Assurance Manager, this role helps strengthen the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of FIU investigations by reviewing case work, assessing suspicious activity reporting decisions, and supporting strong regulatory outcomes. As a secondary responsibility, this role also performs in-depth Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) escalation reviews to assess financial crime risk to eBay and our brand. This position is well suited for someone who brings strong AML investigative experience, sound judgment, and a collaborative mindset, and who is energized by improving both processes and tools in a fast-paced environment.

What You Will Accomplish

Strengthen the quality and consistency of FIU investigations by reviewing suspicious activity case work, including SAR and No SAR decisions, for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements.Support the preparation and filing of suspicious activity reports with FinCEN and other applicable regulatory bodies, helping ensure timely, well-documented, and compliant reporting.Conduct detailed research across internal and external sources to identify financial crime risk indicators, develop clear investigative findings, and contribute to strong case outcomes.Partner with FIU investigators and cross-functional stakeholders to identify and apply AML typologies, investigative techniques, and analytics that improve the effectiveness of the investigations program.Perform and support reviews of escalated AML and EDD matters, including PEP reviews, Special Interest Person escalations, registration model alerts, and periodic EDD reviews, helping assess risk and determine appropriate next steps.Contribute to continuous improvement by helping scope and enhance investigative tools, case management workflows, and related analytics that support efficient, scalable FIU operations.


What You Will Bring

4+ years of experience investigating money laundering, terrorist financing, or related financial crime in a BSA/AML compliance, regulatory, or law enforcement environment, along with 2+ years of quality assurance review experience.Knowledge of BSA/AML laws and regulations, reporting and record retention requirements, OFAC compliance, and international AML/CFT standards, with the ability to apply regulatory changes to investigative and quality review processes.Strong analytical, investigative research, writing, and documentation skills, with the ability to assess complex information, exercise sound judgment, and communicate clearly in time-sensitive situations.Experience reviewing complex case work, assessing risk indicators and typologies, and supporting escalation reviews such as PEP, SIP, registration alerts, and periodic EDD reviews.Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Access, including use of pivot tables; Tableau experience is preferred, and Microsoft Visio or omniGraffle experience is required.Ability to work with a high degree of professionalism, discretion, and agility in a fast-paced environment while building strong relationships across FIU, Compliance, and external partners; AML or fraud-related certification such as CAMS, CFCS, CFE, or similar is preferred.


Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$71,600 - $123,400

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We designed our program to be a game-changing first step in kicking off your career journey. We're looking for the next generation of home merchandisers who can bring fresh ideas and perspectives to our brands. During this 10-week program, you'll develop your skills alongside a team of supportive mentors and inspiring leaders.

Merchandising blends creativity, analytics, and marketing  to drive customer engagement and profitability. As an intern, you'll work closely with a team for a specific category (ex: furniture, tabletop, bath, etc) to get behind the scenes insight on how they create product strategies, manage pricing, and interpret data. You'll use this to develop your own new product recommendations.

ABOUT YOU


 Passionate about product, home decor, and retail  Keep up with home design trends  Currently in your junior year of an undergraduate program  Minimum GPA of 3.5  Able to work onsite at one of our brands in San Francisco  Know how to prioritize and move quickly to react to our ever-changing business  Think strategically and critically to solve problems  Have Excel experience: vlooks-ups, pivot tables, etc… 


OUR PROGRAM

Our program is designed for undergraduate students graduating in 2028. During your internship, you will be a part of an intern cohort working for one of our San Francisco Brands (Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, or PB Kids and Teen). Throughout the program, you will attend business critical meetings, lead projects, gain experience working with cross-functional teams, attend professional trainings, and have the chance to brainstorm with our leadership team.

At the end of the program, you are given the opportunity to pioneer a new idea and present it to our executive leadership team. Many of our interns' project proposals have been implemented in new business strategies, as we value the fresh perspective our interns bring to the business.

Of course, we also leave time for a little fun by hosting social and networking opportunities with your fellow interns such as cohort lunches, and social hours.

Our 10 week program runs June 7th - August 13th (start date is flexible for students on the quarter system).

WHERE

San Francisco, CA. Onsite 4x a week.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a global, multi-channel retailer of home furnishings and housewares (our family of brands includes Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn teen, west elm, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark & Graham), but we operate within smaller teams, giving each person an opportunity for hands-on experience.  American Innovation Index Top 25 Most Innovative Companies, 2023  Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable U.S. Companies, 2023  Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces, 2023  Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces for Women, 2022  Newsweek’s America’s Best Customer Service, 2024  Time World’s Best Companies, 2024  Fortune 500 List, 2022

rows.title: Consumer Insights Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity

Chewy is seeking a Consumer Insights Manager to join our Consumer Insights team in Boston, MA. This hands-on manager and analyst role will help strengthen Chewy's consumer-centric approach by leading small to mid-sized research projects, supporting recurring insights programs, and turning data into clear implications for the business. Working closely with Consumer Insights leaders and partners across Marketing, Analytics, Product, and customer-facing teams, this person will connect insights across brand health, customer behavior, competitive intelligence, cultural insights, syndicated sources, and primary research. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable digging into the data, managing the details of research execution, and communicating the story behind the findings.

What You'll Do

Lead defined research projects. Independently manage small to mid-sized quantitative and qualitative studies from business question through approach, questionnaire or discussion guide, fieldwork, analysis, and final story.Dig into brand health and measurement. Support the day-to-day management and analysis of Chewy's brand tracking programs, including funnel performance, equity measures, audience differences, competitive context, and changes over time. Partner with Brand, Media, and Analytics teams to evaluate campaign performance across awareness, ad recall, message association, familiarity, and consideration. Connect campaign-level results with brand-health trends to identify what is working, for whom, and where additional learning is needed.Connect the dots across data. Integrate findings from surveys, customer and behavioral metrics, syndicated tools, competitive intelligence, and prior research to identify patterns, explain what is changing, and surface the most important implications.Translate findings into action. Build clear, concise reports and presentations that move beyond data reporting to explain the customer tension, the business impact, and recommended next steps.Run recurring insights workstreams. Manage Chewy's DIY survey platform and omnibus, support monthly and quarterly reporting, and maintain consistent quality, timing, and documentation across repeatable programs.Build actionable audience intelligence. Use audience platforms and syndicated tools to size and profile priority audiences, understand their attitudes and media behaviors, and translate findings into clear inputs for audience strategy, media planning, and activation.Apply a cultural intelligence lens. Identify how cultural shifts and differences across audiences influence pet-parent needs, brand perceptions, and behaviors, translating these insights into opportunities for more relevant and inclusive marketing and customer experiences.Maintain consistent measurement. Support the development of repeatable scorecards and benchmarks for upper-funnel performance, including campaign, channel, creative, and audience-level results.Ensure research quality. Review survey programming, sample plans, data tables, outputs, and deliverables for accuracy; identify inconsistencies and resolve issues before work is shared with stakeholders.Support larger strategic programs. Partner with senior Consumer Insights leads on high-impact initiatives by owning analyses, research workstreams, timelines, and deliverables while maintaining visibility across multiple priorities.Bring the consumer into the conversation. Share findings in working sessions and stakeholder presentations, answer follow-up questions with evidence, and help teams apply insights to marketing, brand, product, and customer experience decisions.

What You'll Need

Education. Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, statistics, research, social sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.5+ years of experience in consumer insights, market research, analytics, or a related field, ideally supporting consumer, retail, e-commerce, or technology brands.Collaborative mindset. A curious, proactive, hands-on partner who asks thoughtful questions, works well across teams, and thrives in a fast-paced, often ambiguous environment.End-to-end research skills. Hands-on experience designing and executing quantitative and qualitative research, with the judgment to independently lead clearly scoped studies and seek guidance on larger or more ambiguous work.Strong analytical foundation. Ability to work directly with crosstabs and datasets, analyze trends and audience differences, understand statistical significance, diagnose drivers, and reconcile findings across multiple sources.Brand measurement experience. Experience with brand health, equity, funnel, customer experience, NPS, or other tracking programs, including interpreting movement over time and competitive benchmarks.Media and audience measurement experience. Familiarity with brand-lift studies, upper-funnel media metrics, audience profiling, segmentation, and syndicated audience tools. Ability to connect media results with broader brand-health and customer insights is strongly preferred.Insight synthesis and storytelling. Strong writing and presentation skills, with the ability to turn detailed analysis into a focused narrative, meaningful human insight, and practical business implications.Executional discipline. Strong project management, organization, and attention to detail, with a track record of balancing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work on time.Tools and data fluency. Experience with survey platforms, Excel or similar analytical tools, and syndicated data sources such as Nielsen, MRI-Simmons, Numerator, or YouGov. Familiarity with visualization or statistical software is a plus.Vendor and communication skills. Experience coordinating research vendors and presenting findings to cross-functional stakeholders. Experience conducting qualitative interviews is a plus.

In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is recruiting for Director- TDS Data, Data Science & AI – R&D DDSAI – Therapeutics Development & Supply (TDS)

The primary location for this position is open to Spring House, PA

J&J Innovative Medicine develops treatments that improve the health of people worldwide. Research and development areas encompass oncology, immunology, neuroscience, cardiopulmonary and specialty ophthalmology. Our goal is to help people live longer, healthier lives. Therapeutics Development & Supply (TDS) is the bridge between scientific discovery and clinical application, encompassing Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC), Device development, and clinical supply chain. This organization ensures that every molecule, modality and delivery system is robustly developed, scaled, and supplied under rigorous and regulatory standards.

The R&D Data Science organization is seeking a Director, Data, Data Science and AI to lead a team of data product engineers, data scientists, and ontology developers in support of the Therapeutics Development and Supply organization. This people leader role is responsible for building and scaling the data engineering, semantic, ontology, and knowledge graph capabilities that underpin all AI/ML and analytics work across TDS. People Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

Recruit, develop, and lead a team of data product engineers, ontology developers, and data scientists.Establish and maintain dotted-line operating model with DDSAI's Data Strategy & Products leadership team

Qualifications

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.10+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data science platform development, with at least 3 years in a people leadership role.Deep expertise in modern data stack technologies: cloud-based architectures (AWS, Snowflake), Python, SQL, graph databases, and semantic technologies, including knowledge graphsDemonstrated experience building and scaling data teams that deliver enterprise-grade data products.Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence and align across technical and business stakeholders at the Senior Director and VP level.

You will build the data and AI foundation for one of the most ambitious digital transformations in pharmaceutical R&D. Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

About The Opportunity

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Senior Data Scientist dedicated to our Biologics Discovery organization. This role sits within our Data, Data Science & Artificial Intelligence team (DDSAI) and partners closely with our In Silico Discovery (ISD) organization - the group that builds the molecular design and property-prediction models (for example, developability, affinity and binding, and other molecular-property and liability-risk models) that guide which biologic molecules to design, make, and advance. ISD owns core molecular model development; you will build the data-facing ML capabilities (featurization, model-ready datasets, evaluation frameworks, and applied models on assay and sequence data) that make ISD's models faster to build and better to trust.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-095854

Spain - Requisition Number: R-096793

Why this role matters: Biologics Discovery is generating rich, fast-growing data across assays, sequences, and modalities, and the opportunity now is to make that data fully model-ready and seamlessly available for ML. This role ensures biologics data is structured for training, and that applied ML on discovery data helps scientists prioritize molecules, flag risks, and generate hypotheses earlier - strengthening the interface to ISD's models rather than duplicating them.

Position Summary

You will design robust featurization and dataset curation, build and evaluate applied models on biologics assay, biophysical, and sequence/construct data, and define evaluation frameworks that keep models trustworthy. You operate at the interface between our data-generating and data-infrastructure partners and In Silico Discovery (ISD), ensuring the datasets and features you create strengthen ISD's molecular property models. This is an opportunity to shape how AI learns from every biologics experiment.

Key Responsibilities

Featurization & Model-Ready Data

Develop featurization and model-ready datasets from antibody/protein sequence, construct, assay, and biophysical data.Work with data engineers to specify the features, labels, and levels of aggregation that models need, preserving raw representations where information matters.Curate, document, and version datasets so modeling is reproducible and traceable.

Applied ML & Evaluation

Develop featurization and model-ready datasets from antibody/protein sequence, construct, assay, and biophysical data.Work with data engineers to specify the features, labels, and levels of aggregation that models need, preserving raw representations where information matters.Curate, document, and version datasets so modeling is reproducible and traceable.

Partnership, Rigor & Growth

Collaborate with ISD to hand off standardized, traceable training datasets and align on where Data Science enables versus where ISD owns modeling.Partner with Discovery scientists to frame ML problems around real decision points in the design-make-test-learn (DMTL) cycle.Work closely with ontology and MLOps colleagues so datasets carry consistent semantics and models move reliably from development into use.Champion reproducibility, documentation, and responsible AI.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is an opportunity to apply ML where it truly moves the needle in biologics discovery - grounded in real assay and sequence data, tightly partnered with world-class molecular modeling, and with real room to grow your scope, technical leadership, and impact as you build a track record of delivery.

Qualifications

Required

Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Statistics, or a related field.At least 2 years of applied ML experience, including model development, evaluation, and dataset curation on complex scientific or biomedical data.Strong proficiency with Python and the modern ML stack (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn) and SQL.Experience turning complex, heterogeneous experimental data into robust features and training sets, with exposure to cloud training and data infrastructure.Sound understanding of evaluation, validation, and the risks of leakage and distribution shift.Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental scientists and modeling partners in a matrixed R&D environment.

Preferred

Experience with biologics, antibody/protein sequence models, or protein language models.Experience with active learning, Bayesian optimization, or sequence-based generative models for molecular design.Familiarity with biophysical/assay data and developability endpoints.Experience with MLOps, experiment tracking, and model monitoring.Familiarity with how ontologies or knowledge graphs support data reuse and AI-ready datasets.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Data Science

Job Category

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Madrid, Spain, Raritan, New Jersey, United States of America, Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

About The Opportunity

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Senior Data Scientist dedicated to our Biologics Discovery organization. This role sits within our Data, Data Science & Artificial Intelligence team (DDSAI) and partners closely with our In Silico Discovery (ISD) organization - the group that builds the molecular design and property-prediction models (for example, developability, affinity and binding, and other molecular-property and liability-risk models) that guide which biologic molecules to design, make, and advance. ISD owns core molecular model development; you will build the data-facing ML capabilities (featurization, model-ready datasets, evaluation frameworks, and applied models on assay and sequence data) that make ISD's models faster to build and better to trust.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-095854

Spain - Requisition Number: R-096793

Why this role matters: Biologics Discovery is generating rich, fast-growing data across assays, sequences, and modalities, and the opportunity now is to make that data fully model-ready and seamlessly available for ML. This role ensures biologics data is structured for training, and that applied ML on discovery data helps scientists prioritize molecules, flag risks, and generate hypotheses earlier - strengthening the interface to ISD's models rather than duplicating them.

Position Summary

You will design robust featurization and dataset curation, build and evaluate applied models on biologics assay, biophysical, and sequence/construct data, and define evaluation frameworks that keep models trustworthy. You operate at the interface between our data-generating and data-infrastructure partners and In Silico Discovery (ISD), ensuring the datasets and features you create strengthen ISD's molecular property models. This is an opportunity to shape how AI learns from every biologics experiment.

Key Responsibilities

Featurization & Model-Ready Data

Develop featurization and model-ready datasets from antibody/protein sequence, construct, assay, and biophysical data.Work with data engineers to specify the features, labels, and levels of aggregation that models need, preserving raw representations where information matters.Curate, document, and version datasets so modeling is reproducible and traceable.

Applied ML & Evaluation

Develop featurization and model-ready datasets from antibody/protein sequence, construct, assay, and biophysical data.Work with data engineers to specify the features, labels, and levels of aggregation that models need, preserving raw representations where information matters.Curate, document, and version datasets so modeling is reproducible and traceable.

Partnership, Rigor & Growth

Collaborate with ISD to hand off standardized, traceable training datasets and align on where Data Science enables versus where ISD owns modeling.Partner with Discovery scientists to frame ML problems around real decision points in the design-make-test-learn (DMTL) cycle.Work closely with ontology and MLOps colleagues so datasets carry consistent semantics and models move reliably from development into use.Champion reproducibility, documentation, and responsible AI.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is an opportunity to apply ML where it truly moves the needle in biologics discovery - grounded in real assay and sequence data, tightly partnered with world-class molecular modeling, and with real room to grow your scope, technical leadership, and impact as you build a track record of delivery.

Qualifications

Required

Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Statistics, or a related field.At least 2 years of applied ML experience, including model development, evaluation, and dataset curation on complex scientific or biomedical data.Strong proficiency with Python and the modern ML stack (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn) and SQL.Experience turning complex, heterogeneous experimental data into robust features and training sets, with exposure to cloud training and data infrastructure.Sound understanding of evaluation, validation, and the risks of leakage and distribution shift.Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental scientists and modeling partners in a matrixed R&D environment.

Preferred

Experience with biologics, antibody/protein sequence models, or protein language models.Experience with active learning, Bayesian optimization, or sequence-based generative models for molecular design.Familiarity with biophysical/assay data and developability endpoints.Experience with MLOps, experiment tracking, and model monitoring.Familiarity with how ontologies or knowledge graphs support data reuse and AI-ready datasets.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are under 18 years of age, you (the candidate) may need to obtain the necessary working papers or other documentation required by state law to start the assignment, as well as get a parent’s consent for the background check.

Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers , internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.

The anticipated base pay range for this position is $109,000 to $174,800. The Company maintains highly competitive, performance-based compensation programs. Under current guidelines, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan. The annual performance bonus is a cash bonus intended to provide an incentive to achieve annual targeted results by rewarding for individual and the corporation’s performance over a calendar/performance year. Bonuses are awarded at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company sponsored employee benefit programs: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, business accident insurance, and group legal insurance.

Employees may be eligible to participate in the Company’s consolidated retirement plan (pension) and savings plan (401(k)).

About The Opportunity

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Senior Data Scientist dedicated to our Biologics Discovery organization. This role sits within our Data, Data Science & Artificial Intelligence team (DDSAI) and partners closely with our In Silico Discovery (ISD) organization - the group that builds the molecular design and property-prediction models (for example, developability, affinity and binding, and other molecular-property and liability-risk models) that guide which biologic molecules to design, make, and advance. ISD owns core molecular model development; you will build the data-facing ML capabilities (featurization, model-ready datasets, evaluation frameworks, and applied models on assay and sequence data) that make ISD's models faster to build and better to trust.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-095854

Spain - Requisition Number: R-096793

Why this role matters: Biologics Discovery is generating rich, fast-growing data across assays, sequences, and modalities, and the opportunity now is to make that data fully model-ready and seamlessly available for ML. This role ensures biologics data is structured for training, and that applied ML on discovery data helps scientists prioritize molecules, flag risks, and generate hypotheses earlier - strengthening the interface to ISD's models rather than duplicating them.

Position Summary

You will design robust featurization and dataset curation, build and evaluate applied models on biologics assay, biophysical, and sequence/construct data, and define evaluation frameworks that keep models trustworthy. You operate at the interface between our data-generating and data-infrastructure partners and In Silico Discovery (ISD), ensuring the datasets and features you create strengthen ISD's molecular property models. This is an opportunity to shape how AI learns from every biologics experiment.

Key Responsibilities

Featurization & Model-Ready Data

Develop featurization and model-ready datasets from antibody/protein sequence, construct, assay, and biophysical data.Work with data engineers to specify the features, labels, and levels of aggregation that models need, preserving raw representations where information matters.Curate, document, and version datasets so modeling is reproducible and traceable.

Applied ML & Evaluation

Develop featurization and model-ready datasets from antibody/protein sequence, construct, assay, and biophysical data.Work with data engineers to specify the features, labels, and levels of aggregation that models need, preserving raw representations where information matters.Curate, document, and version datasets so modeling is reproducible and traceable.

Partnership, Rigor & Growth

Collaborate with ISD to hand off standardized, traceable training datasets and align on where Data Science enables versus where ISD owns modeling.Partner with Discovery scientists to frame ML problems around real decision points in the design-make-test-learn (DMTL) cycle.Work closely with ontology and MLOps colleagues so datasets carry consistent semantics and models move reliably from development into use.Champion reproducibility, documentation, and responsible AI.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is an opportunity to apply ML where it truly moves the needle in biologics discovery - grounded in real assay and sequence data, tightly partnered with world-class molecular modeling, and with real room to grow your scope, technical leadership, and impact as you build a track record of delivery.

Qualifications

Required

Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Statistics, or a related field.At least 2 years of applied ML experience, including model development, evaluation, and dataset curation on complex scientific or biomedical data.Strong proficiency with Python and the modern ML stack (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn) and SQL.Experience turning complex, heterogeneous experimental data into robust features and training sets, with exposure to cloud training and data infrastructure.Sound understanding of evaluation, validation, and the risks of leakage and distribution shift.Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental scientists and modeling partners in a matrixed R&D environment.

Preferred

Experience with biologics, antibody/protein sequence models, or protein language models.Experience with active learning, Bayesian optimization, or sequence-based generative models for molecular design.Familiarity with biophysical/assay data and developability endpoints.Experience with MLOps, experiment tracking, and model monitoring.Familiarity with how ontologies or knowledge graphs support data reuse and AI-ready datasets.

Operations Research & Mathematical Optimization

Technical Delivery & Scaled Capability Development

Develop robust, reusable modeling workflows and decision-support products using Python and modern scientific computing, optimization, simulation, and cloud-based tooling.Apply software engineering best practices, including modular design, version control, testing, documentation, reproducibility, code review, and maintainable interfaces.Partner with data engineering, product, architecture, and platform teams to integrate models with enterprise data and embed outputs into recurring planning and operational workflows.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Impact

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer to help build the agentic layer of our Biologics Discovery data engine. This is an opportunity to be one of the early builders of agentic AI workflows that automate secondary data processing, orchestrate analyses, and connect experimental outputs to models and decisions across the DMTL (design-make-test-learn) cycle. You will work at the intersection of scientific experimentation, data pipelines, AI systems, and lab automation, partnering closely with the broader AI/ML team to bring these systems to life.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, Raritan, NJ, or Cambridge, MA, USA; or at our office in Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-095856

Spain - Requisition Number: R-096797

Why this role matters: Getting biologics data to flow reliably through our systems is a critical, often underestimated challenge, and there is significant opportunity to automate secondary analysis. This role brings hands-on agentic AI engineering to compress cycle time, reduce manual intervention, and improve reproducibility - building the scalable, connected, intelligent discovery workflows that today's hands-on processes still lack.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is a rare chance to help build how scientific and physical AI come together to steer design and execution in the lab - contributing hands-on to one of the first agentic discovery engines in a large pharma setting. As the team and its agentic capabilities grow, this role offers a clear path to increasing scope, technical ownership, and influence.

Position Summary

As a Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer, you will build and maintain agentic workflows and orchestration that support the scientific data analysis and secondary processing logic our team delivers. You will implement automation and AI pipelines connecting automation software, data stores, models, and compute, working closely with senior engineers to translate scientific priorities into working systems.

You will partner across Discovery, Data Science, In Silico Discovery (ISD), our Enterprise Generative AI team, and our data-infrastructure and lab-automation teams to help enable closed-loop feedback so that each experimental cycle improves downstream models and decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Orchestration & Integration

Build and continuously improve agentic workflows that automate secondary analysis for biologics discovery assays, replacing fragile manual and ad-hoc scripted steps.Develop and maintain real-time or near-real-time pipelines connecting automation software, data stores, models, and compute environments.Partner with IT and platform teams to implement resilient APIs, observability, versioning, and workflow orchestration end-to-end.Work with our Enterprise Generative AI team to build on shared GenAI platforms, models, and agentic frameworks - extending them for biologics discovery rather than duplicating enterprise capabilities.Partner with ontology and MLOps colleagues so automated workflows produce semantically consistent, reusable data and deploy reliably into production.

AI-Driven Scientific Learning

Contribute to workflows optimized for AI-driven learning, not just throughput, supporting closed-loop feedback across the design-make-test-learn (DMTL) cycle.Collaborate with discovery scientists, AI/ML scientists, and data engineers so experimental outputs improve downstream property models and decision-making.Help ensure data generated through agentic workflows is high-quality, traceable, interoperable, and AI-ready, with strong metadata, provenance, and lineage.Identify and propose opportunities to apply agentic AI to compress cycle time and improve reproducibility.

Qualifications

Required

Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related computational field (or Bachelor's with substantial relevant experience).At least 2 years experience building scientific workflow orchestration, or automation software, including experience in agentic workflows.Hands-on experience designing real-time or near-real-time data pipelines and integrating complex and heterogeneous scientific data and instrument outputs.Experience applying agentic AI and modern LLM-based agents (or comparable intelligent-automation systems) to scientific or laboratory workflows.Experience working with enterprise or shared GenAI platforms and retrieval-augmented approaches (e.g., RAG or GraphRAG) rather than standing up capabilities from scratch.Strong communication skills and comfort operating in ambiguity within a matrixed organization.

Preferred

Experience in drug discovery domains such as biologics, high-throughput experimentation, or imaging.Exposure to lab automation, robotic systems, or cyber-physical systems for R&D.Familiarity with MLOps/DevOps, workflow engines, and production-grade monitoring/observability.Understanding of FAIR data, ontologies, semantic models, lineage/provenance, and AI-ready data standards.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, Raritan, NJ, or Cambridge, MA, USA; or at our office in Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

About Innovative Medicine

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

Responsibilities

The Director, Global Strategic Marketing will be responsible for leading commercial strategy & execution for ICOTYDE in Plaque Psoriasis. Key responsibilities include participating in label working groups and compound development teams in collaboration with R&D, leading the Global Commercial Team for strategic alignment across the brand, navigating through immunology governance activities, ensuring regional and cross-functional alignment in strategic decisions and execution, and delivering a clear and actional portfolio strategy. The qualified candidate should be an agile team player who is able to lead and participate on cross-functional teams, gain alignment and drive decision making with regional commercial colleagues on business case, commercial strategy, and tactical plans. This individual will have the ability to understand, interpret and communicate commercial and competitive implications of complex technical/clinical/regulatory data. This individual must have an understanding of clinical data and the ability to interact with R&D and Medical Affairs colleagues on scientific issues. This individual must demonstrate strong leadership presence through influencing without authority with high-level management, detail orientation, and excellent strategic thinking.

Qualifications

A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required. Postgraduate qualification, PhD, MBA, or other graduate degree is strongly preferred.A minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical industry is required.A minimum of 5 years demonstrated in-line marketing, marketing insights, consulting, or sales management/training experience executing marketing strategy is required.An ability to manage multiple demands and priorities on time, lead teams, gain alignment, and drive decision making is required.Immunology experience is preferred.Senior brand responsibility, product launch, experience in working with global teams, and a strong understanding of pharmaceutical development is preferred.Strong executive, verbal and written communication skills are required, along with demonstrated presentation skills.This position is based in Horsham, PA will require up to 25% domestic and international travel.

rows.descriptionText:

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Data Engineering

Job Category

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Raritan, New Jersey, United States of America, Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

About The Opportunity

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Principal Agentic Workflow & AI Engineer to help build the agentic layer of our Biologics Discovery data engine. This is an opportunity to be one of the early, senior experts shaping how agentic AI workflows automate secondary data processing, orchestrate analyses, and connect experimental outputs to models and decisions across the DMTL (design-make-test-learn) cycle. You will work at the intersection of scientific experimentation, data pipelines, AI systems, and lab automation.

This position will be located at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ. (No remote option.)

Why this role matters: Getting biologics data to flow reliably through our systems is a critical, often underestimated challenge, and there is significant opportunity to automate secondary analysis. This role brings agentic AI and intelligent automation to compress cycle time, reduce manual intervention, and improve reproducibility - transforming today’s hands-on processes into scalable, connected, intelligent discovery workflows. It is a strategically visible Principal-level role, central to our next-generation discovery automation.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is a rare chance to architect how scientific and physical AI come together to steer design and execution in the lab - not just automating steps but building a next-generation discovery engine in a large pharma setting. As a Principal individual contributor, your work will be among the most visible and influential on the team and will directly accelerate how tomorrow's therapies are discovered.

Position Summary

As a Principal Agentic Workflow & AI Engineer, you will design and build agentic workflows and orchestration that own the scientific data analysis and secondary processing logic our team delivers. You will translate scientific priorities into automation and AI roadmaps, and build real-time pipelines connecting automation software, data stores, models, and compute.

You will partner across Discovery, Data Science, In Silico Discovery (ISD), our Enterprise Generative AI team, and our data-infrastructure and lab-automation teams to enable closed-loop feedback so that each experimental cycle improves downstream models and decisions - timed to lab-automation readiness as new automation infrastructure comes online. You will also set technical direction and mentor other team members.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Orchestration & Integration

Design, configure, and continuously improve agentic workflows that automate secondary analysis for biologics discovery assays, replacing fragile manual and ad-hoc scripted steps.Build or oversee real-time pipelines connecting automation software, data stores, models, and compute environments.Partner with IT and platform teams to implement resilient APIs, observability, versioning, and workflow orchestration end-to-end.Partner with our Enterprise Generative AI team to build on shared GenAI platforms, models, and agentic frameworks - extending them for biologics discovery rather than duplicating enterprise capabilities.Partner with ontology and MLOps colleagues so automated workflows produce semantically consistent, reusable data and deploy reliably into production.

AI-Driven Scientific Learning

Design workflows optimized for AI-driven learning, not just throughput, enabling closed-loop feedback across the design-make-test-learn (DMTL) cycle.Collaborate with discovery scientists, AI/ML scientists, and data engineers so experimental outputs improve downstream property models and decision-making.Ensure data generated through agentic workflows is high-quality, traceable, interoperable, and AI-ready, with strong metadata, provenance, and lineage.Identify opportunities to apply agentic AI to compress cycle time and improve reproducibility.

Technical Leadership

Set technical direction and standards for agentic workflows and mentor engineers and data scientists across the AI/ML space.Evaluate and pilot emerging agentic AI methods, frameworks, and tools, guiding where the team invests.Represent the team's agentic work in cross-functional technical forums, aligning approaches with partner teams and enterprise standards.

Qualifications

Required

Advanced degree (Ph.D. preferred) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related computational field.At least 3 years experience building scientific workflow orchestration, automation software, including experience in agentic workflows and technical leadership responsibilities.Hands-on experience designing real-time or near-real-time data pipelines and integrating complex and heterogeneous scientific data and instrument outputs.Experience applying agentic AI and modern LLM-based agents (or comparable intelligent-automation systems) to scientific or laboratory workflows.Experience building on enterprise or shared GenAI platforms and retrieval-augmented approaches (e.g., RAG or GraphRAG) rather than standing up capabilities from scratch.Ability to translate scientific objectives into practical, scalable technical solutions and to set technical direction for others.Strong communication and stakeholder management with comfort operating in ambiguity and representing work to leadership in matrixed organizations.

Preferred

Experience in drug discovery domains such as biologics, high-throughput experimentation, or imaging.Exposure to lab automation, robotic systems, or cyber-physical systems for R&D.Familiarity with MLOps/DevOps, workflow engines, and production-grade monitoring/observability.Understanding of FAIR data, ontologies, semantic models, lineage/provenance, and AI-ready data standards.

This position will be located at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ. (No remote option.)

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are under 18 years of age, you (the candidate) may need to obtain the necessary working papers or other documentation required by state law to start the assignment, as well as get a parent’s consent for the background check.

Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers , internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.

The anticipated base pay range for this position is $117,000 to $201,250. The Company maintains highly competitive, performance-based compensation programs. Under current guidelines, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan. The annual performance bonus is a cash bonus intended to provide an incentive to achieve annual targeted results by rewarding for individual and the corporation’s performance over a calendar/performance year. Bonuses are awarded at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company sponsored employee benefit programs: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, business accident insurance, and group legal insurance.

Employees may be eligible to participate in the Company’s consolidated retirement plan (pension) and savings plan (401(k)).

rows.title: Converge by Deloitte VP Sales Executive - Data Studio-C_MAT
rows.descriptionText:
As a VP Sales Executive for Deloitte's Converge for Healthcare portfolio, you will help create the market for the next evolution of our revenue cycle offering: the extension of Revenue Intellect™ - our established, in-market analytics product - into an agentic platform, powered by Data Studio, that enables full revenue cycle business process outsourcing (BPaaS). Revenue Intellect™ helps healthcare providers improve financial margin and revenue cycle performance through data-driven insights; the platform and BPaaS motion extends that value from insight to fully AI-enabled execution of the work itself.

Revenue Intellect™ has been in market for more than nine years and is used by some of the largest and most complex health systems in the country. It remains a product this role sells actively and out of the box, generating near-term revenue and reference clients. The larger opportunity - and the primary focus of this role - is to build the market for the agentic platform and BPaaS engagements that Revenue Intellect™ is evolving into: larger, multi-year, outcome-based deals in which Deloitte runs revenue cycle processes for clients on an AI-enabled platform.

This is a market-making role, not solely a closing role. You will bring your own senior relationships and your own approach to market outreach; source and originate qualified pipeline; shape the deals; and quarterback complex pursuits alongside the product, delivery, deal-desk, and account teams who carry deals to signature. You will also help shape the pricing, packaging, and commercial constructs for these newer offerings, informed by what you learn in market - an important but secondary part of the role, weighted behind being in market.

Your time is weighted toward the market-making mandate - originating and advancing the Data Studio platform and Rev Cycle BPaaS motion - with continued active selling of Revenue Intellect™ as the near-term, in-market anchor. Success is measured primarily by qualified pipeline sourced and total contract value (TCV) originated on the platform and BPaaS motion, with a secondary line for Revenue Intellect™ bookings.

Recruiting for this role ends on 09/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As a VP Sales Executive on the Converge for Healthcare team, you will be responsible for:

Sell Revenue Intellect™ in market. Actively sell Revenue Intellect™ out of the box across mid-market health systems, regional IDNs, and multi-specialty groups (typically $250M-$2B in net patient revenue), landing near-term wins and reference clients that build credibility for the larger platform story.Make the market for the platform & BPaaS motion. Originate, shape, and quarterback the larger agentic-platform (Data Studio) and revenue-cycle BPaaS pursuits - larger, multi-year, outcome-based engagements - working shoulder-to-shoulder with product, delivery, and solutioning to define both what is sold and how it is delivered. You bring the outreach and the relationships; you are not solely responsible for closing.Pursuit orchestration and pipeline visibility. Partner with Converge for Healthcare leaders, Deloitte Industry account teams, deal desk, inside sales, and marketing to optimize targeting and lead-to-pipeline conversion and to move complex pursuits toward signature; provide structured visibility into qualified pipeline and TCV across the motion.New-logo origination through your own network. Activate your personal network of health system relationships to originate opportunities beyond Deloitte's existing accounts, and set the outreach approach for the segment. Where a Deloitte account relationship exists, you and the account team open doors together and the pursuit team helps carry deals to close.Executive engagement across business and technical buyers. Engage VP and C-suite buyers across revenue cycle, finance, and operations (CFO/COO) on the make-vs-buy decision for BPaaS, and across data, analytics, and IT (CDO/CIO/enterprise architecture) on the platform - advancing deals and building lasting relationships.Shape pricing, packaging, and commercial constructs (secondary). Feed market signal back into the pricing, packaging, and deal constructs for Data Studio and BPaaS - including consumption/capacity-based and outcome-based models - in partnership with the pricing and deal-desk workstream. A field-informed contribution, weighted behind being in market.

A Strong, Successful Candidate Will Possess These Skills

Deep fluency in healthcare revenue cycle operations, including denial management, charge capture, payer contracting, coding, and financial performance management, with the ability to translate domain complexity into clear product value for finance and operations executives.Demonstrated track record of building sales infrastructure in a new or early-stage product context-including playbooks, pipeline processes, and go-to-market frameworks-without significant pre-existing organizational support.Established personal network of senior decision makers across health systems, IDNs, and payer organizations that can be immediately leveraged for pipeline development.Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with proven experience presenting to CFO, CRO, COO, and VP-level audiences and structuring complex product value into clear business and ROI outcomes.Ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles spanning procurement, legal, IT security, and compliance, with the judgment to know when to bring in product, delivery, or solution support.Commercially driven, self-directed orientation - comfortable owning pipeline generation, origination, and forecast within an early, still-forming commercial motion, without heavy day-to-day management support.Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to operate effectively across Deloitte account teams, product leadership, marketing, inside sales, and delivery in a matrixed environment.Practical familiarity with modern sales tooling and operating rhythms, including CRM hygiene, pipeline forecasting discipline, and structured account planning.Fluency with data platforms and agentic/AI capabilities in healthcare, and the ability to position a platform and its outcomes credibly with both technical buyers (data, analytics, IT) and business buyers (finance, operations).Comfort operating across multiple commercial models - subscription, consumption/capacity-based, and outcome/managed-service (BPaaS) - including deals where pricing and packaging are not yet fixed, with sensitivity to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal.Experience selling tech-enabled managed services, business process outsourcing (BPaaS), or outcome-based engagements - where the sale is inseparable from delivery capacity, transition, and client-side operating-model change.Awareness of the broader healthcare market context, including payer-provider dynamics, mid-market consolidation trends, and the competitive landscape across revenue cycle and financial analytics vendors.

The team

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, and works closely with Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering-, product-, and platform-oriented mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions, identifying and investing in areas of growth three, five, and ten years into the future.

Converge for Healthcare combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help health systems and payers improve financial performance, optimize revenue cycle operations, and drive sustainable margin improvement. Revenue Intellect™ is the flagship product within this portfolio, supported by full product, delivery, marketing, and inside sales teams. Business Development leaders in Converge for Healthcare operate at the intersection of product, industry, and client-partnering with Deloitte Partners, Market Makers, Product Leads, and Pursuit Teams to align offerings with priority client opportunities and growth agendas.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS, platform, and/or tech-enabled managed-services sales, with at least 5 of those years selling to or working within healthcare organizations (health systems, IDNs, payers, or physician groups).5+ years originating and carrying complex, multi-stakeholder deals in software, platform, or managed-services sales, including multi-year agreements structured as subscription, consumption, or outcome-based constructs.Demonstrated record of sourcing qualified pipeline and originating multi-million-dollar total contract value (TCV), with experience being measured on pipeline and origination - not solely on individual closed bookings.Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

3+ years selling revenue cycle management, revenue integrity, denials management, financial analytics software, or revenue cycle managed services / BPaaS to mid-market or larger health systems and IDNs.Prior experience working inside a healthcare provider or payer organization in revenue cycle, finance, or health IT.Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, healthcare administration, health informatics, or a related field.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $171,600.00 to $338,300.00.

You may also be eligible to participate in a sales incentive program, whereby you may be eligible to receive certain incentive compensation amounts based on achievement of certain sales goals set forth each year, subject to the terms and conditions of any applicable program document.
