rows.title: Delivery Consultant, OSINT Investigations
rows.descriptionText:
Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organization. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Work You'll Do

As a Delivery Consultant, Risk, Compliance, and Governance Solutions on the team, you will:

Support federal law enforcement investigations through open source and commercial data research and intelligence analysis to illuminate networks and identify leads. Support federal law enforcement investigations through the collection, analysis, and synthesis of publicly available information. Identify relevant actors, networks, trends, and digital tracesProduce clear, defensible intelligence products and support investigators with timely research and analysis. Research public records, social media, news, websites, forums, and other open sourcesCorrelate data to build timelines, link charts, and entity profilesProduce intelligence notes, reports, and briefing materialsValidate sources and document analytical confidenceSupport investigators with rapid-turn analysis and ad hoc researchMaintain compliance with legal, privacy, and policy requirements

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Forensic, Discovery, & Financial Crime offering provides services to support anti-money laundering, discovery, business disputes and investigations. Protect brands from financial crime and other corporate misconduct, as well as enable government organizations with tradecraft & technology to combat emerging and evolving threats.

This opportunity sits within our Center talent model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Center Talent Model has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
The Deloitte Greenhouse® Experience - Consultant - NY/NJ

The person in this role will split their time between Deloitte offices in New Brunswick, NJ and New York City (30 Rockefeller Plaza).

The Deloitte Greenhouse team has been instrumental in helping thousands of executives and teams tackle business problems. From simple to the most complex, it takes specialized skills, proven best practices, and deft executive facilitation to deliver results that are anything but business-as-usual. Our teams design both physical and virtual environments that enable leaders and their teams to reach their desired outcomes together.

We are looking for authentic, motivated, organized, and creative team members with a strong sense of self-awareness and emotional intelligence. You are excited to learn new things and are energized thinking about how to help businesses solve their toughest challenges, particularly in a team setting. Specific background, expectations, and experiences vary by role.

In the Deloitte Greenhouse we drive 1) clients to advance their careers, the effectiveness of their teams, and their business performance, 2) account teams to deepen relationships with clients through their career arcs and in critical moments that matter, and 3) firm growth priorities by providing unique market-shaping experiences and programs.

In this role you will interact extensively with senior Deloitte clients in all industries and functions.

Work you'll do

The Deloitte Greenhouse is searching for a Consultant to join the Executive and Team Experiences team. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a wide array of clients to solve exciting business challenges, stretch your critical thinking and problem-solving skills, and network with executive-level clients and Deloitte leaders. You will be responsible for:

Experience Design:

Supporting the experience design, which includes planning, producing, and managing all experience materials and tools (physical or digital), participating in and documenting design sessions, researching as part of the design effort, managing pre-experience interviews as appropriate, and creating an immersive experience for participants. We are looking for someone with strong production skills and a passion for creativity.

Experience Delivery:

Participating in day-of experience delivery, which includes managing materials and technology, sharing content, playing music, serving as the main logistics point of contact, facilitating break-out activities under the mentorship and guidance of Experience Managers and Experience Leads, and updating materials in real-time as needed. Experience producers are also responsible for developing comprehensive documentation for each experience, which includes capturing notes, synthesizing, and organizing the information for documentation purposes. We are looking for someone with executive presence and attention to detail.

Project Management:

Managing logistics and providing both operational support and underlying project management for assigned Executive & Team experiences and other events in the XA ecosystem. This includes adhering to milestones, escalating potential risks, conducting necessary reporting efforts for the team, and maintaining appropriate document management systems and team collaboration infrastructure. We are looking for someone with strong project management skills and the ability to drive progress while working independently.

Deloitte Greenhouse Program Support:

In addition to delivering client experiences, you may also have the opportunity to support national or local special projects and test creative and innovative approaches that could be leveraged in the Executive & Team experience portfolio. We are seeking an individual who enjoys taking on new challenges and pushing boundaries.

What We're Looking For

In this role you will exercise skills in the following areas:

Management of Multiple Workstreams

Managing multiple priorities across fast-paced, ambiguous environments Working independently and proactively to drive execution across multiple teams Managing & synthesizing large amounts of complex qualitative and quantitative information into audience-tailored insights 

Client Service and Communication

Demonstrating basic business writing and effective document development skills (including note taking and tailoring complex information), exhibiting logical structuring and appropriate formatting Establishing rapport and building strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients Taking personal ownership and bringing a customer-centric approach 

Strategic Thinking

Beginning to understand how organizations make decisions based on strategic, financial, and market considerations Bringing a point of view and structure to ambiguity and unclear problems Applying design thinking and frameworks to complex business challenges 

Creativity & Experience Design

Developing polished, well-formatted visuals and deliverables Turning complex inputs into compelling communications Producing creative and immersive client experiences 

The successful candidate would also possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanorAbility to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others 

Qualifications

Required:

Minimum of 2-3 years professional work experience Bachelor's Degree Well-developed analytical skills - ability to synthesize group discussions into concise / concrete bullet points and help steer abstract dialogue into actionable themes Excellent presence, as well as strong writing and oral presentation skills Mastery of Microsoft Office (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel, Word) Comfortable with learning and upskilling in new tech platforms Ability to travel up to 25% or more based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serveLimited immigration sponsorship may be available 

Preferred :

Graphic design, visual design, or video editing skills (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite) Interest and experience with analytical methods and tools, including data visualization are desirable

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
About L.E.K. Consulting

L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.

How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us.

Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.

Overview of Role: 

We are actively looking for a Data Scientist to join L.E.K.’s rapidly growing DDA (Data, Digital, and AI) practice. This role sits within our Data Science & Engineering team and operates at the intersection of advanced analytics, machine learning and applied AI, building the models, applications and analytical products that power client engagements and L.E.K.'s proprietary IP.

The ideal candidate brings fluency in applied data science (e.g., model development and validation, experimentation, and deployment of models) alongside hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-based and agentic AI solutions. You will work directly with clients across multiple industries, translating complex technical work into measurable commercial outcomes, and partner with data scientists, strategy consultants and client teams to build solutions that create high client impact.

As part of a dynamic and growing team, there is every opportunity to carve out value added work, and to grow your skills and experience. You won’t just be a technical expert; you will work at the intersection of data science and commercial understanding, across a range of domains, to deliver analytically driven recommendations to our clients, with state-of-the-art training and the opportunity to shape how the firm adopts new methods.

Responsibilities

Client engagements:Support end-to-end data science projects from conceptualization through to deployment, and deploy advanced machine learning models in clients' cloud environments, optimizing for scalability, performance, and reliability to address specific business challenges and objectivesSupport clients in strategically leveraging technical models, guiding them through the interpretation of results and the integration of actionable insights into their business workflows.Solve a wide variety of complex analytical challenges for clients, sometimes dynamically balancing multiple client rows.descriptionText:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.

From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.

10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.

But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.

If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.

Find us on Instagram: @optimizely

Introduction 

Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Digital Experience , the Visual Designer will help shape and evolve the visual experience of Optimizely.com. In this role, you'll blend visual design, systems thinking, and digital execution to create engaging, user-centered experiences that elevate our brand and support business goals.

You'll be responsible for designing and maintaining scalable web experiences, expanding our design system, and building reusable website components within Optimizely's Visual Builder. Working closely with marketing, content, product marketing, UX, and development teams, you'll ensure our website remains visually compelling, consistent, and easy to maintain.

This is a fully remote position with flexible working options.

Job Responsibilities

Own the visual design of Optimizely.com, ensuring a polished, consistent, and engaging experience across the site. Maintain, evolve, and expand the Optimizely web design system, creating reusable patterns and components that scale across teams. Audit existing pages to identify opportunities to improve visual consistency, usability, accessibility, and brand adherence. Design and build reusable website components in Optimizely Visual Builder, enabling marketers to create high-quality pages efficiently. Create page layouts and landing pages that balance aesthetics, usability, performance, and conversion goals. Partner with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and efficiently. Collaborate with content strategists, campaign managers, and product marketers to translate business objectives into compelling digital experiences. Ensure designs meet accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design best practices. Contribute to ongoing optimization by incorporating user feedback, analytics, and A/B testing insights into future designs. Help establish and document web design standards, guidelines, and best practices. 

Knowledge And Experience

3+ years of experience in web, visual, or digital design. Strong portfolio demonstrating modern web design, landing pages, and component-based design systems. Proficiency in Figma and collaborative design workflows. Experience working within and expanding design systems. Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and UX best practices. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers and marketers. Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance creativity and consistency. 

Additional Skills And Preferences

Experience creating marketing graphics, campaign assets, and illustrative graphics. Experience designing product visuals, diagrams, or feature illustrations. Motion graphics or animation experience (After Effects, Lottie, Rive, or similar). Familiarity with Optimizely CMS and Visual Builder, or other enterprise CMS platforms. Understanding of HTML/CSS and how designs translate into front-end development. Experience supporting experimentation and conversion rate optimization initiatives. 

Education

Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design , Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience)

Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Total Target Compensation range: $74,000-$137,000

Optimizely considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills.

rows.title: Cyber Identity - FDE Senior Consultant - Engineering and Product Engineer III
rows.descriptionText:
As a Cyber Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will work at the intersection of client engagement and hands-on engineering, embedding directly with client engagement teams to design, build, and deliver high-quality cybersecurity and AI-enabled solutions. You will support end-to-end technical delivery while contributing to deal shaping, influencing product direction, and providing appropriate support when needed for clients' post-deployment.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Engineering and Product Engineer III on the Cyber Engineering team, you will be responsible for:

Translating business and cybersecurity needs into technical solutions, including AI/GenAI-enabled capabilities where applicable, and deploying them in alignment with client requirements and architectureIdentifying, troubleshooting, and resolving technical issues within scopePartnering with stakeholders during pursuits to shape technical solutions, including demos, proofs of concept, and prototypesContributing to solution design and aligning client needs with delivery feasibilityCapturing delivery learnings to inform reusable product and platform improvements while enabling client teams through documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanorAbility to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cyber Engineering is a new team that is spearheading the buildout of Cybersecurity technology that will underpin the next generation of our Cybersecurity services. Join us as we work with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity to build future capabilities today.

Qualifications

Required:

5-8+ years of hands-on experience in full stack development across frontend and backend technologies.Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Next.js).Backend expertise in Node.js, Python (Django/Flask), or Java (Spring Boot).Experience with relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).Experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, and serverless architectures.Experience deploying applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and development lifecycle tools (e.g., Git, Azure DevOps).1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments1+ years of experience with one of the following Frontier Gen AI Platforms: Anthropic, Google or Open AI, including hands on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Claude API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, Gemini API, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Grounding, Google Workspace integration, GPT-4o, Assistants API, Responses API, OpenAI Agents SDKUnderstanding of AI system architectures and ability to align application pipelines to support them.Ability to independently own defined scope end-to-end with consistent, high-quality output.Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs.Strong accountability and ownership mindset in achieving client outcomes.Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.Ability to travel up to 20% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

Experience and/or certification with Anthropic is strongly preferred.Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts (e.g., application security, cloud security, identity, detection engineering).Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.Exposure to search/analytics platforms (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) or graph databases (Neo4j).Knowledge of Kubernetes, GitOps, or advanced cloud-native patterns.Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).Basic familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

rows.title: Technologist, Expert Associate Partner, Tech Insights Group

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.WHO YOU’LL WORK WITHThe Technology Insights Group (TIG) at Bain & Company is a rapidly growing global team of world-class consultants and technologists. We work with leading Private Equity (PE) investors and their tech-enabled portfolio companies to act as technical advisors in investment processes. We conduct product and technology due diligence engagements and value creation assignments, leveraging our extensive expertise in software and understanding of commercial environments specific to tech-enabled businesses. We deliver our projects by combining a team of consultants with former CPOs and CTOs of leading global technology and software companies with decades of both advising and operating experience. The team has completed 400+ product and technology diligences and value creation engagements worldwide. Over the past 5 years, we supported our clients on some of the most visible technology investments in the US and Europe, including several of the global Top 2024 & 2025 software deals.WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAMYou’ll be joining TIG as a Technologist. It’s an exciting opportunity to help scale a critical capability at Bain. You will work closely with the global Tech leadership as well as regional Private Equity (PE) and General Consulting teams as the experienced technical voice on diligence and value creation engagements. You’ll have the opportunity to critically analyse and evaluate some of the most interesting tech and tech enabled companies around gaining exposure to a broad range of technologies, products, industries and innovation in the very fast-moving adoption of AI.This role is based in the United States, with a preference for candidates located in the Northeast, particularly the Boston or New York areas.WHAT YOU’LL DOAct as the senior Technologist and a full member of the case leadership team across technology and integrated due diligence (TDD/IDD), post-acquisition (Day 1 and the first 100 days), and value creation plan (VCP) engagements, working hand-in-hand with the Senior Manager & Operating Partner who own and drive the project deliverables and story line.Own the “technical answer” and be heavily engaged in shaping the executive summary key assumptions and their assessments, ensuring an answer-led approach grounded in the investment thesis (for PE) or an operator view (for industry/corporate clients).Validate overall product capability against the investment thesis; assess the extent and impact of technical debt and architecture choices; surface material risks (cyber security in particular); evaluate R&D’s ability to execute; and translate all of this into a clear view of “what it takes” and “how much it will cost.”Be the senior technical voice in client calls, management deep dives, and target conversations – remaining highly present to both client and target – and deep-dive critical technical topics even when outside your direct experience, drawing on the wider technologist group and expert network to maintain fidelity.Be a critical factor in winning work – shaping proposals and approach, and convincing even the most sceptical clients in a pitch through genuine technical credibility and “street creds”.Demonstrate fluent understanding of software architectures, technology stack, cloud and mobile computing, technical debt, functional and non-functional roadmaps, hosting, cyber-security, database technologies, data & analytics, including AI/ML technologies, R&D organization, and AI enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, quality assurance, and CI / CD processesDemonstrate solid understanding of some major software business application areas, which may include e-Commerce, ERP, CRM, Data warehousing, Business Intelligence and have familiarity with new emerging applicationsApply the investment thesis to the tech due diligence process and make relevant assessments and recommendations that translate into insights using appropriate methodologiesHelp develop TIG intellectual property and identify areas of new opportunity for technology due diligence and value creation for Bain and its PE clientsCommunicate with and educate both senior and junior colleagues to further embed technology know how across the firm and within our clientsCoach, and mentor junior TIG team membersABOUT YOUThis role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.Must have substantial hands-on experience in commercial software engineering and architectureMust demonstrate a practical understanding of the AI technology landscape, including large language models, AI-assisted development tools, orchestration frameworks, and emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) serversDirect and recent experience applying AI across the software development lifecycle is preferred, including the use of generative AI and, ideally, agentic AI to improve product development, engineering productivity, platform capabilities, or business processes.A strong data science, machine learning, or AI engineering background with clear applicability to these areas may also be considered10+ years industry experience, including leadership roles for at least 3 yearsTrack record of leading and collaborating on strategic initiatives.Strong team and business communication skills – can walk through approach with technical clients or explain complex concepts to non-technical peopleAbility to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teamsMust thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to work independentlyTravel requiredConsulting experience and/or hands-on experience with technical due diligence processes an advantage U.S. Compensation InformationCompensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range to be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:In Boston, Massachusetts and New York, New York, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $240,000 - $290,000; placement within this range will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level.Annual discretionary performance bonus.This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation.4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date. Bain & Company’s comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family.Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck.Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays.Fully vested 401(k) company contribution.Paid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

rows.title: Cyber Forward Deployed Engineer - Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Deloitte's Cyber team helps our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, and enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage their security posture.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you will do:

As a Cyber Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Manager, you will lead delivery of cybersecurity and AI-enabled solutions at the intersection of client engagement and hands-on engineering. You will lead teams on delivering high-quality solutions while playing a key role in deal shaping, scaling delivery practices, and enabling long-term client and team capability.

Solution Delivery & Engineering (Primary Focus)

Translate business and cybersecurity needs into high-quality technical solutions (including AI/GenAI-enabled capabilities where applicable), and deploy them for clients in alignment with their requirements and architectureIdentify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues within scope

Pre-Sales & Deal Shaping

Partner with stakeholders to help shape technical solutions during pursuits, including leading demos/POCs/prototypesContribute to solution design, ensuring alignment between client needs and delivery feasibility.Partner with leadership to influence technical win strategy, including pricing inputs, and effort estimation, ensuring alignment between client needs, feasibility, and commercial viability.

Customer Delivery Leadership

rows.title: Converge by Deloitte VP Sales Executive - Data Studio-C_MAT
rows.descriptionText:
As a VP Sales Executive for Deloitte's Converge for Healthcare portfolio, you will help create the market for the next evolution of our revenue cycle offering: the extension of Revenue Intellect™ - our established, in-market analytics product - into an agentic platform, powered by Data Studio, that enables full revenue cycle business process outsourcing (BPaaS). Revenue Intellect™ helps healthcare providers improve financial margin and revenue cycle performance through data-driven insights; the platform and BPaaS motion extends that value from insight to fully AI-enabled execution of the work itself.

Revenue Intellect™ has been in market for more than nine years and is used by some of the largest and most complex health systems in the country. It remains a product this role sells actively and out of the box, generating near-term revenue and reference clients. The larger opportunity - and the primary focus of this role - is to build the market for the agentic platform and BPaaS engagements that Revenue Intellect™ is evolving into: larger, multi-year, outcome-based deals in which Deloitte runs revenue cycle processes for clients on an AI-enabled platform.

This is a market-making role, not solely a closing role. You will bring your own senior relationships and your own approach to market outreach; source and originate qualified pipeline; shape the deals; and quarterback complex pursuits alongside the product, delivery, deal-desk, and account teams who carry deals to signature. You will also help shape the pricing, packaging, and commercial constructs for these newer offerings, informed by what you learn in market - an important but secondary part of the role, weighted behind being in market.

Your time is weighted toward the market-making mandate - originating and advancing the Data Studio platform and Rev Cycle BPaaS motion - with continued active selling of Revenue Intellect™ as the near-term, in-market anchor. Success is measured primarily by qualified pipeline sourced and total contract value (TCV) originated on the platform and BPaaS motion, with a secondary line for Revenue Intellect™ bookings.

Recruiting for this role ends on 09/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As a VP Sales Executive on the Converge for Healthcare team, you will be responsible for:

Sell Revenue Intellect™ in market. Actively sell Revenue Intellect™ out of the box across mid-market health systems, regional IDNs, and multi-specialty groups (typically $250M-$2B in net patient revenue), landing near-term wins and reference clients that build credibility for the larger platform story.Make the market for the platform & BPaaS motion. Originate, shape, and quarterback the larger agentic-platform (Data Studio) and revenue-cycle BPaaS pursuits - larger, multi-year, outcome-based engagements - working shoulder-to-shoulder with product, delivery, and solutioning to define both what is sold and how it is delivered. You bring the outreach and the relationships; you are not solely responsible for closing.Pursuit orchestration and pipeline visibility. Partner with Converge for Healthcare leaders, Deloitte Industry account teams, deal desk, inside sales, and marketing to optimize targeting and lead-to-pipeline conversion and to move complex pursuits toward signature; provide structured visibility into qualified pipeline and TCV across the motion.New-logo origination through your own network. Activate your personal network of health system relationships to originate opportunities beyond Deloitte's existing accounts, and set the outreach approach for the segment. Where a Deloitte account relationship exists, you and the account team open doors together and the pursuit team helps carry deals to close.Executive engagement across business and technical buyers. Engage VP and C-suite buyers across revenue cycle, finance, and operations (CFO/COO) on the make-vs-buy decision for BPaaS, and across data, analytics, and IT (CDO/CIO/enterprise architecture) on the platform - advancing deals and building lasting relationships.Shape pricing, packaging, and commercial constructs (secondary). Feed market signal back into the pricing, packaging, and deal constructs for Data Studio and BPaaS - including consumption/capacity-based and outcome-based models - in partnership with the pricing and deal-desk workstream. A field-informed contribution, weighted behind being in market.

A Strong, Successful Candidate Will Possess These Skills

Deep fluency in healthcare revenue cycle operations, including denial management, charge capture, payer contracting, coding, and financial performance management, with the ability to translate domain complexity into clear product value for finance and operations executives.Demonstrated track record of building sales infrastructure in a new or early-stage product context-including playbooks, pipeline processes, and go-to-market frameworks-without significant pre-existing organizational support.Established personal network of senior decision makers across health systems, IDNs, and payer organizations that can be immediately leveraged for pipeline development.Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with proven experience presenting to CFO, CRO, COO, and VP-level audiences and structuring complex product value into clear business and ROI outcomes.Ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles spanning procurement, legal, IT security, and compliance, with the judgment to know when to bring in product, delivery, or solution support.Commercially driven, self-directed orientation - comfortable owning pipeline generation, origination, and forecast within an early, still-forming commercial motion, without heavy day-to-day management support.Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to operate effectively across Deloitte account teams, product leadership, marketing, inside sales, and delivery in a matrixed environment.Practical familiarity with modern sales tooling and operating rhythms, including CRM hygiene, pipeline forecasting discipline, and structured account planning.Fluency with data platforms and agentic/AI capabilities in healthcare, and the ability to position a platform and its outcomes credibly with both technical buyers (data, analytics, IT) and business buyers (finance, operations).Comfort operating across multiple commercial models - subscription, consumption/capacity-based, and outcome/managed-service (BPaaS) - including deals where pricing and packaging are not yet fixed, with sensitivity to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal.Experience selling tech-enabled managed services, business process outsourcing (BPaaS), or outcome-based engagements - where the sale is inseparable from delivery capacity, transition, and client-side operating-model change.Awareness of the broader healthcare market context, including payer-provider dynamics, mid-market consolidation trends, and the competitive landscape across revenue cycle and financial analytics vendors.

The team

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, and works closely with Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering-, product-, and platform-oriented mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions, identifying and investing in areas of growth three, five, and ten years into the future.

Converge for Healthcare combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help health systems and payers improve financial performance, optimize revenue cycle operations, and drive sustainable margin improvement. Revenue Intellect™ is the flagship product within this portfolio, supported by full product, delivery, marketing, and inside sales teams. Business Development leaders in Converge for Healthcare operate at the intersection of product, industry, and client-partnering with Deloitte Partners, Market Makers, Product Leads, and Pursuit Teams to align offerings with priority client opportunities and growth agendas.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS, platform, and/or tech-enabled managed-services sales, with at least 5 of those years selling to or working within healthcare organizations (health systems, IDNs, payers, or physician groups).5+ years originating and carrying complex, multi-stakeholder deals in software, platform, or managed-services sales, including multi-year agreements structured as subscription, consumption, or outcome-based constructs.Demonstrated record of sourcing qualified pipeline and originating multi-million-dollar total contract value (TCV), with experience being measured on pipeline and origination - not solely on individual closed bookings.Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

3+ years selling revenue cycle management, revenue integrity, denials management, financial analytics software, or revenue cycle managed services / BPaaS to mid-market or larger health systems and IDNs.Prior experience working inside a healthcare provider or payer organization in revenue cycle, finance, or health IT.Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, healthcare administration, health informatics, or a related field.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $171,600.00 to $338,300.00.

You may also be eligible to participate in a sales incentive program, whereby you may be eligible to receive certain incentive compensation amounts based on achievement of certain sales goals set forth each year, subject to the terms and conditions of any applicable program document.

#DeloitteNDO

rows.title: Knowledge Management Senior Manager
rows.descriptionText:
About L.EK. Consulting

L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.

How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us.

Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.

Overview Of Function

Knowledge Management (KM) is one of four key pillars to the Solutions Team at L.E.K. Consulting, alongside Data & Analytics, Market Insights, and Information & Research Center. The Solutions team works together to support and enable our consulting team members to generate best in class insights for our clients. Knowledge Management is critical to capturing the best of our consulting staff’s individual and collective expertise to make it available to the broader firm. KM is focused on developing and distributing insights, frameworks, and tools for our consulting team members to leverage on casework and business development, enabling consulting teams to utilize best-in-class insights, approaches, and be more efficient in their work.

The Knowledge Management Manager leads the US KM function to ensure knowledge assets are embedded in core business processes. Reporting to the Solutions Director, this individual oversees U.S. KM operations, drives innovation in knowledge services, and leads a high-performing team of KM professionals across sectors and service lines.

Responsibilities

Knowledge Management Strategy

Collaborate with the Senior Director, Solutions to develop KM’s role in the Solutions portfolio and, alongside EU and APAC leads, to drive the firm's global KM strategy, covering IP development, dissemination, and quality standards across sectors and service lines Ensure knowledge assets are embedded in business processes and accessible to consulting teams for proposal development, case delivery, and business development Coordinate with regional KM leaders and Strategy & Operations teams to set priorities and maintain global consistency Drive the firm's knowledge agenda by identifying capability gaps, setting quality benchmarks, and championing best practices 

Team Management and Engagement

Provide oversight of the US KM team and US-aligned, India-based Content team Support KM team members in developing expertise, building strong relationships, and amplifying impact Meet regularly with KM sector and service line teams to support progress on initiatives and address sector and stakeholder needs Drive the team to own and continuously improve the breadth, depth, and quality of recommendations and support Oversee onboarding of new team members and support professional development and career progression Foster a strong sense of KM team community and shared purpose across the function 

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

Drive the innovation and evolution of KM offerings and best practices, including:Increased automation of core processesHarnessing AI tools to surface new knowledge and insights at scaleIdentification and piloting of new servicesUnifying knowledge silos and repositories into a more streamlined interfaceContinued evolution of team structure and operating modelSupporting further technology initiatives, including enhanced platform functionalityDrive visibility and uptake of knowledge tools 
Stakeholder and Cross-functional Collaboration

Promote and elevate the KM value proposition to senior stakeholders across the firm Collaborate with other Solutions leads (primary and secondary research) to integrate functions and functional knowledge for a more cohesive stakeholder experience Partner with sector and functional leaders and regional KM teams to align on knowledge priorities Advise on new and existing KM initiatives, providing strategic guidance to the broader team Represent KM interests in cross-functional forums, contributing to firmwide capability-building efforts 

Qualifications

5-10 or more years of experience in knowledge management, internal insights, or intellectual property (IP) management role Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing teams in a global or matrixed organization Strong understanding of ever-evolving KM principles, IP lifecycle management, and knowledge dissemination strategies Deep familiarity with KM technologies and AI tools, including proprietary search solutions and generative AI platforms Experience working across sectors and service lines, with the ability to set priorities and drive global consistency Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate the value of KM to diverse audiences Strong project management skills with a bias for action and continuous improvement 

Additional Information:  

The expected base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonus and a comprehensive benefits package. L.E.K. Consulting offers a competitive total rewards package including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with employer contribution, HSA contributions (where applicable), paid time off, and other firm-sponsored benefits.This role is based in either our Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, New York, or San Francisco office and follows our hybrid work model for U.S. offices.  We require employees to be in their assigned home office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday each week, as well as the first Friday of each month.Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for employer sponsorship. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider candidates requiring visa sponsorship, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, F-1 (OPT/CPT/STEM), or other work authorization.L.E.K. Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.In accordance with applicable state and local laws, we will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs, practices, or observances.For more information and to apply, please visit: https://www.lek.com/careers/apply

rows.title: Cyber Forward Deployed Engineer - Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Deloitte's Cyber team helps our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, and enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage their security posture.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you will do:

As a Cyber Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Manager, you will lead delivery of cybersecurity and AI-enabled solutions at the intersection of client engagement and hands-on engineering. You will lead teams on delivering high-quality solutions while playing a key role in deal shaping, scaling delivery practices, and enabling long-term client and team capability.

Solution Delivery & Engineering (Primary Focus)

Translate business and cybersecurity needs into high-quality technical solutions (including AI/GenAI-enabled capabilities where applicable), and deploy them for clients in alignment with their requirements and architectureIdentify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues within scope

Pre-Sales & Deal Shaping

Partner with stakeholders to help shape technical solutions during pursuits, including leading demos/POCs/prototypesContribute to solution design, ensuring alignment between client needs and delivery feasibility.Partner with leadership to influence technical win strategy, including pricing inputs, and effort estimation, ensuring alignment between client needs, feasibility, and commercial viability.

Customer Delivery Leadership

Own overall customer satisfaction, proactively managing expectations, delivery quality, and outcomes to ensure a strong client experience.Build and maintain trusted client relationships, addressing escalations effectively and driving continuous improvement based on client feedback.Ensure delivery aligns with agreed scope, timelines, and cost estimates, proactively managing deviations to protect margins and client outcomes.Drive delivery efficiency and unit economics by optimizing team structure, utilization, and effort allocation across engagements

Product Feedback & Continuous Improvement

Capture and translate delivery learnings into actionable product or platform improvements, distinguishing reusable enhancements from client-specific needs.Enable client teams through structured knowledge transfer, clear documentation, and practical runbooks.

The Team

Deloitte's Cyber Engineering is a new team that is spearheading the buildout of Cybersecurity technology that will underpin the next generation of our Cybersecurity services. Join us as we work with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity to build future capabilities today.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.Ability to travel up to 20% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

We require 8+ years of experience for all areas below:

Hands-on experience in full stack development across frontend and backend technologies.Experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Next.js).Backend experience in Node.js, Python (Django/Flask), or Java (Spring Boot).Experience with relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).Experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, and serverless architectures.Experience conducting code reviews and guiding teams on best practices.Experience delivering and scaling applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and development lifecycle tools (e.g., Git, Azure DevOps).

We require 1+ years of experience for all areas below:

1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments1+ years of experience with one of the following Frontier Gen AI Platforms: Anthropic, Google or Open AI, including hands on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Claude API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, Gemini API, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Grounding, Google Workspace integration, GPT-4o, Assistants API, Responses API, OpenAI Agents Experience guiding teams on AI architecture, platform selection and integration into production systems.Experience with scalability, governance, and performance considerations for AI-enabled solutions.

Client-Facing & Delivery Ownership

 8+ Years experience leading technical solutioning in pursuits, including demos, POCs, and proposal inputs.8+ Years experience defining scope, estimating effort, and aligning solutions with delivery feasibility and business goals.8+ Years experience working with senior client stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. 8+ Years experience articulating technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs.8+ Years experience demonstrating accountability and ownership mindset in achieving client outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Anthropic experience and/or certification STRONGLY preferredFamiliarity with cybersecurity concepts (e.g., application security, cloud security, identity, detection engineering).Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.Exposure to search/analytics platforms (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) or graph databases (Neo4j).Knowledge of Kubernetes, GitOps, or advanced cloud-native patterns.Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).Basic familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).

CompensationThe wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $155,600 - $306,800.

rows.title: Cyber Forward Deployed Engineer - Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Deloitte's Cyber team helps our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, and enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage their security posture.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

 Work you will do: 

As a Cyber Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Sr Consultant, you will drive delivery of cybersecurity and AI-enabled solutions at the intersection of client engagement and hands-on engineering. You will lead teams on delivering high-quality solutions while playing a key role in deal shaping, scaling delivery practices, and enabling long-term client and team capability.

Solution Delivery & Engineering (Primary Focus)

 Translate business and cybersecurity needs into high-quality technical solutions (including AI/GenAI-enabled capabilities where applicable), and deploy them for clients in alignment with their requirements and architecture  Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues within scope 

 Pre-Sales & Deal Shaping 

 Partner with stakeholders to help shape technical solutions during pursuits, including leading demos/POCs/prototypes  Contribute to solution design, ensuring alignment between client needs and delivery feasibility.  Partner with leadership to influence technical win strategy, including pricing inputs, and effort estimation, ensuring alignment between client needs, feasibility, and commercial viability. 

 Customer Delivery Leadership 

 Own overall customer satisfaction, proactively managing expectations, delivery quality, and outcomes to ensure a strong client experience.  Build and maintain trusted client relationships, addressing escalations effectively and driving continuous improvement based on client feedback.  Ensure delivery aligns with agreed scope, timelines, and cost estimates, proactively managing deviations to protect margins and client outcomes.  Drive delivery efficiency and unit economics by optimizing team structure, utilization, and effort allocation across engagements 

 Product Feedback & Continuous Improvement 

 Capture and translate delivery learnings into actionable product or platform improvements, distinguishing reusable enhancements from client-specific needs.  Enable client teams through structured knowledge transfer, clear documentation, and practical runbooks. 

 The Team 

Deloitte's Cyber Engineering is a new team that is spearheading the buildout of Cybersecurity technology that will underpin the next generation of our Cybersecurity services. Join us as we work with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity to build future capabilities today.

Required Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.  Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.  Ability to travel up to 20% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. 

 We require 5+ years of experience for all areas below: 

 Hands-on experience in full stack development across frontend and backend technologies.  Experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Next.js).  Backend experience in Node.js, Python (Django/Flask), or Java (Spring Boot).  Experience with relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).  Experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, and serverless architectures.  Experience conducting code reviews and guiding teams on best practices.  Experience delivering and scaling applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.  Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and development lifecycle tools (e.g., Git, Azure DevOps). 

 We require 1+ years of experience for all areas below: 

 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments  1+ years of experience with one of the following Frontier Gen AI Platforms: Anthropic, Google or Open AI, including hands on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Claude API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, Gemini API, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Grounding, Google Workspace integration, GPT-4o, Assistants API, Responses API, OpenAI Agents  Experience guiding teams on AI architecture, platform selection and integration into production systems.  Experience with scalability, governance, and performance considerations for AI-enabled solutions. 

 Client-Facing & Delivery Ownership 

 5+ Years experience leading technical solutioning in pursuits, including demos, POCs, and proposal inputs.  5+ Years experience defining scope, estimating effort, and aligning solutions with delivery feasibility and business goals.  5+ Years experience working with senior client stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.  5+ Years experience articulating technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs.  5+ Years experience demonstrating accountability and ownership mindset in achieving client outcomes. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Anthropic experience and/or certification STRONGLY preferred  Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts (e.g., application security, cloud security, identity, detection engineering).  Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.  Exposure to search/analytics platforms (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) or graph databases (Neo4j).  Knowledge of Kubernetes, GitOps, or advanced cloud-native patterns.  Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).  Basic familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch). 

Compensation

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Do you thrive in times of disruption? Have a passion for turning challenges and opportunities into long-term competitive advantages? The Deloitte Audit and Assurance practice helps organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities-from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational, cyber, and regulatory risks-to gain competitive advantage. Our market-leading team's help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.

The team

Our professionals understand the dynamics of serving complex, global clients across multiple industries, and the importance of increasing transparency around business performance. Qualifications

Preferred:

Master's in accounting or Information SystemsAt least one of the following certifications: CISA, CISSP, CIA, CISMSAP, NetSuite, Peoplesoft or Oracle controls experiencePrior work experience with a Big-4 or other Accounting and Consulting Firm
