This role leads that effort for ZAIDYN and ZS's broader product portfolio, managing the Product Demand Generation team and partnering closely with Product Marketing to turn product priorities into in-market activation.

What You'll Do

Lead planning and execution of a portfolio of demand generation programs for ZAIDYN and ZS's broader product portfolio, ensuring priorities, resources and delivery standards are aligned across audiences, segments and use cases; Partner closely with Product Marketing to bring product priorities to life as integrated, multi-channel activation plans spanning digital, ABM, events, alliances and other channels; Manage campaign performance against goals related to engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution, and ROI, using results to continuously sharpen targeting, messaging deployment and channel mix; Guide deployment of campaign assets and business-support materials, including product demos, trial and adoption content, and sales-facing materials, that drive conversion and account engagement; Lead a Product Demand Generation team, covering professional development and day-to-day management to ensure focus on defined priorities and delivery of expected results; Establish team processes, governance, and execution standards for campaign planning, delivery, reporting, attribution and lead management; Lead post-campaign reviews and translate results into recommendations that improve marketing operations, campaign scalability and pipeline impact; Represent Product Demand Generation in cross-functional planning with Product Marketing and Consulting Marketing, helping shape how the teams work together as the model evolves. 

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree required in marketing or a related business discipline, advanced degree preferred; 10-12+ years of B2B demand generation, campaign leadership, or integrated marketing experience; experience marketing SaaS platforms, enterprise software, or technical products strongly preferred; Proven experience successfully leading and coaching a marketing team; Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously and translate strategic priorities into scalable, in-market programs; Experience partnering closely with product marketing or product management counterparts to align activation with product strategy; Deep knowledge of campaign execution, marketing operations, attribution and cross-channel activation; Experience developing and managing plans, budgets, and deadlines, as well as achieving and evaluating results; Experience with marketing automation platforms, CRM systems and reporting/analytics tools. 

Additional Skills & Requirements: 

Exceptional presentation and communication skills, both verbal and written, including experience presenting to and influencing senior executives in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment; Critical thinking and the capacity for innovative and original thought with strong attention to detail; Strong international collaboration skills, working with India preferred; Comfort operating with ambiguity and helping define process alongside the team, rather than simply following an established one; Must be a self-starter who is able to learn quickly and independently. 

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Find Out More At:

www.zs.com

ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

ZS’s Corporate Enterprise Functions comprise team-oriented, pragmatic and results-driven people who thrive in a challenging work environment. Our people come from diverse backgrounds but share a passion for quality customer service and dedication—whether our customer is a client or another ZS employee.

DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MARKETING

As the director of product marketing, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategy and messaging for our platform and product offerings. You will work closely with firm leadership, product management and sales while leading a team of talented marketers to develop and execute marketing plans that resonate with our target audiences, drive demand, and ultimately contribute to the growth and success of ZS.

What You’ll Do:

Develop cohesive marketing plan and strategies that successfully position platform and product offerings for growth.Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and competitive developments, providing insights and recommendations to inform platform and product roadmap decisions and future marketing strategies.Leverage customer satisfaction, win/loss analysis, competitive landscape and industry trends to develop competitive platform and product positioning, messaging and differentiation strategies.Collaborate with product management to develop competitive need/gap analysis, align platform/product roadmaps and pricing strategy. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product management, sales, and customer success to ensure portfolio alignment and drive product success throughout the lifecycle.Create compelling messaging and positioning that effectively communicates the value proposition of our platform and product offerings to various target audiences.Oversee the creation of thought leadership, sales enablement materials, customer case studies, demos and other content assets to support demand generation, lead nurturing, and sales conversion efforts.Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new product launches, working closely with product management to drive successful product introductions and adoption.Track and analyze key performance metrics to assess and optimize the effectiveness of marketing strategies and drive continuous improvement.Manage the hiring, development, and retention of product marketing talent; provide day-to-day leadership and direction to product marketing team.

rows.title: TikTok LIVE - AI Data Operation Specialist (Russian Speaking)
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
The livestream industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become the next growth driver for TikTok global business. It also brings great joy to users globally and it creates a new channel for our creators to show themselves.

We are seeking an AI Data Operation Specialist to join our team to lead quality initiatives in content moderation—leveraging both human labeling and machine learning models, including Large Language Models (LLMs). This role plays a critical part in upholding content quality across TikTok Live platform. The ideal candidate will be deeply involved in training AI models, analyzing moderation data to extract actionable insights, resolving complex content scenarios, and working closely with partner teams to ensure effective issue resolution. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, high ownership, and the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams. A keen eye for detail and a proactive mindset toward challenging existing processes and driving continuous improvement are essential.

- Ensure high-quality content benchmarking across BPO teams, support the setup, onboarding, and training of new BPO teams. Manage policy clarifications, calibrations, and arbitration processes. Analyze BPO team performance to identify knowledge gaps and systemic issues.
- Handle content labeling for specific queues based on cross-functional business requirements, analyze labeled content to identify trends and provide insights to project teams and independently manage quality evaluation initiatives, delivering actionable analytical insights.
- Train models using large datasets of labeled content to improve decision-making accuracy. Enhance model capabilities through iterative training and reinforcement learning, assist in data preparation, cleaning, and structuring for training purposes. Improve model accuracy by testing and fine-tuning, highlight the algorithm team with supporting examples for any potential gaps in LLM decision making draft, revise, and quality-check content to explore and enhance the synergy between human input and data in LLM training.
- Analyze moderation and labeling data from multiple queues to derive a process or market specific trend/correlation. Arrange supporting data points for impact analysis and solution planning.
- Custodian of all quality specific artifacts for the content moderation scope, generating creative solutions, including the use of technology and tools, to enhance the quality of both individual and team outputs.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Communications, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in AI data operation, leveraging AI and ML for content quality management, product operations, or a related analytics role, preferably in tech, digital content, or platform moderation environments
- Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or similar
- Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Strong ability to analyze complex datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable insights
- Fluency in both written and spoken English is essential as it will be utilized as the primary language for daily work. In addition, to better understand live streaming content in specific regions and better monitor and improve the ecosystem health of the Russian-speaking markets, proficiency in Russian language is also necessary.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Able to review and analyze potentially disturbing content with objectivity, professionalism, and emotional resilience
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, influence strategy, and drive impactful solutions
- Highly adaptable, proactive, and self-motivated, with a proven ability to thrive in fast-paced and constantly evolving environments
- Solid understanding of machine learning principles, including model evaluation metrics and optimization techniques
- A deep interest in LLMs, human behavior and user experience is essential. The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic learner who finds engagement with diverse case studies and annotators stimulating
- Experience as RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) annotators for leading AI/LLM companies is strongly preferred

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

rows.title: Staff Marketing Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

The Marketing Science team at Snap helps advertisers maximize ROI from Snap’s advertising platform through advanced measurement and analytics. rows.title: Customer Experience Program Manager, Fulfilment, EMEA
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
About the Team:
The e-commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. This role sits within the EMEA E-Commerce Governance and Experience team. This team is responsible for ensuring our marketplace is engaging, safe and trustworthy for not only users, but also sellers and creators. We put the customer at the heart of our business and work on policies, rules, products and systems to ensure a best in class customer experience (CX). 

About the Role:
In this role, you'll use data and customer feedback to scope opportunities to improve delivery experience. You will build data driven business cases and work closely with our logistics partners to implement customer centric solutions to our delivery related product features, customer service, and communications. 

To be successful in this role you will need to have strong analytical, problem solving, planning and stakeholder management skills. 

Key Responsibilities Include:
- Analyse data, identify key areas for improvement and translate into clear, concise, and impactful solution insights that inform the business strategy and project prioritization in the Business Requirements Document.
- Triangulate findings and insights from across different sources to scope out key customer problems and collaborate with cross functional teams and key stakeholders to gather requirements, design best fit solutions, and negotiate project timelines and resources.
- Produce and own the project plan for implementation, ensuring that all interdependencies are identified and tracked to schedule.

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Vendor & Law Firm Management to lead the strategic, commercial and operational management of TikTok Legal’s relationships with outside counsel, alternative legal service providers (ALSPs) and other strategic legal vendors.
Reporting to the Global Head of Legal Operations, this role will build and lead a world-class global outside counsel and legal vendor management program. The Senior Manager will develop the frameworks, processes, data, technology-enabled workflows and commercial strategies needed to optimize external legal spend, provider performance and service delivery. This role requires a commercially savvy, analytically rigorous operator who can build trusted relationships with senior attorneys and law firm partners and turn data into better decisions and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities:
Outside Counsel Strategy & Panel Management
- Develop and manage a global Outside Counsel Management Program with Legal leadership and Practice Leads.
- Define strategies for using law firms and ALSPs, including preferred counsel programs, panel structures, and practice-area and geographic coverage.
- Establish frameworks for allocating external legal resources and advise on firm selection, relationship strategy and resource allocation.
- Manage preferred-firm and strategic-provider relationships through structured governance and executive business reviews.
- Standardize provider onboarding, engagement, evaluation and offboarding.
Commercial & Legal Spend Management
- Lead commercial management of outside counsel and strategic vendors, including rate negotiations, matter budgets, fixed fees, AFAs, volume arrangements and other pricing models.
- Analyze spend, rates, matter economics and utilization to improve cost, predictability and resource allocation.
- Strengthen budgeting, forecasting, accruals and spend visibility.
- Deliver savings, cost avoidance and greater value while protecting quality and legal outcomes.
- Develop benchmarks and market intelligence for commercial and rate negotiations.
Competitive Sourcing & RFPs
- Lead sourcing and RFPs for outside counsel and legal services with Practice Leads and Procurement.
- Develop sourcing strategies, RFP materials, evaluation criteria, pricing analyses and recommendations.
- Evaluate firms consistently across quality, economics, capabilities, technology, innovation and demonstrated value.
- Provide analysis for sourcing and resource-allocation decisions.
Provider Performance & Value Management
- Build a scalable framework to measure and improve provider performance.
- Develop scorecards, KPIs and business reviews covering quality, responsiveness, staffing, efficiency, budget performance, innovation and value.
- Gather structured feedback from attorneys and Practice Leads and convert insights into management actions.
- Lead strategic reviews with key firms and vendors.
Legal Vendor Lifecycle & Operations
- Own the provider lifecycle from sourcing and onboarding through engagement, renewal and offboarding.
- Create standardized processes, playbooks, guidelines and governance.
- Build technology-enabled workflows for intake, sourcing, onboarding, engagement, billing, performance management and offboarding.
- Partner with relevant functions to implement controls for vendor risk, information security, confidentiality, data handling and compliance.
Billing, E-Billing & Financial Controls
- Partner with Legal Finance and technology teams to strengthen billing and e-billing operations.
- Establish and maintain Outside Counsel Guidelines and billing standards with Legal leadership.
- Monitor compliance and reduce billing leakage, non-compliance and inefficient spend.
- Improve invoice workflows, accruals, forecasting and spend reporting with Finance and e-billing teams.
- Use billing and matter data to improve pricing, staffing, matter management and provider performance.
Data, Analytics & Executive Reporting
- Build a data and reporting framework for outside counsel and vendor management.
- Develop dashboards covering spend, rates, matter volumes, budgets, forecasts, savings, panel utilization and provider performance.
- Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations for Legal leadership.
- Establish KPIs and benchmarks for decisions about external legal resources.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
- Significant amount of relevant experience in legal operations, outside counsel or law firm management, legal spend, legal procurement, professional services management or a related field, including within a large, complex and global corporate legal.
- Demonstrated expertise in law firm economics, legal spend management and commercial negotiations, including rates, matter budgets, AFAs and other pricing models.
- Experience managing or influencing complex networks of law firms, alternative legal service providers (ALSPs) and legal vendors
- Experience developing and implementing outside counsel programs, preferred-provider panels, RFPs, scorecards and performance-management frameworks.
- Strong analytical and technology skills, including the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations and leverage e-billing, matter management, spend analytics, automation and emerging AI capabilities.
- Exceptional communication and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence senior attorneys, law firm partners and cross-functional executives.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Advanced degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field is preferred.
- Experience designing and operationalizing end-to-end lifecycle-management processes for external legal providers, from sourcing and onboarding through performance management, renewal and offboarding.
- Experience leading or collaborating with global, distributed and cross-functional teams.
- Familiarity with vendor-risk management, information security, confidentiality, data governance and compliance requirements applicable to external legal providers.

rows.title: Data Engineer, Product Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building some of the world's most extensive data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a world-class data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a strong focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.

Data Engineer, Product Analytics Responsibilities:

Manage and execute data warehouse plans for a product or a group of products to solve well-scoped problemsIdentify the data needed for a business problem and implement logging required to ensure availability of data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolveCollaborate with engineers, product managers and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights in a meaningful wayBuild data expertise and leverage data controls to ensure privacy, security, compliance, data quality, and operations for allocated areas of ownershipDesign, build and launch new data models and visualizations in production, leveraging common development toolkitsIndependently design, build and launch new data extraction, transformation and loading processes in production, mentoring others around efficient queriesSupport existing processes running in production and implement optimized solutions with limited guidanceDefine and manage Service Level Agreements for data sets in allocated areas of ownership

Minimum Qualifications:

2+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positionsBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience2+ years of experience with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala or others.)

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's or Ph.D degree in a STEM fieldDemonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

rows.title: Lead Business Intelligence Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer for Snap’s People Team. This person will be a trusted business partner who brings together technical expertise, business acumen, and analytical rigor. They will work closely with engineering, People Science, business leaders, and HR leadership to lead business intelligence and analytics engineering initiatives, design scalable data solutions, deliver meaningful insights, and enable data-informed decision-making.

What you’ll do:

Lead complex, high-impact business intelligence and analytics engineering initiatives from problem definition through delivery. Translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical and analytical approaches, working with stakeholders to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize solutions. Independently own your workflow and delivery, using sound judgment to prioritize work, manage timelines and dependencies, address risks or blockers, and keep stakeholders informed. Design and architect reliable, scalable data pipelines, data models, and self-service analytics solutions using tools such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, Airflow, Visier, Looker, and Posit. Own key data products or systems end-to-end, including technical design and architecture, quality, reliability, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement. Conduct rigorous analysis and translate complex findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, reduce manual work, and build more scalable solutions. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, contribute to team standards and best practices, and help foster a culture of learning and high-quality execution. 

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience designing and building reliable data pipelines, models, and analytics solutions, and the ability to leverage AI-assisted development and analytics tools responsibly; and willingness to adopt new technologies as needs evolve. Deep understanding of the data ecosystem, including data warehouses, dimensional and semantic modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, analytics layers, visualization tools, and self-service data products. Demonstrated ability to design reliable, scalable data architectures and improve data quality, performance, maintainability, and operational resilience. Ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently navigate complex or ambiguous problems, make sound technical and architectural decisions, manage priorities across multiple workstreams, and drive work forward with limited direction. Experience applying analytical and statistical methods, including descriptive analysis, regression, correlation, time series analysis, and hypothesis testing, using tools such as Python or R. Business acumen and experience translating business questions into clear metrics, analytical requirements, data solutions, and actionable insights, with careful attention to scope, consistency, and interpretation. Ability to lead through influence and communicate complex technical and analytical concepts clearly across executives, business partners, analysts, and technical teams. Strong judgment and commitment to data quality, privacy, security, governance, and the responsible use of People data. 

Minimum Qualifications:

BS/BA degree in a technical field (e.g., computer science, mathematics) or a research-based social science field (e.g., public policy, sociology). 6+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, quantitative analysis, or a related field or a Master’s degree in a technical field + 5+ year of post-grad experience; or a PhD in a related technical field + 2+ years of post-grad experience6+ years of experience with SQL or similar query languages and development experience in at least one object-oriented or scripting language (Python, Java, Scala, etc.); Python preferred. 3+ years of experience designing and building dashboards, reports, and other end-user analytics solutions using data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, Visier, Posit, or similar platforms. 

Preferred Qualifications:

MA/MS in a technical and/or research-based field. Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform and data technologies such as BigQuery and Airflow. Experience working in an agile development environment and collaborating across technical and business teams. Experience with version control systems such as Git. Experience working with People data, including workforce and Talent Acquisition data, and familiarity with People analytics platforms such as Visier. 

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

Compensation

In the United States, work locations are assigned a pay zone which determines the salary range for the position. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The starting pay may be negotiable within the salary range for the position. These pay zones may be modified in the future.

The base salary range for this position is $190,000-$284,000 annually.

Zone B:

The base salary range for this position is $181,000-$270,000 annually.

Zone C:

The base salary range for this position is $162,000-$241,000 annually.

This position is eligible for equity in the form of RSUs.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Multimodal - Intelligent Integrity
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
Our Business Integrity team has a strong user focus and a dedication to technical excellence. We aim to meet our users’ needs with reliable and high-performing platforms and services. We are looking for strong machine learning engineers who are excited to grow their business understanding, build highly scalable machine learning models, and partner across disciplines with global teams, in pursuit of excellence. Given the fast growth of TikTok in the world, we are working on building a next-generation content understanding system for TikTok monetization. We are seeking Research Engineers who are experienced in machine learning, which can help us create an ecosystem that rewards high quality user experience and advertiser value.

1. Focus on ad content understanding and security, conduct algorithm R&D for large model implementation, and apply LLM/MLLM and other AIGC technologies to e-commerce and short-video ad content understanding to build a next-gen large model-based commercial intelligence review system.

Minimum Qualifications:
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in CS, AI, Mathematics, Statistics or related majors, with 1+ year of algorithm R&D/project implementation experience in content understanding or AIGC.

rows.title: Data Scientist - TikTok Integrity and Safety (San Jose)
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
About the Team
Join our team and leverage the power of data science to directly safeguard content, users, and privacy on TikTok. You will provide critical data-driven insights for platform responsibility and safety initiatives, including video content safety, live content safety, account security, privacy compliance, and moderation platforms, ultimately enhancing the safety experience for millions of users worldwide.

Responsibilities - What You'II Do
- Design, build, and maintain core metrics systems related to platform content safety and risk, including but not limited to content violation, user report, and account risk identification. Develop comprehensive monitoring and anomaly detection systems to quickly identify and analyze security incidents, providing data support for risk alerts and policy adjustments.
- Apply rigorous statistical methods, including A/B testing, causal inference, regression analysis, and more, to evaluate the effectiveness of security policies. You will deeply analyze experiment results, provide quantitative evidence for business decisions, and continuously optimize experiment design to improve evaluation efficiency.
- Develop quantitative analysis systems for specific business challenges and leverage data mining techniques to identify potential optimization opportunities. rows.descriptionText:
The Sales Operations Core Solutions team of Meta Reality Labs is seeking an experienced Solutions Architect. In this role, you will play a crucial part in designing and deploying cutting-edge sales tools and systems to support critical sales capabilities and drive business success.The core function of this Solutions Architect position is to empower the Reality Labs Retail, Sales, Operations and Partnerships teams, ensuring they have the essential capabilities to operate, satisfy customer and partner needs, and grow the business. A significant aspect of this role involves leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to develop and deploy AI-enhanced solutions. These solutions will augment business intelligence, automate processes, and generate predictive insights, ultimately enabling business growth and operational efficiency. This role is responsible for the development and maintenance of the technical solutions, tooling, and platforms that business-facing teams use daily. A key focus is on improving internal team productivity, increasing operational efficiency, and-providing data driven insights. Crucially, these systems not only improve productivity but also establish the fundamental business records that underpin key business decision-making processes.The Solution Architect will partner with a wide range of cross-functional teams such as business stakeholders, program managers and engineering teams throughout the development life cycle. In this technical role, the Solutions Architect will apply their core skill set and experiences to define scalable solutions partnering with internal engineering, data analytics, data engineering teams, and external technology vendors to deliver impactful results. The Solutions Architect is additionally responsible for ensuring an effective maintenance protocol is in place for completed solutions.

Solutions Architect Responsibilities:

Architect and Design Scalable Solutions: Take on ambiguous, complex business problems and design robust, scalable, and secure solutions that meet the needs of our internal and external partners. You will own the technical design from concept to launch, ensuring alignment with our long-term technical strategy and business roadmapDrive Technical Strategy and Roadmaps: Identify and define the projects and initiatives required to solve key business challenges. You will be responsible for creating and managing the technical roadmap for your domain, ensuring that we are making the right investments to support our growthLead Cross-Functional Programs: Lead large-scale, cross-functional technical programs from design to deployment. You will work closely with engineering, product, data, and business teams to ensure that we deliver high-quality solutions on time and within budgetProvide Technical Leadership and Mentorship: As a key member of the team, you will be expected to provide technical leadership and mentorship to others. You will be a go-to expert for your domainChampion Operational Excellence: Design and implement solutions that are not only scalable and performant, but also highly reliable and maintainable. You will be responsible for defining and implementing best practices for operational monitoring, support, documentation and will lead business continuity efforts while driving ongoing improvements to the tools and processes owned by Core SolutionsAI Native Mindset: Champion AI-native approaches by designing and integrating advanced AI and machine learning solutions into sales processes and customer experiences. This includes leveraging Meta’s AI platforms and models to automate workflows, generate data-driven insights, and enable personalized engagement at scale. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure responsible, privacy-compliant AI adoption, continuously explore emerging AI technologies, and empower both internal teams and customers to realize the full value of AI-powered innovation within the RL Sales ecosystem

rows.descriptionText:
Meta's Internal Audit team is seeking an experienced audit professional to lead product risk and compliance audit engagements across Meta's portfolio of consumer and enterprise products. In this role, you will evaluate the design and effectiveness of controls governing product development lifecycles, regulatory compliance obligations, privacy frameworks, and risk management practices embedded within Meta's product organizations. You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders across product, legal, privacy, and compliance teams to provide independent assurance and drive meaningful improvements to how Meta manages product-related risks at scale. Strong programming skills in Python, JavaStrong problem-solving skills with a focus on system performance, scalability, and efficiencyGood understanding of distributed systems and the infrastructure components of large-scale ML Experience with big data processing frameworks such as Spark, Flink, or RayAbility to collaborate and work well with othersProven track record of operating highly-available systems at significant scaleAbility to proactively learn new concepts and apply them at workAdaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as computer science or equivalent experience2+ years of post-Bachelor’s software development experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 1+ year of post-grad software development experience; or PhD in a relevant technical fieldExperience building large scale production machine learning systems, distributed systems or big data processing

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters/PhD in a technical field such as computer science or equivalent industry experienceExperience working with ML Training platforms or optimizing AI model inferenceFamiliarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Caffe2, Spark ML, scikit-learn, or related frameworks

EOE, including disability/vets.

rows.title: Senior Director, Corporate FP&A
rows.descriptionText:
As Marqeta's Senior Director, Corporate FP&A, you will lead Marqeta's company-wide planning, forecasting, and operating expense function — and significantly elevate how it operates.

You will inherit a small, dedicated team — spanning corporate finance and headcount forecasting, and finance business partnership across the company —. The function is at an inflection point: Marqeta has grown significantly, and there is meaningful headroom to modernize how the team operates — integrating data flows, automating recurring processes, and freeing the team to focus on analysis and partnership rather than production. Your mandate is to build on a solid foundation and elevate the function to the standard a public company at our scale deserves.

The single biggest mandate is automation. Sigma is in place, AI is available, and the appetite for transformation is real. We need an architect — someone who examines every data stream, every recurring process, and every manual report and asks, "why is a human still doing this by hand?" — then redesigns the flow from source systems to the executive view.

You will also own the company's planning rhythms and strategy — the annual operating plan, long-range plan, quarterly forecasts, monthly close commentary, board materials, and the calendar that ties them together — as well as operating expense end-to-end: headcount (the largest investment), vendor spend, T&E, capital expenditure, and the cost structure that drives Marqeta's profitability.

The right leader operates as a true business partner to the executive team and functional leaders — understanding what the company must invest in to win, helping leaders structure trade-offs, and finding creative paths when the answer is not obvious. You will hold the broader picture and use that perspective to help functional leaders make better decisions.

You will partner closely with the CFO, the executive team, and functional leaders, and serve as a key partner to me as VP of FP&A. I am hiring for this role because I need a senior partner who can architect what this function should become — modernizing the systems, integrating the data, and elevating the team to the standard a public company at our scale deserves. The right person is energized by that mandate: someone who sees an opportunity to build something modern and durable, and who is eager to develop a team along the way.

While we work Flexible First we have a strong preference for candidates based in Oakland. You'll be expected to be in-office for Board meetings. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

Transformation, automation, and systems architecture. Be the architect of how data flows through FP&A — from source systems through Sigma and AI tooling to the executive view — and drive an aggressive automation agenda where every recurring report, templated update, and monthly refresh is a candidate. Own the FP&A systems and tooling roadmap and the data architecture that feeds them, and make automation contagious by building tools and workflows that serve finance leadership and cross-functional counterparts too. The function should be known as the team that automates first.Leadership of the Corporate & Functional FP&A team. Lead the team of 3-4 across central planning and business partnership. Be a teacher and mentor first — coaching the team on modern FP&A practices, setting a clear bar for analytical quality and business partnership, and defining how the team works together as it scales.Company-wide planning & forecasting. Build out the annual operating plan, long-range plan, quarterly forecast, and monthly close commentary — how they run, what they produce, and how they connect. Design the planning calendar and cross-functional rhythms (budget reviews, QBRs, planning kickoffs) that make it real, and drive the financial narrative for board materials, exec reviews, and investor-facing analysis in partnership with the CFO and IR.Opex & headcount management. Own company-wide opex forecasting end-to-end — headcount (the biggest driver), vendor spend, T&E, capex, and the broader cost structure. Build the headcount planning process that ties business priorities to investment decisions in partnership with People Ops, Recruiting, and functional leaders. Surface risks and opportunities in the cost structure proactively, and partner with Accounting on close-cycle accuracy and the integrity of opex actuals.Public company accounting & GAAP partnership. Be the senior finance voice on the technical accounting topics that shape Marqeta's P&L — stock-based comp, capitalized software development costs, and GAAP treatment decisions that flow through opex. Partner deeply with the Controller, Technical Accounting, and Audit teams on the forecasting implications of policy decisions, and make sure the team is fluent enough in GAAP to forecast accurately and partner credibly with Accounting.Strategic partnership. Serve as a senior finance partner to the CFO and exec team — at the table for strategic decisions about investment, hiring, org design, and cost structure. Partner with functional leaders (CTO, CPO, COO, etc.) on the financial implications of their plans and the levers they have to manage their cost base — helping them structure trade-offs and find creative paths, not just defend a budget number. Translate financial reality into the story the business needs to act on.

Who You Are

Background and credentials. Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Math, or similar); MBA welcomed but not required with equivalent experience; CPA or equivalent strongly preferred. 15+ years of progressive FP&A experience at scaled operating companies, including meaningful public-company FP&A experience, and 7+ years managing FP&A teams with a track record of developing analysts and senior analysts into stronger versions of themselves.Deep corporate FP&A and opex expertise. Annual planning, long-range planning, quarterly forecasting, monthly close commentary, and board materials — owned end-to-end at scale, not just contributed to. Fluent in the mechanics of opex and headcount management: build-up, ramp, attrition, vendor spend, T&E, capex, and how it all ties into a coherent operating expense view.Deep public-company accounting and GAAP fluency. You know stock-based comp cold. You've worked with capitalized software development costs, lease accounting, and the technical topics that materially affect a tech company's P&L, and you hold your own with Controllers, technical accounting teams, and auditors.An architect of data streams with automation as a default reflex. You don't just consume reports — you've designed how data flows through a finance function, building (or rebuilding) the connective tissue between source systems, planning tools, BI layers, and the executive view. You think in pipelines, not spreadsheets. When you see a manual recurring process, your first instinct is "how do we make this run itself," and you've actually done it across reports, dashboards, forecasts, and analytical workflows.AI-fluent and already deploying it. You have an informed, opinionated view on how AI changes the work of FP&A, with real examples of putting it to work on a finance team. Past experimentation, into deployment.A teacher and mentor at heart. You lead by developing people. You take pride in watching analysts and senior analysts grow under your leadership, and your team leaves your function stronger than they arrived. Comfortable inheriting a function that needs evolution —you see building out systems, integrating data, and developing a team as a great mandate, and you've done this kind of work beforeA true business partner to the executive team and functional leaders. You understand financial planning is about helping the company invest in what will make it win, not about defending a number. You hold the strategic picture, find creative paths, and tell leaders what's possible — not just what isn't. You earn trust because operators know you're trying to help them succeed within real constraints.A strategic partner to executives and functional leaders alike. You've been the senior finance voice to a CFO and exec team before, bringing point of view rather than just numbers — executives want you in the room when consequential decisions are getting made. Equally effective with CTOs, CPOs, COOs, or equivalents, helping them understand and manage their cost base, and building trust quickly across functions.Calm in a fast, public-company environment, and a player-coach when needed. When the close is loud, the forecast is shifting, and the board ask just landed, you set the tone for your team. You lead through them, but you're not above rolling up your sleeves when a critical analysis needs to land.Excellent communicator. Comfortable presenting to a board, talking to the CEO, or coaching a senior analyst through a model.

Nice-To-Haves

Payments, fintech, or scaled SaaS experiencePublic-company experience including investor-facing materials and earnings cycle supportPrior experience leading a finance function through transformation — modernizing systems, automating processes, rebuilding data architecture, or upgrading the teamHands-on experience with Sigma or comparable BI/analytics platforms used as a finance layerHands-on experience deploying AI workflows, agents, or automations on an FP&A team

Your Manager

Monica Gras, VP FP&A

Typical Process

Application SubmissionRecruiter video callHiring manager video callVirtual "Onsite" consisting of 3-4 video calls with cross-functional leaders (CFO, Controller, Accounting leadership, functional executive partners)Final Interview with the CFO and hiring manager.Executive panel (if applicable)Offer!

Compensation And Benefits

Marqeta is a Flex First company which allows you to choose your best working environment, whether that be from home or at a company office. To support Flex First, we calibrate pay to a competitive value according to working location. Compensation is aligned according to three tiers within the United States:

National: A baseline tier that applies to most of the geographic territory of the United States.Premium: Slightly elevated from the National tier, and oriented toward a narrower set of higher cost-of-living areas, such as Los Angeles CA and Seattle WAPremium Plus: A tier for the most expensive working areas, like the San Francisco Bay area and New York City.

Visit this page or consult with a Recruiter to determine which tier would be applicable to you.

When determining salaries, we consider several factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior experience, and work location. The new-hire base salary range for this position is:

National: $217,300 - $271,600Premium: $228,600 - $285,800Premium Plus: $240,000 - $300,000

We also believe in recognizing the contributions of our people. That's why we award annual bonuses to eligible employees, rewarding both individual performance and the success of the entire company.

Along with monetary compensation, Marqeta offers

Multiple health insurance optionsFlexible time off – take what you needRetirement savings program with company contribution and after tax contributionsEquity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase ProgramFamily-forming benefits, fertility support, and up to 20 weeks of Parental LeaveFree therapy sessions, financial and professional coaching, and legal adviceMonthly stipend to support our remote work modelAnnual “development dollars” to support our people growth and developmentThrough Flex First, the freedom to live and work wherever you and your family thrive

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

Equal Employment Opportunity, Accommodations and Privacy

Marqeta is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), veteran status or uniformed service member status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information (including testing or characteristics) or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Marqeta endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please submit this form with your specific accommodation request.

Marqeta cares about your privacy. Personal data that is provided as part of the application and recruitment process is processed in accordance with the Applicant Privacy Notice. Additional information for California residents can be found here.

Notice on Use of AI in Recruitment

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Global Network Experience (GNX) in Money Platform — the team that owns the decision intelligence behind every dollar Remitly moves. Our platform determines not just how money moves, but what's possible, what's required of a customer, and what outcome they should expect.

You will work on a platform operating at real scale: 5,000+ corridors across 171 countries, 35,000+ routes, tens of thousands of receiving institutions, and a catalog serving hundreds of millions of requests a day. The complexity is shape as much as size: a route is a combination of country, currency, payment method, institution, partner and product line — only some combinations are valid, and we keep adding dimensions.

The central engineering challenge is platformizing that complexity — democratizing the data, building autonomy

into network management, optimizing business value with continuous monitoring and intelligence, and making each new corridor, partner, payment method or product line faster to launch and better-performing than the last.

GNX's platform surface spans from defining the data model of the network to the intelligence that operates it:

Modeling the network — the authoritative account of what the network can do: every partner, institution, destination and route we support, and the libraries everything else is built on.Deciding how money moves — what we ask and verify before a send, the route it takes, the limits that apply, when it will land across 171 countries of partner schedules and holidays, and what happens when a partner fails. Every transaction, continuously, and increasingly by model rather than rule.Controlling it safely — the platform operators run the network from, and the agent interfaces that let AI do the same under real change control.

We are looking for range: depth in one of these areas, enough fluency in the others to make good calls at the seams, and the communication to represent your area to everyone who depends on it. You will take technical ownership of an area, become the person the company trusts on it, and then do it again somewhere else. The domains are interdependent — a change in how the catalog models an institution lands on routing, validation and estimates within the same quarter — so the engineers who do well here are the ones who can hold more than one of them in their head.

The direction is autonomy — a network that notices a partner degrading, reroutes around it and corrects its own delivery promises without a human in the loop. You will also work closely with network operations, program management, analytics, the ML team, Treasury, integration squads and business product teams — the platform has a broad internal customer base, and part of the job is representing your area to it.

rows.title: Pricing Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 2-3 days in office)

Pricing at Marshmallow

This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new?

We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency.

We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements.

We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors.

All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with!

What You’ll Be Doing

Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing.Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers.Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python.Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python.Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing.Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value.Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals.Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products.

Who are you?

Proactive: You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities Modeller: You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class modelsCommercial: You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impactCurious: You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate furtherOwner: You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your areaOpinionated: You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest wayExplainer: You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-expertsNetworker: You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business

What skills are we looking for from you?

Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/RAbility to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/RAt least 3 years of experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role

Perks of the job

Bonus scheme designed to reward high performancePrivate medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with OlivaPersonal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a yearMonthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose25 days holiday plus bank holidays4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Our process

Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)Technical interview with a couple of the team (60 mins)Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

rows.title: Director, Healthcare Product Partnerships
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

We are seeking a Director, Healthcare Product Partnerships to lead the partnerships that shape what WHOOP measures, validates, and builds. This role will manage relationships with academic medical centers, research institutions, medical device and diagnostics companies, and digital health platforms, with the goal of expanding WHOOP's physiological signal set, generating clinical evidence, and deepening product integration across the healthcare ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines fluency in research and collaboration opportunities, digital health product development, data sharing and privacy, and strong partnership and negotiation instincts. This role will work closely with leaders across Product, Data Science, Clinical & Medical Operations, Regulatory, and Legal to bring product and research partnerships from concept through execution, validation, and ongoing relationship management.

Develop and execute WHOOP's product and research partnerships strategy, identifying opportunities with academic medical centers, health systems, research institutions, third party vendors, medical device and diagnostics companies, and digital health platformsBuild and manage a pipeline of co-development and integration opportunities that expand WHOOP's physiological and clinical signal set in partnership with Product, Clinical and Data ScienceManage the research collaboration pipeline end-to-end — from partner identification through execution; in partnership with Performance Science and Clinical & Medical AffairsNegotiate and structure research, data-sharing, and technology integration agreements, partnering with Legal and Regulatory to ensure alignment with HIPAA, Privacy/Security, and FDA complianceLead partnerships with EHR vendors and digital health platforms to enable data interoperability and product-level integrations that support clinical use casesEvaluate potential licensing, co-development, or exclusivity arrangements with medical device and diagnostics companies, building business cases in partnership with Finance and AnalyticsEstablish frameworks to evaluate research and product partnership performance, including evidence generated, publications, and downstream product impactPresent product and research partnership pipeline, findings, and strategic recommendations to executive leadershipManage ongoing partner relationships to ensure ongoing success with all contracted partners

rows.title: Principal Product Manager, System Insights for DX
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

How Product Works At DX

PMs at DX act as the compass and context engine for their product area. You will own product direction, prioritized problems, and outcomes; your Tech Lead partner will own sequencing, technical scope, and quality. We expect PMs to stay close to customers, synthesize context for the team, sprint ahead on ambiguous work with lightweight specs and mockups, and increase the team’s speed of learning. We default to pragmatic, async written work rather than unnecessary process.

About The Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead DX’s System Insights portfolio, including out-of-the-box reports, Dashboards, Data Studio, and Pulse.

This portfolio is where complex engineering data becomes understandable and actionable. You will define how DX turns quantitative signals into trusted insights for engineering executives, developer productivity leaders, and platform teams. That includes both opinionated experiences that answer common questions quickly and flexible tools that let sophisticated customers explore their own questions.

You will set portfolio strategy, connect work across multiple product surfaces, and drive decisions through deep customer, market, technical, and quantitative context. The right person is an exceptional data product leader who can move fluently between analytical methods, data models, information design, customer workflows, and business outcomes.

Location

This role is US remote-friendly. Candidates based in Utah are preferred.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for DX’s System Insights portfolio.Establish a coherent reporting and analytics experience across out-of-the-box reports, Dashboards, Data Studio, and Pulse.Define how DX helps customers move from data to insight to action, reducing time to insight while preserving analytical trust.Balance opinionated, ready-to-use insights with flexible tools for custom exploration and analysis.Raise the quality of report discoverability, information architecture, data visualization, and decision support across the product.You’ll own how DX evolves AI across the platform, shaping the roadmap for DX AI, our conversational copilot that lets engineering leaders query their own data to investigate anomalies, compare teams, summarize survey feedback, and generate charts on the flyYou will drive the platform toward a more Agentic future where AI proactively surfaces insights and takes action on the user’s behalf.Partner with the Data Cloud and Self-Reported Insights teams to combine system and human signals into a differentiated customer experience.Develop deep context on engineering executives, developer productivity leaders, platform teams, the questions they need to answer, and how those answers affect decisions.Shape the most ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, analytical exploration, and clear written narratives.Always know how the portfolio is performing across usage, adoption, retention, and satisfaction; lead regular growth reviews and bring hypotheses when metrics move.Influence product direction beyond your immediate team and raise the quality of product thinking across DX.Partner with Engineering, Design, customer-facing teams, and go-to-market leaders on pilots, launches, documentation, positioning, and measurement.


Compensation

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. To support this goal, the baseline of our range is higher than that of the typical market range, but in turn we expect to hire most candidates near this baseline. Base pay within the range is ultimately determined by a candidate's skills, expertise, or experience. I

Pay Ranges

Role

In The United States, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A: $197,100 - $257,325

Zone B: $177,390 - $231,593

Zone C: $163,593 - $213,580

Qualifications

What we’re looking for

7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a significant analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or data product portfolio.Deep understanding of quantitative data and data analysis, with the ability to reason about data models, metrics, analytical methods, and the limits of the underlying data.Strong technical fluency and the ability to work effectively with senior engineers and data specialists on complex product and architectural tradeoffs.Demonstrated strength in data visualization, information design, reporting workflows, or analytical product experiences.A track record of setting strategy and delivering outcomes across multiple related products or teams.Principal-level influence: the ability to clarify complex decisions, align senior stakeholders, and improve product thinking without relying on reporting authority.Strong customer discovery, synthesis, prioritization, and written communication skills.Comfort operating in ambiguity, moving quickly, and making pragmatic tradeoffs without sacrificing quality or enterprise trust.


Nice to have

Experience building products for developer productivity, platform engineering, or engineering leadership audiences.Product experience in developer tools, observability, data infrastructure, or business intelligence.Experience building both out-of-the-box reporting and flexible self-service analytics.Experience in a fast-growing startup.Firsthand experience using DX as a customer.

rows.descriptionText:
