parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:

In-office locations: London, UK; Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA.

Remote location(s): Washington, USA.Minimum qualifications:

PhD degree in Computer Science, Human-Centered Computing, Cognitive Science, or a related field. 6 years post-PhD experience conducting research on topics relating to Human-Centered AI (e.g., postdoctoral work, faculty experience, industrial research, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

Experience communicating complex scientific concepts to academic and general audiences.Deep familiarity with relevant academic literature and commercial innovations in AI, HCI, and related areas.Strong track record of peer-reviewed publications in venues for AI, ML, HCI, or social science research. Proficiency in developing prototypes for exploring novel modes of Human-Computer Interaction (software or hardware). 

About The Job

As a research scientist, you will leverage your expertise at the intersection of AI and Human-Computer Interaction to develop and execute a novel research agenda that identifies and explores key topics regarding the future of human interactions with artificial general intelligence, and the likely impacts of such interactions on individuals and society. You will communicate your findings to DeepMind stakeholders, the academic research community, and the general public through appropriate fora such as publication in rigorous peer-reviewed venues, the DMI platform, research symposia, prototypes and demonstrations, and other formats. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with interdisciplinary colleagues within DMI and DeepMind as you formulate and execute rigorous, forward-looking research on the future of Human-AI Interactions.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Develop and lead a novel research agenda addressing high-impact questions regarding the future of Human-AI Interactions.Collaborate with interdisciplinary colleagues from DMI and DeepMind in developing and executing research. Develop relationships with Google’s product and policy teams to translate research findings into company and global impact. Design, conduct, and analyze mixed-methods studies involving human-subjects, including lab studies, surveys, field experiments, and other appropriate methods for evaluating Human-AI Interactions. Develop artifacts for exploring and advancing the future of Human-AI Interactions, including hardware and/or software prototypes, new interaction techniques and interface designs, novel metrics, benchmarks, agents, simulations, and other methods and artifacts for investigating and advancing the field. Communicate research findings internally and externally via peer-reviewed scientific publications, whitepapers and tech reports, presentations, keynotes, workshops, blogs, and other media.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.4 years of experience building, scaling, and debugging machine learning models using deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).Experience in one core area: Reinforcement Learning (RL), Post-Training (SFT/RLHF/RLAIF), Agentic Tool-Use, or Inference-Time Search.

Preferred qualifications:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Physics, or a related quantitative field.Experience training and managing models on large-scale distributed accelerator clusters (e.g., TPUs or GPUs).Experience designing asynchronous agent-environment simulation loops or large distributed post-training pipelines.Experience prototyping new hypotheses quickly while keeping shared codebases clean, robust, and production-grade.

About The Job

At DeepMind, the Planning, Reasoning, Inference & Structured Models (PRISM) team brings together researchers and engineers to advance the frontiers of AI reasoning and autonomous agentic systems. We reject the false tradeoff between research and execution, pursuing breakthroughs on open AI challenges while embedding directly into core teams to land those capabilities in production.

Our work powers Gemini & Gemma—developing core reasoning capabilities and RL scaling for Gemini 3, and leading Gemma 3 270M, including multi-agent Gemini capabilities. We deliver critical contributions to AI Grand Challenges (such as our gold medal-winning IMO 2025 effort), drive product innovations like 'deep think' mode and agentic inference scaling in antigravity, and lead Alphabet-wide initiatives including AI for Science and Project Big Sleep.

In this role, you will operate across the full research-and-engineering lifecycle, developing distributed post-training infrastructure and algorithms that enable Gemini models to solve complex, multi-step problems autonomously.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

rows.title: Principal Product Manager, System Insights for DX

parsed.text: Salt Lake City, UT, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

How Product Works At DX

PMs at DX act as the compass and context engine for their product area. You will own product direction, prioritized problems, and outcomes; your Tech Lead partner will own sequencing, technical scope, and quality. We expect PMs to stay close to customers, synthesize context for the team, sprint ahead on ambiguous work with lightweight specs and mockups, and increase the team’s speed of learning. We default to pragmatic, async written work rather than unnecessary process.

About The Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead DX’s System Insights portfolio, including out-of-the-box reports, Dashboards, Data Studio, and Pulse.

This portfolio is where complex engineering data becomes understandable and actionable. You will define how DX turns quantitative signals into trusted insights for engineering executives, developer productivity leaders, and platform teams. That includes both opinionated experiences that answer common questions quickly and flexible tools that let sophisticated customers explore their own questions.

You will set portfolio strategy, connect work across multiple product surfaces, and drive decisions through deep customer, market, technical, and quantitative context. The right person is an exceptional data product leader who can move fluently between analytical methods, data models, information design, customer workflows, and business outcomes.

Location

This role is US remote-friendly. Candidates based in Utah are preferred.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for DX’s System Insights portfolio.Establish a coherent reporting and analytics experience across out-of-the-box reports, Dashboards, Data Studio, and Pulse.Define how DX helps customers move from data to insight to action, reducing time to insight while preserving analytical trust.Balance opinionated, ready-to-use insights with flexible tools for custom exploration and analysis.Raise the quality of report discoverability, information architecture, data visualization, and decision support across the product.You’ll own how DX evolves AI across the platform, shaping the roadmap for DX AI, our conversational copilot that lets engineering leaders query their own data to investigate anomalies, compare teams, summarize survey feedback, and generate charts on the flyYou will drive the platform toward a more Agentic future where AI proactively surfaces insights and takes action on the user’s behalf.Partner with the Data Cloud and Self-Reported Insights teams to combine system and human signals into a differentiated customer experience.Develop deep context on engineering executives, developer productivity leaders, platform teams, the questions they need to answer, and how those answers affect decisions.Shape the most ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, analytical exploration, and clear written narratives.Always know how the portfolio is performing across usage, adoption, retention, and satisfaction; lead regular growth reviews and bring hypotheses when metrics move.Influence product direction beyond your immediate team and raise the quality of product thinking across DX.Partner with Engineering, Design, customer-facing teams, and go-to-market leaders on pilots, launches, documentation, positioning, and measurement.


Compensation

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. To support this goal, the baseline of our range is higher than that of the typical market range, but in turn we expect to hire most candidates near this baseline. Base pay within the range is ultimately determined by a candidate's skills, expertise, or experience. I

Pay Ranges

Role

In The United States, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A: $197,100 - $257,325

Zone B: $177,390 - $231,593

Zone C: $163,593 - $213,580

Qualifications

What we’re looking for

7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a significant analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or data product portfolio.Deep understanding of quantitative data and data analysis, with the ability to reason about data models, metrics, analytical methods, and the limits of the underlying data.Strong technical fluency and the ability to work effectively with senior engineers and data specialists on complex product and architectural tradeoffs.Demonstrated strength in data visualization, information design, reporting workflows, or analytical product experiences.A track record of setting strategy and delivering outcomes across multiple related products or teams.Principal-level influence: the ability to clarify complex decisions, align senior stakeholders, and improve product thinking without relying on reporting authority.Strong customer discovery, synthesis, prioritization, and written communication skills.Comfort operating in ambiguity, moving quickly, and making pragmatic tradeoffs without sacrificing quality or enterprise trust.


Nice to have

Experience building products for developer productivity, platform engineering, or engineering leadership audiences.Product experience in developer tools, observability, data infrastructure, or business intelligence.Experience building both out-of-the-box reporting and flexible self-service analytics.Experience in a fast-growing startup.Firsthand experience using DX as a customer.

rows.title: Research Engineer, Frontier AI, Incubation, DeepMind
rows.descriptionText:
Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.Experience programming in Python or C++.Experience with machine learning, algorithm design, data structures, and distributed software systems.Experience taking technical projects or machine learning systems from conceptual formulation to implementation and deployment.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience developing, fine-tuning, or optimizing foundation models including techniques such as RLHF/RLAIF, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient tuning, or inference optimization.Experience with personalization, adaptive systems, user modeling, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic memory architectures.Experience with modern machine learning frameworks and model training or serving infrastructure.Experience collaborating across research and product boundaries to co-design technical architectures.

About The Job

At Google, research-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Design, train, and optimize foundational algorithms and machine learning systems (e.g., personalized model adaptation, agentic workflows, contextual memory architectures, dynamic prompt optimization, and multimodal reasoning).Lead end-to-end technical development from algorithmic design and experimental prototyping to production-grade architecture and scaled serving infrastructure.Partner directly with engineering and product teams to integrate and harden core technologies within production environments (e.g., Project Helix, agent workspaces, and intelligent system integrations).Formulate novel automated and human-in-the-loop evaluation methodologies to measure capability gains, latency/compute efficiency, alignment, and personalization fidelity.
